jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer(EN)
jobs.description:
Create your own future

As a Senior .NET Developer in the Nexus Team, you will help build the foundation for future digital solutions within our Private Clients business.

The Nexus Team is responsible for developing an Operational Data Store (ODS): a central data platform that brings together information from multiple source systems, standardises it, and makes it available for applications across the organisation. By creating a consistent and reliable data layer, we enable development teams to make better use of data. While this is a Senior .NET Developer role, the focus is primarily on backend development.

This is a highly autonomous role in a lean team. You will not only build solutions, but also help shape the future of the platform. You will work in a complex environment where business processes, applications and data models come together.

We believe that the best solutions come from truly understanding the problem first. That's why we're looking for someone who is curious and enjoys investigating how things work, actively engages with stakeholders, challenges assumptions, and translates complex questions into scalable technical solutions.

Your responsibilities

Design, build and maintain services and applications on top of the Operational Data Store
Develop backend functionality and integrations using C# .NET and Azure SQL
Help migrate functionality from existing APIs to the new data layer where appropriate
Integrate and standardise data from multiple source systems
Contribute to the evolution of the data model and platform architecture
Work closely with business stakeholders, architects and development teams to understand requirements and identify opportunities for improvement
Investigate complex data and application landscapes and propose solutions that balance business and technical needs
Take ownership from analysis through implementation

Your talents

As a Senior .NET Developer, you are independent, analytical and proactive. You enjoy working in an environment where not everything is defined upfront and where discovering the right solution is part of the job.

You are someone who wants to understand how things really work. You ask questions, challenge assumptions and are comfortable forming and defending your own view on technical and functional decisions.

In addition, you have:

At least 5 years of experience with C# .NET development
Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases
Experience building integrations between systems and applications
Experience working with Azure-based solutions
An affinity for data modelling and complex data structures
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience working in Agile teams

Move ahead at Van Lanschot Kempen

Investing in a more future-oriented, sustainable, and data-driven way with various clients. Both nationally and internationally. With nearly 300 years of experience, we make this ambition a reality at Van Lanschot Kempen. We do this with more than 2,100 colleagues in various fields of expertise.

Within the Nexus Team you will join a group of senior professionals in a Scrum team with a clear mission: creating a reliable and future-proof data foundation for applications within the Private Clients domain. Because the team is lean, your contribution has a direct impact on the direction of the platform. You will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, shape solutions, and work on challenges that combine software engineering, architecture, and data. We offer an environment where ownership, curiosity and initiative are valued. Technical expertise matters, but your ability to navigate complexity is what will make the difference.

An organisation's degree of innovation and agility also depends on the diversity of its workforce. Our differences make us stronger together. We promote an inclusive work environment where all colleagues feel at home. With us, you can be yourself. And we are proud of that.

Curious about the stories of colleagues and how they experience working at Van Lanschot Kempen? Go to Podcasts and find out more

That's what we do. The fact is, if you add value, you can expect the same from us in return. A good work-life balance with our 'hybrid way of working' is a good example of this. As Senior .NET Developer, you will also be given:

a gross monthly salary between €5.500 and 7000 commensurate with your knowledge and experience.
additional flexible budget of 19.47% of your gross salary (containing a 13th month, 8% holiday allowance & 7 extra legal leave days) You can utilize this by buying a bike, monthly gym membership, but also to save up for a sabbatical! It’s also possible to get the full budget paid out at any moment in the year.
an employee share plan, where Van Lanschot Kempen doubles your investment (of max. €3.500 a year) in Van Lanschot Kempen shares.
27 leave days of which 7 are part of the flexible budget.
working from home equipment such as electric standing desk, chair, a number of screens of your choice can be ordered and sent to your home.
your commute to work is compensated, including green options of walking and biking to work!
working from home allowance.
the option of exchanging national public holidays for religious holidays.
a free Van Lanschot Kempen bank account and other employee conditions, such as a discount on an Evi (investment) account.
a market competitive pension scheme. The exact contribution is based on your salary and age, generally, most people can expect around 20% contribution, which 4% is employee contribution.
a number of communities and events throughout the year, communities such as Young Professionals, Women, International, Pride, Sustainability, Sports clubs etc.
weekly drinks at our bar in the office.
Dutch and English language courses.
Hybrid working with flexibility, with the team typically in the Amsterdam office two days a week, Monday and Friday

And we have many other employment benefits ready for you. Discover all the benefits of working at Van Lanschot Kempen.

Excited about this opportunity? Apply through our website.

Bij NCIM zoeken we ervaren nieuwe collega's die de diepte in willen gaan op het gebied van autonomie en missiekritieke software. We bouwen hier geen standaardapplicaties, maar complexe systemen voor Defensie en Veiligheid. Denk aan satellietcommunicatie en real-time dataverwerking waar stabiliteit en veiligheid allesbepalend zijn. 🛡️

Wat ga je technisch doen?

Je werkt aan projecten waar de technische keuzes die jij vandaag maakt, bepalend zijn voor de stabiliteit en veiligheid op de lange termijn.
Architectuur & Design:
Je bouwt en ontwerpt in C# / .NET 8. We zoeken iemand die complexe systemen niet uit de weg gaat en begrijpt hoe je een oplossing neerzet die zowel veilig als schaalbaar is.
Frontend Engineering:
Je vertaalt grote datasets naar een logische UI in Angular, React of Vue.js. Hierbij focus je op een strakke structuur en herbruikbare componenten; geen 'quick fixes', maar stabiele code.
DevOps & Infra:
Docker en Kubernetes zijn voor jou bekend terrein. Je zorgt voor een efficiënte uitrol van applicaties, vaak binnen beveiligde on-premise omgevingen waar veiligheid voorop staat.
Code Quality:
Je bent kritisch op je eigen werk en dat van anderen. SOLID-principles en design patterns zijn voor jou de standaard, en je vindt het leuk om via code reviews het team scherp te houden.

Wie ben jij?

Achtergrond:
Een afgeronde technische HBO of WO en een stevige basis in software engineering.
Tech stack:
Je bent ervaren met .NET, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework en Azure. Je weet niet alleen hoe het werkt, maar ook hoe je het slim inzet.
Inhoudelijke sparringpartner:
Je kunt technische keuzes onderbouwen en uitleggen waarom de ene oplossing beter is dan de andere. Vervolgens steek je ook zelf de handen uit de mouwen om het te bouwen.
Communicatie:
Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

Wat krijg je van ons?

We regelen de zaken goed, zodat jij je kunt focussen op de inhoud:
Beloning:
Een competitief salaris dat past bij je ervaring en een maandelijkse bonusregeling.
Mobiliteit:
Een leaseauto met tankpas (ook voor privégebruik) en
een extra mobiliteitsvergoeding bovenop je salaris.
Vrijheid:
29 vakantiedagen + 5 mei vrij, hybride werken en een goede pensioenopbouw.
Groei:
Een uniek mentorschap en mogelijkheden voor specialistische trainingen certificeringen.
NCIM-cultuur:
We zijn een hecht team zonder hiërarchisch gedoe. Naast het werk doen we veel samen: van de borrelmomentjes en teamuitjes tot onze jaarlijkse trip naar het buitenland.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise C/C++ and .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Back-end Developer or Fullstack developer (Blazor) who thrives on security, scale, and high-impact engineering?

Do you want to modernize mission-critical enterprise software, evolve a global-ready product, and help shape the future of secure certificate lifecycle management?

Then this is your chance to join a technically elite core team and make a direct impact on a platform used across complex IT, OT, and IoT landscapes worldwide.

About the organization

Our client is a fast-growing Dutch scale-up with global ambitions, developing cutting-edge enterprise solutions for PKI Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM). Their software automates certificate discovery, provisioning, and renewal across large hybrid environments - from data centers to cloud-native infrastructures.
The environment is dynamic, flexible and ambitious: the platform is evolving rapidly, and your expertise will directly influence its architecture, scalability, and security posture.

About the role

As a Senior Back-end Developer, you'll work hands-on on both legacy modernization and greenfield development. You'll upgrade and extend a foundational C/C++ codebase, while designing and building new components in C# / ASP.NET within a modern enterprise ecosystem.
Security, reliability, and maintainability are critical. You'll act as a technical sparring partner, contribute to architectural decisions, and help evolve the platform into a global-scale product. If you enjoy deep engineering challenges and meaningful technical ownership, this role will fit you perfectly.

What you'll do

Modernize and extend a legacy C/C++ enterprise codebase
Design and build new back-end components in C# / ASP.NET
Strengthen the platform's security, scalability, and reliability
Integrate with cloud-native and enterprise services (e.g., Entra ID / MS Graph)
Work with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Contribute to CI/CD automation and infrastructure tooling (Ansible)
Implement robust, secure coding practices and perform code reviews
Bring new product features to life in a fast-moving environment
Collaborate closely with developers and architects in a lean, high-performing team

Who you are

A pragmatic, seasoned engineer with strong ownership
Comfortable working in small, high-impact teams
Capable of bringing modern architecture into complex legacy systems for enterprise companies
Someone who naturally thinks in terms of security, robustness, and long-term maintainability
Not afraid to dive deep into systems and improve them from within

What you bring

EU passport (needed for security compliance)
Based in the Netherlands
Strong expertise in secure coding, code review, and automation
Solid experience with C# and ASP.NET
Strong C/C++ skills for maintaining and evolving legacy components
Experience in Enterprise Software environments, not in embedded environments!!!!!
Proficient in SQL, RESTful APIs, multithreading
Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Ansible
Interest in cloud identity integrations such as Entra ID / MS Graph

Nice to have

gRPC / Protobuf
.NET 8+ / C# 12+
Experience with Blazor
Generative AI-assisted development
OpenSSL knowledge
Applied interest in post-quantum cryptography
MySQL administration experience

What's in it for you

Work on a platform with high security, global scale, and real-world impact
A role with significant technical influence and architectural input
Hybrid working: one day per week in Utrecht, the rest remote
A highly skilled, collaborative engineering team with deep domain expertise
Freedom, responsibility, and room to experiment with modern technologies
A transparent, flat organization where your contribution directly shapes the product and the company's growth trajectory

Why this role matters

jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een ervaren .NET-developer die de stap naar architectuur heeft gemaakt en zich de afgelopen jaren actief is gaan verdiepen in AI. Iemand met een stevige basis in C#/.NET, die weet wat er nodig is om software in productie te krijgen en te houden, en die zijn technische kennis en nieuwsgierigheid naar AI nu wil inzetten om het totaalontwerp van AI-oplossingen naar zich toe te trekken.

Concreet: samen met onze andere senior engineers bepaal je welke modellen en infrastructuur we inzetten, hoe die aansluiten op de bestaande systemen van ons en onze klanten, en je bouwt zelf mee om het werkend te krijgen. We zoeken nadrukkelijk geen AI-specialist zonder developmentachtergrond, en ook geen developer zonder affiniteit met AI. We zoeken de combinatie: een doorgewinterde .NET-engineer die het pad naar AI is ingeslagen.

Groeien met Hoppinger

We zijn eerlijk over waar we staan. Hoppinger is op dit moment nog geen AI-native organisatie. Onze platformen voor bedrijfskritische processen in zorg, housing, kennis en onderwijs en industrie zijn gebouwd op een stevige softwarebasis, met C#/.NET als belangrijk fundament. AI voegen we daar gericht aan toe.
De ambitie is wel duidelijk: we groeien naar een AI-first manier van werken, waarbij AI geen losstaand experiment is, maar een beheersbaar en schaalbaar onderdeel van het platform. Om die stap te zetten hebben we mensen nodig die hun technische ervaring en hun nieuwsgierigheid naar AI al effectief combineren in de praktijk. Jij helpt die transformatie waarmaken en geeft er mede richting aan.

Jouw rol: van bedrijfsprobleem naar werkende oplossing

Je vertaalt het vraagstuk van onze klanten naar een technische oplossing en bepaalt hoe AI wordt ingezet binnen hun platformen. Dat is breder dan modellen kiezen: het gaat om het ontwerpen van een complete oplossing, van architectuur tot productie. Je staat met één been in de code en met het andere aan het whiteboard bij de directie van onze klanten.
Je dagen zijn afwisselend en bestaan onder andere uit:
Het vertalen van een bedrijfsprobleem naar een technische architectuur
Het beoordelen welke AI-aanpak past: agents, klassieke ML of een combinatie, en de afweging tussen bouwen, kopen of een API aanroepen
Het zelf meebouwen aan oplossingen, in een omgeving waar C#/.NET en moderne frameworks de basis van onze platformen vormen
Het bewaken van non-functionals: schaalbaarheid, latency, kosten, beveiliging en compliance
Het werken aan agentic systemen: orkestratie, tool use, human-in-the-loop patronen en meer
Het samenwerken met experience architects, engineers en data-analisten, en het leiden van zowel een architectuurreview met developers als een whiteboard-sessie met een directeur

Wie ben jij

Je bent in de eerste plaats een ervaren software engineer met een sterke .NET-achtergrond, doorgegroeid naar een architectuurrol. Je hebt aantoonbaar software gebouwd en live gebracht, en je verdiept je actief in wat er nodig is om AI betrouwbaar in productie te draaien. Die laatste stap heb je al gezet of je bent er serieus mee bezig.
Je herkent jezelf hierin:
Ruime ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, met C#/.NET als vaste waarde in je gereedschapskist. Dit is voor deze rol een harde eis, geen pré
Kennis van softwarearchitectuur: API-design, microservices, event-driven architectuur en containerisatie
Ervaring met minstens één hyperscaler (Azure, AWS of Google Cloud)
Hands-on ervaring met LLM's en het bouwen van AI-toepassingen. Productie-ervaring is een pré, een aantoonbare en al actieve drive om hierin verder te groeien is een eis
Affiniteit met agentic development en de ambitie om je hierin te specialiseren
Het vermogen om technische keuzes uit te leggen aan niet-technische stakeholders, van product owner tot C-level
Relevante certificeringen (zoals Azure Solutions Architect of AWS Solutions Architect) zijn een pré, aantoonbare kennis en ervaring wegen zwaarder

Wat bieden wij

Veel vrijheid en een ambitieuze cultuur waar persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staat. Natuurlijk draait niet alles om werk, en bovenop alle gebruikelijke benefits die je mag verwachten bieden we ook:
Salaris :
een marktconform salaris, € 4.900 - € 7.500, o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring
Celebration Leave: ruil 3 nationale feestdagen in voor jouw eigen feestdagen
Alleo: kies extra benefits op basis van je eigen interesses
100% doorbetaald partnerverlof: voor een goede start van je gezin
Hybride werken: flexibiliteit om te werken vanuit onze inspirerende kantoren in Rotterdam en Utrecht (De Bilt) of vanuit huis
Multidisciplinaire teams: werk samen met ambitieuze collega's
Opleidingsbudget: voor jouw persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling
Lerende organisatie: groei in een omgeving vol kennisdeling en innovatie
Gratis lunch: met aandacht voor gezond eten, samen lunchen en vaste tradities zoals Krokettenwoensdag

Even kort over Hoppinger

Hoppinger is een Digital Partner die organisaties helpt versnellen in hun digitale groei en innovatie. Wij gidsen opdrachtgevers bij strategische keuzes en de ontwikkeling van platformen voor bedrijfskritische klant- en kernprocessen. Door onze expertise over meerdere disciplines, sectorervaring en bewezen methodieken realiseren we digitale oplossingen die waarde creëren voor organisaties, medewerkers en eindgebruikers. Voor nu, en in de toekomst.
We werken voor organisaties in impactvolle sectoren zoals zorg, educatie, industrie en dienstverlening.

jobs.title: Adviseur software development en automatisering
jobs.description:
Waar code en engineering samenkomen

Technische installaties leveren steeds meer data op. Maar hoe zet je die data om in software waar engineers en assetbeheerders echt mee kunnen werken? Als AI Software Engineer bij Iv bouw je toepassingen die precies dat doen.

Van AI voor inspecties tot risico gestuurd assetmanagement: jouw software helpt om technische assets slimmer te beheren. Je ontwikkelt schaalbare applicaties en API’s met onder andere Python, C# en FastAPI. Daarbij vertaal je technische vraagstukken naar oplossingen die betrouwbaar werken en praktisch toepasbaar zijn.

Een goed idee is pas waardevol als het ook in de praktijk werkt. Daarom denk je mee over de software-architectuur, werk je technische ontwerpen uit en bouw je mee aan de implementatie. Je doorloopt het hele ontwikkelproces en blijft betrokken bij de doorontwikkeling. Zo ontstaan maakbare oplossingen voor infrastructuur, offshore platforms, waterzuiveringen en industriële installaties.

Ook AI krijgt daarin steeds meer ruimte. Denk aan toepassingen die inspectie- en sensordata analyseren of AI-chatbots die engineers ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken. Samen met data-analisten, data scientists, software developers en inhoudelijke engineers bepaal je wat technisch nodig én bruikbaar is. Het resultaat: software dat aansluit op de dagelijkse praktijk van onze klanten.

Je komt terecht binnen de sector Assetmanagement en werkt nauw samen met collega’s van ICT en Digitalisering. Hier houden we van ingewikkelde technische vraagstukken, maar niet van moeilijk doen. De lijnen zijn kort, de sfeer is ontspannen en professioneel en we zoeken samen naar een oplossing die werkt. Tegelijk krijg je ruimte om jouw rol verder vorm te geven. Wil je dieper de AI in, meer richting architectuur of juist technische verantwoordelijkheid pakken? Jouw ambitie en talent bepalen mede waar je naartoe groeit.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare richting.
3 tot 5 jaar werkervaring als software engineer, AI engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie.
Ervaring met Python en bij voorkeur ook C#.
Kennis van SQL, API-ontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld met FastAPI, en moderne software-architecturen.
Interesse in of ervaring met AI, machine learning en datagedreven toepassingen.
Ervaring met Azure of een ander cloudplatform is een pré.
Affiniteit met assetmanagement, infrastructuur of industriële toepassingen.
Je werkt gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het volledige ontwikkelproces.
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands.

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Een uitdagende en gevarieerde baan bij het meest diverse ingenieursbureau van Nederland! Zo kun je rekenen op:

De gaafste projecten in alle sectoren: je werkt aan hoogwaardige oplossingen waar de maatschappij écht iets aan heeft. Van ’s werelds grootste offshore windplatformen, bruggen en sluizen tot fabrieken, waterzuiveringsinstallaties en onderzeeboten.
Een professionele én gezellige werkomgeving: bij Iv vind je een laagdrempelige werksfeer waarin hard werken hand in hand gaat met plezier. Zo bezoeken we tweejaarlijks het EK- of WK-voetbal, vieren we nieuwjaar groots in de Efteling, organiseren we gezellige zomerbarbecues en nog veel meer!
Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden: kies voor meer salaris, extra vakantiedagen of beide!
Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: 31 vakantiedagen, jaarlijkse gratificatie (7%), winstuitkering, flexibele pensioenregeling en reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding.
Ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden: we bieden talloze mogelijkheden tot het volgen van opleidingen, cursussen en trainingen om nóg beter te worden in je vak.

Kortom: bij Iv werk je samen met 1400 andere specialisten aan de grootste uitdagingen van deze tijd én beleef je veel plezier. Dat noemen wij: engineering that excites.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Hybride
jobs.description:
Wil jij eigenaar zijn van een platform dat er echt toe doet? Van cloudinfrastructuur en releases tot een vloot slimme kasten in het veld, en van security-audits van veeleisende klanten tot de storing die niemand anders kan vinden? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Wij zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die de dagelijkse werking van ons platform draagt: de Azure-infrastructuur, het uitrollen van nieuwe klantomgevingen, CI/CD en releases, security en compliance, kostenbeheersing en de sleutelkasten en lockers die bij onze klanten draaien. Je bent de specialist op wie het team en onze klanten kunnen bouwen. Je adviseert onze Chief Software Officer over de technische keuzes en begeleidt junior en medior DevOps engineers in hun ontwikkeling.
Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior DevOps Engineer zorg jij dat wat het softwareteam bouwt betrouwbaar, veilig en herhaalbaar in productie komt en daar blijft draaien. Je ondersteunt de CSO bij strategische keuzes over architectuur en investeringen door te komen met onderbouwde voorstellen, die je uitvoert en bewaakt. Je werkt nauw samen met de Tech Lead en het softwareteam en bent het technische gezicht van Nauta Connect richting de IT- en securityafdelingen van onze klanten.
Platform en netwerk:
je beheert en ontwikkelt onze cloud- en on-premise infrastructuur via Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/deployment stacks/Azure Verified Modules), firewalls, loadbalancers, Front Door, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Services, ExpressRoute en VPN, DNS en certificaten.
Uitrol nieuwe klanten:
je zet de infrastructuur voor nieuwe klanten en omgevingen geautomatiseerd en volgens de standaard neer (spoke, netwerk, database, toegang en configuratie), ontwikkelt die standaard door en faseert omgevingen gecontroleerd uit.
Releases en pipelines:
je onderhoudt en verbetert onze CI/CD-pipelines in Azure DevOps (smoke- en performancetests, quality gates, security scanning, geautomatiseerde databasemigraties) en voert de releases en hotfixes van onze productsuite uit, met minimale downtime via blue/green of canary deployments.
Security en compliance:
je werkt shift-left: je signaleert en dicht kwetsbaarheden met tooling als SonarQube, GitLeaks, OWASP Dependency-Check, Trivy en OWASP ZAP, stelt securityrapportages op, beantwoordt security-vragenlijsten van klanten en ondersteunt onze ISO 27001-audits.
Databases en observability:
je beheert onze SQL Server- en PostgreSQL-databases in productie (backups, herstel, migraties, performance) en richt monitoring in met Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics en Grafana.
Kosten:
je maakt de kosten van het platform per omgeving en per klant inzichtelijk, optimaliseert zonder verlies van beschikbaarheid of veiligheid en maakt de kostenimpact van elk voorstel expliciet.
Vloot en devices:
je bouwt en onderhoudt de Linux golden image voor onze kasten en lockers en beheert de vloot in het veld: provisioning, updates en het oplossen van problemen op de devices.
Incidenten en klantomgevingen:
je bent het eindstation voor storingen die support en het softwareteam niet kunnen oplossen, ook op het grensvlak van software en infrastructuur. Je bouwt testopstellingen die klantomgevingen nabootsen en helpt klanten ons product veilig in hun netwerk te landen.
Team en kennis:
je leidt de junior en medior DevOps engineers op, reviewt infrastructuur- en securitywerk en zorgt dat kennis in het team wordt vastgelegd in plaats van in één hoofd.

Wat motiveert jou?

Eigenaarschap:
je bijdrage heeft een echte impact op ons platform.
Breedte:
cloud, netwerk, pipelines, security, databases, kosten, embedded devices en klantnetwerken; weinig DevOps-rollen zijn zo veelzijdig.
Impact:
klanten als zorginstellingen en overheden vertrouwen dagelijks op wat jij draaiende houdt.
Groei:
bij bewezen diepgang volg jij het ontwikkelpad naar DevOps Architect.
Samenwerking:
korte lijnen met de CSO en de Tech Lead, en DevOps-collega's die van jou willen leren.
Flexibiliteit:
hybride werken en werktijden die bij je passen.

Dit bieden wij jou

Een compact, divers en gedreven team waarin jouw werk direct zichtbaar is
Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van je ervaring, en fijne secundaire voorwaarden
Tijd en budget voor opleidingen, certificeringen en conferenties
Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken
Laptop en telefoon van de zaak en wat je nodig hebt om ook thuis prettig te werken
28 vakantiedagen
Korting op je sportschoolabonnement, een vitaliteitsprogramma met allerlei (sportieve) activiteiten en gezellige teamuitjes.
Een cultuur waarin experimenteren mag, fouten maken erbij hoort en successen samen gevierd worden

Wat breng jij mee?

Een hbo- of wo-opleiding in IT of informatica, of gelijkwaardige kennis opgebouwd in de praktijk.
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in DevOps of platform engineering, met aantoonbare verantwoordelijkheid voor productieomgevingen.
Diepgaande kennis van Microsoft Azure (onder meer App Services, Container Apps, Functions, Key Vault, Front Door, Application Gateway, SignalR, Managed Redis) en van Azure-netwerken: landing zone, hub-and-spoke, VNet-peering, NSG's, private endpoints, Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute en VPN.
Ruime ervaring met Infrastructure as Code met Bicep en/of Terraform, met containers (Docker, Container Apps, AKS) en met CI/CD in Azure DevOps Pipelines.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI  (Netherlands)
jobs.description:
Who We Are
At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.
We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.
We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Who You Are
You are self-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious and love to explore and learn new technologies. You have demonstrated the ability to build, deploy, and maintain large-scale, complex applications. You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework.
About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

Qualifications
5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

The base wage range for this position based in The Netherlands is targeted at 143,000 - 184,000 EUR per year.

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. 
For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks . 
Diversity At Justworks
Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. [Business Critical IT / Sustainibility]

Geen manager, geen architect die het voor je bedenkt. Zeven mensen ontwerpen dit platform, bouwen het en draaien het zelf, en jij bent daarin de Azure stem.

Mijn klant bouwt mission ciritcal omgevingen waar hele enterprises dagelijks op draaien, zonder downtime. Ze ontwerpen ze, bouwen ze en draaien ze daarna jaren zelf. Je komt in een team van zeven met volledige technische zeggenschap over één klantomgeving en bijna geen managementlaag erboven op je lead engineer na. Dat team bouwt een applicatie opnieuw die een landelijke order to invoice stroom draagt, dertig jaar oude code met meer dan dertig koppelingen eraan. De oude applicatie is met een AI toolset reverse engineered en wordt nu vanaf de business logica opnieuw opgebouwd. De klant zit in duurzaamheid, dus wat jij overeind houdt heeft ook buiten het kantoor effect.

Wat ga je doen

Jij bent de Azure specialist in een team van software engineers. De landing zone komt van een andere partij, dus je bent niet degene die het bedrijfsnetwerk aanlegt. Wat jij bouwt is het platform waar de applicatie op landt: containers, web apps, schaalbare databases met regionale replicas en failover, caching, queues, API gateway, DNS en load balancing. Ruwweg twee derde van je tijd gaat naar CI/CD en het draaiend houden, dus pipelines die unit, integratie en stress tests uitvoeren en zonder downtime uitrollen, plus monitoring, observability en de on call inrichting rond priority one incidenten. De rest is ontwerp, waarbij je functionele en niet functionele eisen omzet in Azure diensten en uitlegt wat elke afweging kost. Alles gaat geautomatiseerd via Terraform, Python en shell, nooit met de hand in de portal. Je werkt daarnaast met de eigen building blocks en private registries, want hier komt niets zomaar van het open internet binnen.

Jouw profiel

5+ jaar als cloud of DevOps engineer met Azure
Je bouwt cloud native applicatieplatformen: containers, web apps, databases met replicas en failover, API gateway, DNS, load balancing
Terraform of andere IaC tool
CI/CD pipelines die je zelf hebt ontworpen, met teststappen en uitrol zonder downtime, in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI of Jenkins
Scripting of development in Python of Go, en je kunt een .NET of Java codebase lezen
Je hebt gedraaid wat je bouwde, dus monitoring, observability en on call
Vloeiend Nederlands en je woont binnen bereik van Eindhoven

Tot €100K bruto per jaar inclusief vakantiegeld. Een vast contract vanaf dag één, 32 tot 40 uur, en drie dagen per week vanaf het kantoor bij Eindhoven. Elektrische leaseauto of vergoeding. 25 Vakantiedagen + secundair pakket.

Azure Platform Engineer – Azure | Terraform | CI/CD | Eindhoven [€100K + car]

[Business Critical IT / Managed Services]

Empty Azure accounts in, a layered platform out. Containers, replicated databases, queues, and pipelines that roll out without downtime.

My client takes over the systems large organisations cannot afford to lose, designs them, builds them, and then runs them for years. You join a team of seven with full technical ownership of one customer environment and almost no management layer above it. That team is rebuilding an application that carries a national order to invoice flow, thirty years of legacy code with more than thirty integrations hanging off it. The old system was reverse engineered with an AI toolset and is now being rebuilt from the business logic up. The customer works in sustainability, so what you keep running has an effect outside the office.

What you’ll do

You are the Azure specialist in a team of software engineers. The base landing zone is delivered by another party, so you are not wiring up the corporate network. What you build is the platform the application lands on: containers, web apps, scalable databases with regional replicas and failover, caching, queues, API gateway, DNS and load balancing. Roughly two thirds of your time goes into CI/CD and running the thing, so pipelines that run unit, integration and stress tests and roll out without downtime, plus monitoring, observability and the on call setup around priority one incidents. The rest is design, taking functional and non functional requirements and deciding which Azure services to use and what each trade off costs. It is all automated with Terraform, Python and shell, never clicked together in the portal. You also work with the in house building blocks and private registries, because nothing gets pulled straight from the open internet here.

Your profile

5+ years in cloud or DevOps engineering with Azure as your main platform
You build cloud native application platforms: containers, web apps, databases with replicas and failover, API gateway, DNS, load balancing
Terraform as your default for infrastructure as code
CI/CD pipelines you designed yourself, with test stages and zero downtime deployments, in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins
Scripting or development in Python or Go, and you can read a .NET or Java codebase
You have run what you built, so monitoring, observability and on call
Fluent Dutch and you live within reach of Eindhoven

What’s in it for you

Up to €100K gross per year including holiday pay. An indefinite contract from day one, 32 to 40 hours, and three days a week from the office near Eindhoven. You pick your own mobility: an electric lease car, a first class public transport card, or around €820 a month in cash instead. Twenty five holidays on paper, and nobody counts them as long as the customer commitments hold. The learning budget has no real ceiling, you only need your team to agree on the time and your coach on the money.

jobs.description:
Kurzbeschreibung

Werde Teil von Septeo CNEE und begleite anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte in der Insolvenzbranche von der ersten Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
Du kombinierst technische Expertise mit Beratungskompetenz und entwickelst individuelle Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprozesse. Dabei arbeitest du nicht an einem Standardprodukt oder der Abarbeitung von Tickets, sondern gestaltest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden individuelle Workflows, Migrationen und Integrationen mit direktem Mehrwert für die Praxis.
Wenn du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, technisch mitgestaltest und gleichzeitig Freude am Kundenkontakt hast, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
Die Rolle ist deutschlandweit möglich. Da die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und dem Team einen wichtigen Bestandteil der Position darstellt, freuen wir uns über eine regelmäßige Präsenz an unserem Standort in Karlsruhe (ca. 1-2 Tage pro Woche) sowie gelegentliche Kundentermine vor Ort.

Deine Aufgaben

Konzeption und (Weiter-) Entwicklung individueller Erweiterungen, Schnittstellen, Workflows und Integrationen auf Basis von C#/.NET, VBA und XML
Weiterentwicklung und Wartung einer Access-basierten Fachanwendung sowie der zugrunde liegenden MS-SQL-Server-Datenbankstrukturen
Anbindung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Aktenlösungen (eIP, e2A), des Elektronischen Gerichts- und Verwaltungspostfachs (EGVP) sowie Integration elektronischer Signaturen
Entwicklung pragmatischer und nachhaltiger Lösungen für komplexe fachliche und technische Anforderungen
Beratung und technische Unterstützung von Kunden bei der Digitalisierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen im Insolvenzumfeld
Technische Abstimmung mit Kunden sowie Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen aus der Justiz
Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen und Sicherstellung einer sauberen Versionsverwaltung mit GIT

Dein Profil

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung oder technischen Beratung in einer projektorientierten Umgebung
Fundierte Kenntnisse in C#/.NET, MS Access, MS SQL Server, VBA sowie idealerweise modernen Webtechnologien wie Angular, React oder Blazor
Erfahrung in der Analyse fachlicher Anforderungen sowie der Konzeption, Umsetzung und Einführung individueller Softwarelösungen, Integrationen und Migrationen
Erfahrung im Umgang elektronischen Signaturen und idealerweise elektronischem Rechtsverkehr (z. B. EGVP) oder vergleichbaren regulierten Umfeldern
Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse sowie Freude an der fachlichen Beratung und Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden
Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise gepaart mit hoher Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit
Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bewerbungsprozess

Digitales Kennenlernen In einem kurzen Austausch mit unserer Recruiterin schauen wir gemeinsam auf die gegenseitigen Erwartungen.
Fachliches Interview Anschließend lernst du den Fachbereich kennen und erhältst tiefere Einblicke in unsere Projekte, Technologien und Arbeitsweise.
Schnuppertag in Karlsruhe Zum Abschluss besuchst du unser Headquarter in Karlsruhe. Du lernst das Team kennen, erhältst Einblicke in reale Kundenprojekte und kannst dir ein authentisches Bild von unserer Zusammenarbeit und Arbeitsweise machen.

Benefits

Unsere vollständigen Benefits & Vorteile werden im Rahmen unseres Recruiting-Prozesses erklärt, aber auf unserer Karriereseite bekommst du bereits einen guten Überblick: https://www.stp.one/en/careers
Als europäisches Unternehmen unterscheiden sich unsere Benefits je nach Land, einige Benefits gelten jedoch für alle Mitarbeitenden:
Jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget sowie konkrete Karrierepfade
Mitarbeitendenempfehlungsbonus
Mobilität: z. B. Fahrradleasing, Bezuschussung bei öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln
Workation: bis zu 30 Tage pro Jahr innerhalb der EU
Bildschirmarbeitsplatzbrille
Steuerfreie Sachbezüge
Events & Firmenfeiern (Sommerfest, Jahres-Kick-off usw.)
Flexible Arbeitsmodelle (hybrid, Home-Office,Teilzeit usw.)
Englischkurse für alle Level

Kontaktdaten

Melde dich bei Fragen gerne bei unserer Recruiterin
Isabel Ostwald
E-Mail: jobs@stp.one

Über uns

Sharing Trust and Passion for Unity

One Team. One Mission: We are stp.one and together we simplify legal work.

In our industry, we have the opportunity to drive innovation every day. The great ideas of our colleagues ensure that we are shaping the AI-driven future of legal tech. You can help our clients to be successful and enable smart digital experience. Across various locations, all of us collaborate with purpose, creativity, and passion to redefine how legal professionals work.
At Septeo (ex. stp.one) everyone has a voice. We believe in the strength of diversity and are proud to bring together people from different backgrounds, skill sets, and walks of life - because it’s these unique perspectives that drive innovation and success.
Your impact matters

Join us in our journey to become the market leader across Europe. Be yourself, thrive in a supportive environment, and take pride in being a key player in our success story. Discover the difference you can make in an organization that values you as an individual and as an essential part of our thriving community.
What Our People Can Expect

At Septeo (ex. stp.one), we’ve created a workplace that values your individuality and your contribution. We foster diversity and we know that everyone has different preferences and needs. Therefore, we ensure that our people have choices to maintain the best work-life-fit. Enjoy the perks of working from anywhere or from an innovative workspace, workcation experiences, and continuous learning.
Join Septeo (ex. stp.one)

Our focus goes beyond innovative software solutions, we believe in the power of our people to shape the future of legal tech and the digital economy. We amplify each other and forge trust sharing knowledge, offering encouragement, celebrate our team effort and cherishing our differences: stp.one is where your unique journey meets professional growth.

As a Working Student in the Ground Systems Engineering Applications team, you will contribute directly to the software systems that support operation, and future development of our launch vehicles. You will collaborate and work in a team of experienced software engineers and aerospace specialists. Moreover, you will have the chance to gain hands-on experience in modern software stacks and how software is developed in the aerospace industry.

Your Role in Our Space Mission:

The main objective will be to work on our in-house software, which is used to operate our test rigs and launch facilities. This role is crucial for enabling the reliable and efficient operation, testing, and development of our launch vehicles.

More specifically, you will:

Implement new features and improve the existing software
Contribute full-stack, backend and frontend
Help automate engineering processes to improve operational efficiency

Enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
Familiarity with frontend or backend web development (Node.js and/or C#/.NET or another object-oriented programming language)
Familiar with Git and collaborative version control workflows
Experience with relational databases and SQL
Organized and proactive with high attention to detail
Strong communication skills and team-player mindset
Fluent in English

Experience with distributed systems and scalable software architecture

From our office in Erlangen and sometimes at our clients’ premises you like to keep yourself busy with:

Preparing offers and feasibility studies for projects in close cooperation with the project manager, the account manager and customer.
Collaborating with project managers to define the project organization, estimate project timeliness, identify risks and related mitigation strategies
Leading the architectural design and development of software systems, ensuring they meet performance, quality and reliability requirements

jobs.title: Staff Engineer Web & Application Architecture (all genders)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Staff Engineer bist du Enabler für unsere Teams und Projekte und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Architekturen auch langfristig tragfähig bleiben.
Du konzipierst und bewertest skalierbare Architekturen für E-Commerce-, PIM- und CMS-Projekte, häufig bereits in der Konzept- und Pitchphase. Dazu gehören die Modellierung von Domänen und Datenstrukturen sowie der Entwurf von Schnittstellen zwischen Frontend, Backend und Systemen wie Shops oder ERPs.
Du arbeitest hands-on: von Prototypen über Architektur-Reviews in Pull Requests bis zum Pair Programming. Ebenso entwickelst du gewachsene Systeme weiter – durch Migrationen, Refactorings und Performance-Optimierungen – und achtest dabei auf Testbarkeit und Wartbarkeit über mehrjährige Produktlebenszyklen.
Zentrale Anwendungsbausteine, wiederverwendbare Komponenten und Schnittstellen, die wir projektübergreifend einsetzen, entstehen unter deiner Verantwortung
Du gestaltest Build-, Deployment- und Infrastrukturprozesse mit – von Containern über CI/CD bis zum Cloud-Hosting – und bringst AI-gestützte Entwicklung in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Expert:innen voran
Gemeinsam mit dem Chapter Lead und den anderen Staff Engineers definierst du das technische Zielbild des Chapters, legst Standards fest und setzt Technologie-Prioritäten. Bei kritischen Projekten bist du zudem fachliche Eskalationsinstanz für Team Leads und Entwickler:innen
Du gibst dein Wissen weiter – durch Schulungen, Reviews und technische Austauschformate für die Teams

Dein Profil

Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung als Senior oder Lead Engineer in der Entwicklung komplexer Webanwendungen mit
Fundierte Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony gehören ebenso zu deinem Profil wie die Erfahrung, Anwendungen über mehrere Jahre hinweg weiterzuentwickeln und zu verantworten. Dabei denkst du full-stack, vom Datenmodell über die Schnittstelle bis ins Frontend (z. B. Node.js, TypeScript, React)
Du hast bereits projektübergreifend wiederverwendbare Bausteine entwickelt – Basis-Setups, Bundles, geteilte Bibliotheken und wiederkehrende Module
Mit CI/CD, Container-Umgebungen und dem Betrieb in der Cloud (z. B. AWS, GCP oder Azure) kennst du dich aus und triffst hier Architekturentscheidungen mit, ohne den operativen Betrieb zu übernehmen
AI-gestützte Entwicklung und agentische Workflows sind fester Bestandteil deines Arbeitsalltags
Du überzeugst durch Argumente statt durch Hierarchie: Du bindest Team Leads und Entwickler:innen frühzeitig ein, begründest deine Vorschläge nachvollziehbar und passt sie an, wenn gute Gegenargumente vorliegen. Technische Zusammenhänge erklärst du sowohl Kund:innen als auch der Geschäftsführung verständlich, und es liegt dir daran, andere fachlich weiterzubringen
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und gute Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab und ermöglichen dir die sichere Kommunikation mit deutschsprachigen Kund:innen
Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Erfahrung mit Pimcore oder in einer Digitalagentur mit

Warum wir?

Ein dynamisches und anspruchsvolles Agentur-Umfeld mit vielfältigen Herausforderungen und einem interessanten Kundenmix
Mitarbeit in einem agilen und fokussierten Team
Eine abwechslungsreiche und selbstständige Tätigkeit mit flachen Hierarchien und gegenseitigem Vertrauen
Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit der Wahl zwischen hybrid oder full remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Spaniens oder Österreichs
Standorte in München, Traunstein, Barcelona und Wien
Flexible Arbeitszeiten (kinderfreundlich und garantiert ohne Wochenenddienst)
Legendäre Teamevents

Über uns

Wir sind die Digitalagentur mit Full-Service-Charakter mit Standorten in München, Traunstein, Barcelona und Wien. Bereits seit 2007 konzipieren, designen und programmieren wir individuelle Websiteprojekte, entwerfen anspruchsvolle Designs, entwickeln erfolgreiche Werbekampagnen und vieles mehr für unsere Kunden. Dabei bieten wir nicht nur für unsere Kunden individuelle Lösungen - auch unser Team profitiert davon. aktive Teilnahme an Code Reviews als technischer Austausch

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Desktop/SDK)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online.

Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton today supports over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. Proton has become profitable and reached scale without relying upon VC funding, largely due to superior talent that allows us to do things faster, more creatively, and more efficiently.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. Tired of blending into the crowd? Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our social media pages
to learn more about us: Twitter, Reddit, Instagram.

The role:

You will be responsible for designing, building, maintaining and evolving the sync SDK powering Proton Drive's desktop applications. This includes not only building the application internals (managing and syncing local and remote state, performing cryptographic operations, etc) but also helping us to build resilient, scalable applications (graceful degradation; log and metrics streams free of personally identifiable information). You will be involved in the entire application lifecycle, but with a strong focus on the internals shared amongst our desktop applications, including Gitlab configuration, deployments, monitoring and alerting, and operational incident response. While this position is not a "full-stack" position, you will be expected to collaborate with backend engineers to drive any necessary changes and/or new features needed for the core of our desktop experience.

What you will do:

Be part of a small team working to bring a "privacy by default" solution to our Drive clients on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Develop applications that delight a wide range of users, from layperson to technical, and gives confidence that their online privacy is in good hands - while getting the complexity of end-to-end encryption out of the way.
Invest in test automation to improve the team's productivity and software delivery cadence.
Think critically on how to divide problems into iterations of simpler, composable solutions. Re-evaluate the minimum scope as necessary to meet objectives on-time.
Insist on high standards for application monitoring and alerting, in order to ensure a smooth customer experience at all times.

We are looking for:

Strong experience in .NET development
Strong experience with concurrent multi-threaded programming
Optional experience building and maintaining desktop applications
Working knowledge of file systems
Working knowledge of Git
Bachelor's or master’s degree in a relevant field of study
Experience with owning and maintaining large software components
Experience with gradual rollouts and metrics/monitoring/alerting frameworks

Even if you don’t meet all the requirements listed above, but feel you could still be a great fit, please still apply.

What We Offer

Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office.
Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.
Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page .

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | API Enterprise | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the API Enterprise
team. We sit at the intersection of DeepL's API platform and our Enterprise ecosystem. Whereas the Core team obsesses over the self-service developer journey, our focus is on enterprise customer adoption: the usage insights, cost controls, RBAC , compliance, and data residency capabilities that enterprise IT and security teams depend on. We work hand-in-hand with a wide set of stakeholder teams to make DeepL's API the obvious and safe choice for global enterprises.

We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries
— builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your Responsibilities

Drive Enterprise API Adoption: You will own the features that turn enterprise interest into deep, durable adoption. Examples include usage insights, cost and consumption controls, and the governance tooling that lets large organizations understand and manage how they use DeepL's APIs
Build for Governance & Compliance: You will design the controls enterprise IT and security admins rely on (roles and permissions, projects, data residency, and audit-ability), making DeepL the compliant default for regulated, global organizations
Guardianship of Quality & Production Reliability: You will own your services end-to-end, including participation in the API on-call rotation, with a shared goal of taking our public API to four nines of reliability. You will implement strong contract testing, monitoring, and SLOs, preventing breaking changes and security vulnerabilities before they reach our enterprise customers
Architect Across the Enterprise Ecosystem: You will work deep within DeepL's existing technical and organizational structures, navigating dependencies across different areas and many stakeholder teams to ship cohesive, reliable enterprise capabilities

Qualities we look for

An "Enterprise-First" Mindset: You treat enterprise IT and security admins as your primary users. You understand that earning their trust means clear governance, predictable cost control, robust compliance, fast response times and data residency. You're a strong communicator who's comfortable owning product decisions and implementing them
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and distributed architectures, primarily in C# / .NET, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong API design fundamentals and system design are core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/TypeScript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement
Enterprise Platform Fluency: You bring hands-on experience with the building blocks of modern enterprise APIs (MCP, CLIs, and OAuth) and know how to wield them to build secure, extensible integrations
Cross-Team Leadership: You have a track record of leading projects across multiple teams. You can align with different areas and other stakeholders, manage cross-team contracts and dependencies, and keep complex, interconnected systems coherent
Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, learn from incidents, and treat mature SLOs as a core engineering feature
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery so you can focus your energy on high-value architecture and complex problem-solving
Bonus points if you have: a track record of zero-downtime migrations on live systems; experience with metering, quota, or usage-data systems; worked in a compliance environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, C5, or similar)

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Description

At Xe, we live currencies. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our Currency Converter, Market Analysis, Currency Data API and quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. We leverage technology to deliver these services through our website, mobile app and by phone. Last year, we helped over 300 million people access information about the currencies that matter to them and over 225,000 people used us to send money overseas.

About This Role

We're hiring a senior back-end engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and lead delivery of new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small team with direct access to product, compliance, and operations, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain decisions.

OUR PRINCIPLES

AMBITION - We dream big, try things out and always ask “why not?” and “what if?” We’re ambitious in our thinking and our delivery
RESPONSIBILITY - We get involved, bring our perspective, and are always open to new ideas. We take personal responsibility
COMMUNITY - We value a sense of belonging, trusting each other and encouraging authenticity. We contribute to our community

Roles & Responsibilities

Design and own backend services that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
Lead cross-functional delivery with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.
Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level engineers.
Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

Position Requirements

6 to 10+ years building production backend services, end-to-end.
Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
SQL and relational database fundamentals.
Writing and maintaining tests.
Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
Production experience with AWS, including hands-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
