Client Suppoort Engineer

London, Belfast or Lisbon - hybrid working

Intapp is looking for a Client Support Engineer to join our Client Success & Support team. This is a technical, client-facing role focused on the investigation and resolution of issues across Intapp Time — our time capture and management platform — in both cloud and on-premise environments.

What you'll do

Own investigation, triage, and resolution of client-reported issues across Intapp Profitability, with a primary focus on Intapp Time in cloud and on-premise environments.

Diagnose issues across the Intapp Time ecosystem, including the web application, Admin, Desktop, Desktop Extension, Mobile, Capture, tenant configuration, and identity and access management.

Investigate common support scenarios such as time-entry and submission failures, missing client or matter data, validation and synchronisation issues, performance problems, login failures, and integration errors.

Use logs, error messages, configuration, browser diagnostics, API responses, and client-provided evidence to isolate root cause and distinguish product defects from configuration, data, network, or environmental issues.

Troubleshoot integrations between Intapp Time and clients' practice-management or financial-management systems using SQL, stored procedures, SOAP/REST APIs, data mappings, service accounts, and integration logs.

Support issues involving Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi) and Intapp Integrate, including schedules, connectors, mappings, credentials, queues, and process reporting.

Apply impact-based triage and prioritisation, taking account of production availability, affected users, business impact, and service-level expectations, and act promptly on high-priority or widespread issues.

Provide accurate, timely, and technically clear updates to client contacts, translating complex findings into practical next steps and maintaining ownership through to resolution.

Prepare complete escalation packages for product defects, including business impact, diagnostic evidence, steps to reproduce, and relevant logs.

Recognise when a request falls outside break-fix support and route it to the appropriate team while maintaining a smooth client handover.

Maintain accurate, audit-ready ticket records and contribute to knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides that improve consistency and time to resolution.

What you'll need

2+ years' experience supporting enterprise SaaS and/or on-premise software in a client-facing technical support or application support role.

Experience supporting integrations between enterprise business applications.

Practical experience with ticketing systems and support workflows, including impact-based prioritisation, SLA management, and accurate technical documentation.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex symptoms, interpret logs, and identify root cause.

Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL; Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL experience is highly desirable.

Working knowledge of SOAP and REST APIs, HTTP, authentication, JSON/XML payloads, and common integration or connectivity issues.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical client contacts.

A strong sense of ownership and client responsibility, with the ability to work independently, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and exercise sound judgement on when to escalate.

A genuine interest in using AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of support work; hands-on experience applying AI in a support or technical environment is an advantage.

Desirable

Experience supporting Intapp Time, other Intapp Profitability products, Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi), or Intapp Integrate.

Experience integrating time or billing applications with legal practice-management or financial-management systems such as Aderant, Elite/3E, or Carpe Diem.

Understanding of synchronisation, data mapping, scheduled jobs, and source-of-truth concepts in integrated enterprise applications.

Familiarity with Microsoft technologies such as .NET, Internet Information Services (IIS), Windows Server, PowerShell, or SQL Server, or relevant Microsoft, .NET, or SQL certification.

Experience with enterprise connectivity troubleshooting, including DNS, proxies, TLS certificates, firewall rules, load balancers, or network tracing tools such as Wireshark or Fiddler.

Experience with identity and access technologies such as SSO, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, or Microsoft Entra ID.

Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or browser developer tools.

Experience creating knowledge-base content or support procedures that reduce recurring issues and improve resolution quality.

What you'll gain

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible, where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities.

Expand your skills

Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.

Enjoy where you work

Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energised throughout the day.

Support what matters most

Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time-off programmes and benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation-matching programme for the causes you care about.

Join us and be part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued and your professional growth is a priority.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.

Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills

Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Enterprise | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Business Acceleration Track (BAT)
. This is the engine room of DeepL’s global growth. While our Research teams build the models, BAT builds the Revenue Flywheel
that allows 200,000+ Enterprises (like the Fortune 500) to actually use and pay for them at scale .

We are moving upmarket. We are transitioning from a consumer-focused app to a mission-critical Enterprise Platform. You will be part of the team architecting the "Financial Nervous System" of DeepL — handling everything from Identity & Access Management (SSO, SCIM) to complex multi-seat Subscription Architectures and Fraud Prevention .

We don't hire engineers to just implement UI tickets. We hire Missionaries
who understand that a perfect AI model is useless if a Global Enterprise can't provision it securely to 50,000 employees. You will own the full vertical: from the user-facing Admin Console in React to the distributed billing logic in C#/.NET.

Your Responsibilities

Architect Revenue-Critical Flows: You will design and ship complex, high-stakes features like "Enterprise Licensing" or "Automated Seat Provisioning." You ensure that when a customer upgrades, the UX is instant, and the billing ledger is immutable.
Own the "Enterprise Experience": You will build the tools that empower CIOs and IT Directors to manage DeepL. You translate complex backend constraints (RBAC, Rate Limits) into simple, elegant UI workflows.
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You work directly with Sales, Product, and Finance to translate "Annual Recurring Revenue" goals into scalable technical architectures .
Drive System Reliability: You understand that billing systems cannot fail. You build for idempotency and resilience, ensuring that our financial data is auditable and flawless, while maintaining a high-velocity frontend experience.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.
Full-Stack Fluency: You are comfortable traversing the stack. You can design a React component for an Admin Dashboard in the morning and debug a distributed transaction in the backend in the afternoon.
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS—Identity (SAML/SSO), Monetization, and Compliance. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .
High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.description:
Location
: Rzeszów (remote/hybrid options available)
Salary
: 13-20K PLN gross per month – Umowa o Pracę
Job Type
: Full-Time, Permanent

Are you looking to make your mark in a developer-centric and technology-focused software company? NewOrbit are looking for skilful software engineers wanting to expand their experience and be a central part of our exciting and growing team.

About Us NewOrbit Poland is a sister company of NewOrbit, a successful, innovative UK-based business that has been delivering software for nearly 15 years. We are a skilled and close-knit team, who work together to deliver entirely bespoke, highly-scalable, cloud-hosted web applications for our clients. We collaborate with a wide variety of clients, which means you gain exposure to lots of different industries - and challenges to solve.
Our stack is typically React
, . NET
, and Azure SQL Server
or Cosmos DB
, but expect variations on that as NewOrbit host everything on Azure
using a wide range of the available technologies. We’re a Microsoft Solutions Partner
, working very closely with Microsoft, including on new Azure technologies before they are released to the general public.

Candidate Requirements Our ideal candidate is someone with breadth, including C#
, TypeScript
, HTML/CSS
, and SQL
. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them, but you do need some full-stack experience. Ideally, you’ll have had some exposure to distributed system design and the full life-cycle of software development.
You will be comfortable estimating and designing features, and communicating with others. For a more senior role, you’ll need experience in technical leadership. There’s no staff management required for this role, but if that’s your one of your career goals then we have opportunities for that too.
NewOrbit use Agile
software development methods, so you should understand these approaches. If you’ve done Scrum that’s ideal, but an Agile mindset is more important.
Although not essential for the role, some test automation experience (e.g. test architecture, CI/CD) would be advantageous.

Overview of Responsibilities Working as part of a small project team where everyone is involved in the planning and execution of work.
Producing clean code to agreed timescales and quality.
Owning features and delivering them with minimal supervision.
Reviewing and submitting pull requests.
Handing over features for acceptance testing.
Owning or contributing to technical design and architecture.

For more senior candidates you would also be:
Leading a small project team of developers, you would be working alongside a project manager and product owner, but still very ‘hands-on’ and in code day-to-day.
Mentoring other members of the development team.
Assessing new technologies and patterns.
Helping us to interview potential candidates for the team.

Why NewOrbit? Being part of NewOrbit is much more than just a salary and holiday allowance (although those are important too!). Your package will include the following benefits, so you can share in our success:
Hybrid and remote working options – expect to visit our offices occasionally, ideally weekly. But let us know if you need more — or less!
Profit share scheme (discretionary)
Private LuxMed healthcare
MultiSport card co-financing
A friendly environment full of fellow enthusiasts:
Meals out
Activity days & retreat weekends
Outdoor activities

Work with us to: Enjoy what you do
: We hire smart people who share our drive and are genuinely proud of our team. We do projects that we believe in and aren’t afraid to challenge clients (and say no). We get our work done and go home - there’s no late-night working culture here.
Grow your career
: Our supportive environment and clear career paths help you thrive. NewOrbit provide access to Pluralsight and Frontend Masters on-demand training and share knowledge within the team through tech talks & coding sessions. We can also provide you with time or learning resources to get Azure certified.
Stay interested
: We welcome innovation and stay at the forefront, actively encouraging side projects and experimentation. We provide you with monthly Azure credits that you can use for whatever you like.
Have an impact
: Our driver is to make a positive difference to our clients and the team, so we look for people who own problems and feel personal pride in what they do. We rely on everyone in the team to look outwards and help decide and drive our technical strategy. If you think there’s something we can do better, we’ll listen.

Application Process Interested?
Please send your CV and any useful links you might have (Stack Overflow, GitHub, open source projects) to recruitment@neworbit.pl.
The next step would be a short 10-15 minute telephone call to have a quick chat about what you are interested in and your past experience.
You will then be invited to complete a programming exercise at your own pace via TestDome – typically around an hour of coding, done whenever suits you best.
If the exercise goes well, we’ll invite you for a final conversation with one of our team – around an hour to dig into your experience, values, and of course an opportunity for you to ask us questions. You will then get feedback on our decision either way – and we might even make you an offer there and then!

We look forward to hearing from you.

Please note: This role is Poland based and candidates are required to have the legal right to work in the Poland for employment.
A background check (including criminal records check and references) is required for this role.
NewOrbit are committed to a safe work environment that supports and respects equality, diversity and inclusion within our team.

jobs.description:
W firmie ABB
pomagamy przedsiębiorstwom działać sprawniej i czyściej – i każdy człowiek w naszej firmie się do tego przyczynia. Będziesz mieć możliwość przewodzenia, otrzymasz wsparcie w rozwoju i poczujesz dumę z wpływu, jaki wspólnie wywieramy. Dołącz do nas i pomóż zarządzać tym, co napędza świat.

Stanowisko To Podlega

Innovation Enablement Manager

__

As a Sales Configurator Product Modeler / Developer you will be a member of a team developing and maintaining sales configurators solutions supporting the operations and customers of ABB Electrification (EL) - Distribution Solution (ELDS) and Service (ELSE). You will be working in a cross-functional team which operates in an international environment.

In this role you will be responsible for the modelling and maintenance of distribution systems and service products (switchgears, grid components and service offering ) in the new global ELDS/SE sales configurator platform(s). You will closely collaborate with product sales configurators, portfolio managers and engineers to design, implement, test and troubleshoot the product models. Together with the internal ABB IS and Business Teams you will have unique opportunity to learn the product portfolio and based on that design and deliver the future platform ensuring it meets the needs of our customers and sales team

The work model for the role is: #hybrid;

You Will Be Mainly Accountable For

Design, implement, test, and troubleshoot product models for ELDS and ELSE.
Develop the product models as defined by the Product Managers / Sales Configurators Portfolio Managers and Engineers. Ensure product models are well-structured to enable high quality change management and simplify the future maintenance
Collaborate with relevant IS and Business stakeholders to deliver a user-friendly and efficient Sales Configurator solution.
Work closely with the platform supplier / implementation partner to ensure the integrity of the product model is guaranteed as the platform evolves.
Provide technical support, troubleshooting and fixing issues reported by users.
Contribute to the overall sales configurator development process

Qualifications For The Role

You are highly skilled in product modelling and configuration within sales configurator tools and enjoy working in the industrial technology and engineering sector
You have established experience in the software development lifecycle, including working with tools such as Azure DevOps
You possess solid expertise in programming languages such as .NET, Python, Java, or similar technologies
You are highly adept in configurator platforms, with experience in Configit ACE considered an advantage
You are passionate about teamwork and collaboration, while also demonstrating a proactive, solution-oriented, and independent working style
You are resilient in agile, fast-paced environments and are motivated by continuous learning and development
You have proven experience or a strong understanding of industrial product portfolios; knowledge of ABB’s DS and SE Division portfolio is considered a plus

Aby zbudować czystszą, mądrzejszą przyszłość, potrzebne są różne umysły: ciekawe, odważne i kreatywne. Dlatego witamy ludzi z każdego środowiska i o różnych doświadczeniach.

, aby dowiedzieć się więcej o wpływie naszych rozwiązań na całym świecie.

identifying architecture patterns, develop guidelines, reference and solution architectures and anchor these in the Ørsted’s Network Product Line

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As our next Staff Software Engineer
, you won’t just be writing code—you’ll be the high-impact catalyst at the heart of our Kraków Hub, forcing clarity and raising the bar for engineering excellence across the entire ActiveCampaign platform. You will sit at the epicenter of our AI-first transformation
, architecting agentic workflows that redefine marketing automation while simultaneously pioneering AI-assisted development practices that accelerate every team around you.

This isn’t a role for someone who waits for a roadmap; it’s for a technical visionary who takes extreme ownership of the platform’s performance, scalability, and future trajectory. Whether you are embedding in a squad to unblock a complex AI integration or advising leadership on cross-cutting architectural debt, your influence will be the force multiplier
that ensures our Kraków Hub remains a powerhouse of innovation. This is your opportunity to shape the direction of a world-class SaaS platform and see your contributions directly impact the way millions of users engage with intelligent automation

On a Typical Day, You Might

Drive technical direction across multiple Kraków Hub teams, acting as a strategic advisor or embedding directly into squads when technical complexity demands a master-level touch.
Architect scalable agentic AI features, ensuring autonomous workflows and LLM integrations across platform subsystems—from CRM to email automation—are reliable and maintainable at scale.
Identify and resolve platform-wide bottlenecks with a whole-system perspective, optimizing everything from frontend rendering in React/Ember to deep backend logic in PHP and Python.
Champion AI-assisted engineering practices, leading the evaluation and adoption of cutting-edge tools (like Copilot, Cursor, or Devin) to transform how our internal teams build and test software.
Mentor and grow the next generation of talent, using pairing and code reviews to foster a culture of high ownership and technical rigor within the hub.
Bridge the gap between strategy and execution, articulating the basis for technical decisions to both engineers and leadership to balance business speed with long-term architectural health.

The Ideal Candidate Will Bring

8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of delivering high-impact results across multiple product areas or complex SaaS systems.
Multi-stack mastery with deep production experience in PHP and modern backend technologies, complemented by a strong competency in React or Ember.
Proven expertise in AI and Agentic development, including real-world experience designing autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration, or deep LLM integrations.
The ability to act as a technical advisor, earning trust across the organization through sound judgment, clear architectural documentation, and a "whole-system" ownership mindset.
Experience in high-growth SaaS environments, ideally within the marketing automation or CRM domain, with a solid understanding of AWS, CI/CD, and observability at scale.
A working knowledge of Python for AI services and experience with data stores like MySQL, DynamoDB, or Redis at scale.
Fluency in English (B2 minimum) and the flexibility to collaborate effectively across time zones, specifically overlapping with US Central time.
Familiarity with emerging AI standards, such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or advanced AI coding assistants.

This is an exciting time to join ActiveCampaign as we build out our new office in Poland. You will be a large part of developing our office culture in this new Krakow hub location.

About ActiveCampaign

ActiveCampaign is the autonomous marketing platform for people at the heart of the action. It empowers teams to automate their campaigns with AI agents that imagine, activate, and validate–freeing them from step-by-step workflows and unlocking limitless ways to orchestrate their marketing.

With AI, goal-based automation, and 1,000+ app integrations, agencies, marketers, and owners can build cross-channel campaigns in minutes–fine-tuned with billions of data points to drive real results for their unique business.

ActiveCampaign is the trusted choice to help businesses unlock a new world of boundless opportunities–where ideas become impact and potential turns into real results.

As a global multicultural company, we are proud of our inclusive culture which embraces diverse voices, backgrounds, and perspectives. We don’t just celebrate our differences, we believe our diversity is what empowers our innovation and success. You can find out more about our DEI initiatives here.

Perks And Benefits

At ActiveCampaign, we prioritize employees’ well-being and professional growth by cultivating a culture centered on collaboration and innovation. When you join our team, you’ll not only have the opportunity to make a significant impact, but also enjoy a range of benefits tailored to support your personal and career development.

Here Are Some Of The Benefits We Offer

Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Top-tier benefits package that includes medical and dental benefits paid 100% by ActiveCampaign for you and 50% for your dependents, and reimbursements on vision expenses. In addition, employees receive complimentary access to telehealth services, and a free subscription to Calm.
Growth & Development: Access to LinkedIn Learning, professional development programs, and career growth opportunities in a fast-growing organization.
Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and take the time you need to maintain work-life balance.
Total Rewards: Pension scheme with matching up to 1.5% of your contribution, MultiSport Plus card to support your active lifestyle, home office stipend to cover your commuter or work from home expenses, and a four-week paid sabbatical with bonus after five years.
Collaborative Culture: Work alongside brilliant, passionate colleagues in an environment that values innovation, teamwork, and mutual support.

ActiveCampaign is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, hire, pay, grow, and promote no matter of gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, marital status, political opinion, national origin, social origin, parentage, workers union membership, economic status, religion, age, health condition, disability or any other grounds protected by law.

Our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) strive to foster a diverse inclusive environment by supporting each other, building a strong sense of belonging, and creating opportunities for mentorship and professional growth for their members.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

About The Role

We're looking for a Software Architect
to join Papaya's central Architects Team
— a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent.

This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch.

If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Lead architectural design across multiple Papaya domains and infrastructure systems, ensuring solutions meet business, scalability, performance, and compliance needs.
Act as a trusted architectural partner to R&D, Product, Security, and DevOps teams — translating business and product requirements into clear technical direction.
Define and maintain high-level architecture across domains, with a focus on seamless integration, maintainability, and long-term evolvability.
Build hands-on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to de-risk architectural decisions, validate new technologies, and demonstrate viable paths forward before broad investment.
Lead technical Due Diligence on third-party vendors, platforms, and integrations — evaluating architecture fit, scalability, security posture, compliance, operational maturity, and long-term cost.
Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently.
Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery.
Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company.
Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects.

Requirements:

Experience & Background

8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems.
12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language.
Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems.
Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Technical depth

Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies.
Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS.
Solid grasp of security fundamentals: encryption, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure coding practices.
Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, and API design using REST and GraphQL.
Practical experience with Git branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.

AI-powered Engineering (required)

Deep, hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI coding tool such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot (Agent Mode), or Codex CLI — used regularly on real, non-trivial work.
Practical fluency with AI productivity tools across the broader workflow: LLM chat assistants for design and review, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, and research.
Ability to design effective context for AI agents — writing good prompts, structuring repos and docs (e.g. CLAUDE.md / rules files) so agents perform well, and knowing when to delegate vs. when to drive manually.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and the broader pattern of connecting AI agents to internal tools, data sources, and services.
Awareness of the security, privacy, IP, and quality risks of AI-assisted development, and opinions on how to mitigate them at an organizational level.
Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities and agent-based components into backend products and workflows is a strong plus.

Ways of working

Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end delivery of complex features — from architecture through production.
Excellent analytical skills and a strong self-learning instinct; comfortable ramping up quickly on unfamiliar domains.
Strong communication and influencing skills — able to align engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders around a technical direction.
Excellent written and verbal English.

In Poland
- Warsaw

We are looking for a dedicated Junior Website Content Administrator to join our global Web Team and support the development and maintenance of our Drupal-based corporate website. The role combines front-end development, content upload and implementation, CMS maintenance and improvements, and day-to-day website operations. You will work closely with the Website team, Global and Regional Campaigns teams, the broader marketing team, and key business stakeholders to translate content requirements into effective web solutions.

The salary for this position ranges from PLN 8 000 to PLN 9 000, depending on the candidate’s relevant experience, skill set, level of expertise and overall fit for the role. Additional factors such as industry background, technical competencies and interview performance may also influence the final offer. The compensation package at Simon-Kucher CBS consists of a gross base salary, a monthly remote work allowance and an annual bonus. The bonus is paid in December and is based on the results of a 360-degree performance evaluation.

Please remember to submit your application in English. Other applications will not be considered. The candidate should have an EU work permit, we do not offer visa for this position.

What Makes Us Special

Become part of a unique entrepreneurial team. Think independently, use your initiative, and take some risks. Entrepreneurship is a powerful force that drives the growth not only of our firm but our clients and people.
Unlock the power of opportunity. Advance your career in a thriving company that creates positive impact. We invest in your professional development every step of the way.
Enjoy balance and flexible working. Be empowered to do your best work – we offer flexible and hybrid working, sabbaticals, and paid time off.
Prioritize your health and wellbeing. No matter where you live, we offer a competitive suite of health benefits to help keep you and your loved ones safe.
Work in a values-driven culture. At Simon-Kucher, our vision is to become the world's leading growth specialist. Our values guide the way we do business and communicate our distinctiveness. They sum up what we stand for, influence our culture, and drive how and why we do things.

How You Will Create An Impact

Support the development and maintenance of our Drupal-based corporate website as part of the global Web Team.
Assist with implementing front-end website components based on Figma designs.
Use HTML and CSS to create and adjust website content, including tables, layouts, and other basic front-end elements.
Set up new webpages and upload, format, and publish written content, charts, tables, and graphics within the CMS.
Edit and update existing webpages in line with business updates or content revisions.
Provide first-level technical support to marketing colleagues regarding website and CMS-related questions.
Help troubleshoot basic website issues and coordinate more complex topics with developers when needed.
Perform regular quality checks (QCs) across the site to identify and fix outdated content, broken links, formatting issues, or design inconsistencies.
Ensure consistency in formatting, branding, and tone across all webpages and follow defined accessibility standards.
Coordinate with content owners, designers, and developers to resolve web issues and support publishing schedules.
Ensure our corporate website remains accurate, current, and aligned with our business needs.
Work closely with the broader marketing team to understand content requirements and translate them into simple, web-friendly formats.
Support the web development team by organizing content submissions, tracking updates, and managing content publishing timelines and day-to-day CMS maintenance.

Your Profile

Minimum 1 year of experience in website content administration, web development, or website operations.
Basic hands-on experience with Drupal is required.
Good basic knowledge of HTML and CSS and an understanding of front-end website structure and accessibility.
Ability to work with Figma designs and translate simple design requirements into website components is an advantage.
Basic understanding of website usability and accessibility principles.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills with a strong attention to detail.
Good problem-solving skills and willingness to support colleagues with basic website and CMS-related issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international environment.
You are fluent in English on a business level (C1).

If you’re interested, and if you’d like to offer your skills and commitment to our international team, then we would be pleased to receive your application.

Hit the ‘Apply Now’ button to begin your application

Simon-Kucher is a global consultancy with more than 2,000 employees in 30 countries. Our sole focus is on unlocking better growth that drives measurable revenue and profit for our clients. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.
Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Company Awards:

Best All-In-One Hotel Management System | HotelTechAwards (2025)
Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025)
Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)
Top 10 People’s Choice (2024)
Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)

Discover our Benefits:

Remote First, Remote Always
PTO in accordance with local labor requirements
Monthly Wellness Fridays - enjoy an extra-long weekend every month
Fully Paid Parental Leave
Home office stipend based on country of residency
Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University
Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling and knowledge transfer

Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion

Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Cloudbeds will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations in the hiring process. We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our HR team by phone at (858) 201-7832 or via email at accommodations@cloudbeds.com. Cloudbeds will provide an American Sign Language (ASL) interpreter where needed as a reasonable accommodation for the hiring process.

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Cloudbeds. Staffing, recruiting agencies, and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit applications, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Cloudbeds does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Cloudbeds employees, or any other company location. Cloudbeds is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

jobs.title: Senior Java Backend Developer
jobs.description:
The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

Mandatory Skills Description:

• Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
• Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
• Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
• Experience building and running containerized applications
• Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
• Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
• Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
• Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
• Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
• Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Microservices architecture and system design
• Messaging and integration technologies: Kafka, IBM MQ, Tibco EMS
• Relational databases: Azure SQL, Oracle, Sybase
• Testing frameworks (unit, integration and E2E testing)
• CI/CD pipelines (GitLab / GitHub)
• Monitoring and observability practices

Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

jobs.title: Erfaren .NET-utvecklare till penningtvätt
jobs.description:
Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom .NET för att utveckla lösningar som spelar en viktig roll i arbetet mot penningtvätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av Team Norrsken i Piteå, ett erfaret och välfungerande team med stort ansvar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och arbeta inom ett område som får allt större betydelse.

Några Anledningar Till Att Välja Rollen

Ett uppdrag med tydligt syfte – du arbetar med lösningar inom bland annat antipenningtvätt och bidrar till utvecklingen av system som möter regulatoriska krav.
Erfarna kollegor nära dig – du blir en del av ett kompetent team med seniora systemutvecklare, teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt och produktägare.
Påverka både lösning och arbetssätt – du får vara delaktig från krav och design till utveckling, test och förvaltning.
Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas – på sikt finns möjligheter att bredda dig mot exempelvis arkitektur, Teamcoach, systemansvar eller systemspecialist.
Gemenskap på kontoret i Piteå – teamet värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet till ett flexibelt hybridarbete.

Vi är 9 personer i teamet som består av systemutvecklare, Scrum Master/Teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt samt systemspecialist. I teamet verkar även från verksamheten en produktägare (PO).

Vi arbetar agilt med dagliga avstämning. Uppgifter och prioriteringar hanteras i Azure DevOps. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor centralt i Piteå. Vi ser ett värde i att arbeta tillsammans på plats, samtidigt som rollen erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete.

Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och förvalta IT-lösningar i C#, .NET och .NET Framework
delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.

Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI-utveckling är meriterande.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om Banken

Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.

Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.

Vårt Erbjudande Inkluderar

Låna: Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.

Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. Behind that journey sits a powerful digital platform enabling everything from checkout and payments to order management, delivery, retail tools, and customer self‑service.

You will join a focused team working across a critical part of the customer journey, building and validating solutions that customers globally and hundreds of internal users depend on every day. With real ownership, close collaboration, and global impact, this role plays a key part in ensuring reliability, performance, and quality across Polestar’s digital ecosystem.

We are now looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join Polestar Digital at our headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Let us describe the challenge we offer

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you will ensure the reliability, performance, and quality of customer‑facing digital products and internal platforms that support the vehicle purchasing journey.

You will work across frontend, backend, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, validating solutions and ensuring that features meet both business and technical requirements before release. Acting as a key partner to Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and Operations teams, you will translate product requirements into effective test strategies and ensure that defects are identified early and resolved efficiently.

The role combines hands‑on testing, automation, and continuous improvement of quality practices, contributing to scalable and high‑quality systems used globally across markets and internal operations. You will also stay up to date with modern QA methodologies and emerging technologies, including AI‑assisted testing approaches.

What you'll do

You will ensure high‑quality delivery across Polestar’s digital platforms by validating solutions, improving test coverage, and driving continuous improvement in quality practices.

Your Responsibilities Include

Ensuring business requirements and acceptance criteria are fulfilled through comprehensive testing of user stories and system workflows
Designing, executing, and maintaining manual and automated tests across frontend, backend, APIs, and integrations
Validating quality, reliability, performance, and security of new platform capabilities and releases
Collaborating with Software Engineers, Technical Leads, Product Managers, and Designers to translate product requirements into effective test strategies
Identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects, while supporting teams in root‑cause analysis and resolution
Contributing to test automation frameworks and improving overall test coverage and development practices
Working closely with cross‑functional agile teams to continuously improve software quality and delivery processes
Monitoring and evaluating quality metrics and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives
Staying up to date with industry best practices, modern QA methodologies, and emerging technologies, including AI‑assisted testing approaches
Documenting test plans, test results, and quality standards across the development lifecycle

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, Technical Leads, and Operations teams, ensuring alignment across technical and business needs while driving quality across the full development lifecycle.

Who you are

You are a structured and analytical quality professional with strong ownership and a proactive approach to ensuring high‑quality outcomes. You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams, and you focus on identifying and resolving issues early to enable smooth and reliable delivery.

You combine hands‑on testing expertise with a continuous improvement mindset and an interest in modern technologies shaping the future of software quality.

To be a great fit for this position, we believe you have:

Strong knowledge and hands‑on experience with Quality Assurance methodologies and software testing principles
Experience testing modern web applications and distributed systems across frontend and backend technologies
Experience with test automation tools and frameworks for UI, API, and integration testing
Understanding of React, TypeScript, .NET (C#), Node.js, APIs, and AWS‑based systems from a testing perspective
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub workflows, and containerized environments
Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and experience working in cross‑functional product teams
Strong analytical, organizational, problem‑solving, and communication skills
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and stakeholders
Experience with commerce, payments, financing, order management, or customer journey platforms is considered an advantage
Atleast 4 years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance

People at Polestar

We know that a change is needed. We also know that each one of us can help bring about that change. Our commitment to becoming climate‑neutral by 2040 is just as important to us as being inclusive, diverse, and innovative.

Together, we are creating, collaborating, and experimenting to usher in a new era of sustainable mobility. We are an electric performance brand, determined to improve the society we live in.

Is this you?

If you are interested in joining the Polestar crew, don’t wait to submit your application. We apply a continuous selection process and the job post will remain open until the position is filled.

As we move through the Swedish summer holiday season, there may be a slight delay in our process. We look forward to getting back to you in August.

Send us your resume along with a short note on what makes this role interesting to you. We read everything.

Are you ready for the journey? Which is electric, by the way…

jobs.title: 1 Systemutvecklare Backend
jobs.description:
2026-09-14

Vill du arbeta med den senaste teknologin och som del av ett scrum-team, med stöd av kompetenta och trevliga kollegor i en kreativ och internationell miljö? Vill du ha en arbetsgivare som satsar på ett hållbart medarbetarskap och erbjuder trygga, förmånliga arbetsvillkor? Välkommen att söka anställning som systemutvecklare på Uppsala universitet.

National Bioinformatics Infrastructure Sweden (NBIS) söker nu ytterligare 1 systemutvecklare. Vi är en nationell infrastruktur vars syfte är att tillhandahålla support för bioinformatiker och forskare inom livsvetenskaperna. Systemutvecklingsgruppen består av två scrumteam som utvecklar verktyg för storskalig datahantering och webbapplikationer för forskargrupper och EU-finansierade projekt, allt inom området bioinformatik.

Att vara en del av ett av våra team ger dig möjlighet att göra skillnad, genom att arbeta i projekt vars mål är att göra forskningsdata säker och delbar. Du kommer att vara anställd vid Uppsala universitet, på Institutionen för cell- och molekylärbiologi (ICM), och vara knuten till NBIS och Science for Life Laboratory (SciLifeLab). Mer information om NBIS finns på https://nbis.se.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som systemutvecklare kommer du att vara ansvarig för utveckling och underhåll av en delningsplattform för mänsklig genomikdata från forskningsprojekt, i samarbete med våra partners i andra europeiska länder. Målet med dessa projekt, som Genomic Data Infrastructure (GDI), är att hjälpa forskare att kunna dela sin data på ett säkert vis, och att på så sätt underlätta deras samarbeten runt mänsklig hälsa och medicin.

Projektet GDI handlar om att möjliggöra säker tillgång till genomiska och kliniska data inom EU, för att kunna förbättra klinisk diagnostik, behandlingar och prediktiv medicin. Bigpicture är ett annat europeiskt flaggskepp som syftar till att bygga en Petabyte plattform för AI inom digital patologi. Våra samarbetspartner kommer från akademin såväl som sjukvården och industrin.

Du kommer arbeta tätt tillsammans med andra utvecklare i ett av våra scrum-team och bidra till de ovan nämnda projekten. Scrum-teamet är ansvarig för produkternas hela livscykel, från planering och utveckling, till driftsättning och underhåll. Du kommer vara del av ett team som värdesätter kreativitet och ser gärna att du är med och påverkar alla beslut inom gruppen.

Kvalifikationskrav

Du som sökande skall minst ha kandidatexamen inom informationsteknik, datateknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller bioinformatik, alternativt motsvarande dokumenterad kompetens inom ett eller flera av dessa områden.

Vidare Krävs

Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i systemutveckling med Python och Java
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Kubernetes med Helm och Hashicorp Vault eller OpenBao
Minst fem års erfarenhet av databaser, t. ex. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet av virtualiseringslösningar och mjukvaru-containrar (t.ex. Docker eller Podman)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git och CI/CD (t. ex. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt enligt scrum och scrum-rollerna certifikat (scrummaster eller produktägare)
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Infrastructure as Code med Terraform och Ansible och ett eller flera molnleverantörer (t. ex. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)
Minst fem års erfarenhet och god förståelse av nätverk (TLS, TCP/UDP, HTTPS, routing)
Att du kan uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet, den sökande ska ha mycket god samarbetsförmåga, initiativförmåga och goda kommunikativa kvaliteter.

Önskvärt/meriterande i övrigt

Följande Räknas Som Meriterande

Vana att arbeta i fysiskt distribuerade team med kommunikation och koordination via elektroniska verktyg som videomöten och liknande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med informationssäkerhet är starkt meriterande
God förståelse av mekanismer för autentisering och auktorisation (t. ex. OAuth, JWT)
Kunskap om bioinformatik, i synnerhet är erfarenhet av verktyg och metoder för analys av human genomikdata särskilt efterfrågat.
Erfarenhet av verktyg för projektmanagement, t. ex. Zenhub, Jira.
Erfarenhet av arbete med infrastruktursystem för känsliga data, speciellt inom den offentliga sektorn eller akademin.

Om anställningen

Anställningen är tillsvidare (provanställning om 6 månader kan tillämpas). Omfattningen är heltid. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort: Uppsala

Upplysningar om anställningen lämnas av:
Chef för systemutveckling Dimitris Bampalikis, dimitrios.bampalikis@nbis.se, +46 72 231 48 19, Vice Chef och Systemutvecklare, Malin Klang, malin.klang@nbis.se, +46 76 249 93 41 eller Avdelningsföreståndare Bengt Persson, bengt.persson@nbis.se.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 2026-09-28, UFV-PA 2026/2709.

Uppsala universitet är ett brett forskningsuniversitet med stark internationell ställning. Det yttersta målet är att bedriva utbildning och forskning av högsta kvalitet och relevans för att göra skillnad i samhället. Vår viktigaste tillgång är alla 7 500 anställda och 53 000 studenter som med nyfikenhet och engagemang gör Uppsala universitet till en av landets mest spännande arbetsplatser.

Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba inom Uppsala universitet

https://uu.se/om-uu/jobba-hos-oss/

Anställningen kan komma att säkerhetsprövas. Vid säkerhetsprövning är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd.

Vi undanber oss erbjudanden om rekryterings- och annonseringshjälp.

Ansökan tas emot i Uppsala universitets rekryteringssystem.

Fackliga företrädare:
Saco-S - saco-s@uu.se, Seko - seko@uadm.uu.se, ST (OFR/S) - ofr@uu.se

jobs.title: Software and Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Join EQT Tech’s Architectural function, where you’ll play a critical role in future-proofing and scaling one of our cross-functional value streams—Fintech.

This is a unique opportunity to design and drive the technology supporting our financial operations — ensuring seamless integrations, efficiency, and innovation. If you're a strategic thinker with a strong technical foundation and a passion for designing scalable systems, we’d love to hear from you.

About The Tech Team – Fintech Value Stream

The Fintech Value Stream strives to improve and automate key financial processes to deliver a best-in-class experience for a broad range of business domains. We’re a cross-functional team collaborating closely with stakeholders across EQT to ensure data and technology strategically support business outcomes. Our team includes tech leads, data professionals, product managers and architects who together shape the future of finance operations through scalable, data-driven solutions.

What You’ll Do

As a Software and Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping EQT’s technical landscape within the Fintech Value Stream. Your primary responsibility will be to collaborate with Tech Leads, Engineers, and external partners to design and implement solutions that drive efficiency and scalability across EQT’s investment technology.

Beyond your work in the Fintech Value Stream, you'll also collaborate closely with peers in the Architecture function to shape EQT Tech's long-term architectural direction, ensuring consistency, reusability, and strategic alignment across value streams.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with tech leads and engineers to support the Fintech Value Stream in new projects & initiatives, engaging in technical discussions with both third-party service providers and internal teams to ensure a structured approach to solution development
Assess the current architecture, team capabilities, and resource allocation to determine the best approach for future implementations
Develop new architectural solutions and enhance existing ones to ensure they are harmonized, scalable, and efficient for all of EQT
Establish technical standards, best practices, and improved ways of working across EQT’s Tech teams
Collaborate with other Value Streams (Investment & Client) and Platform Teams to define interfaces, ownership, and capabilities within the Fintech domain
Design system integrations, ensuring seamless connectivity between internal systems, new external systems, and vendors
Work closely with the Head of Architecture and the Head of Fintech, supporting key strategic initiatives

Who are you?

We’re looking for an experienced Software and Solution Architect with a strong technical foundation and a strategic mindset. You should have a passion for problem-solving, system design, and technical leadership. You likely have 8–12 years of experience across software engineering and architecture, including time spent designing systems in regulated or data-sensitive environments.

Desired Skills & Experience

Strong software engineering background, with hands-on experience designing and maintaining complex, high-availability systems that handle sensitive data
Strong understanding of system integrations, APIs, and data architectures
Proven ability to drive implementation from initial requirements to high-level solution design and progress tracking
Strong leadership and coaching skills, with the confidence to take a firm stance in technical discussions
Excellent communication skills, able to engage effectively with key stakeholders and external partners
Proactive mindset, with a desire to learn, adapt, and drive continuous improvement
Curiosity about applying AI and advanced analytics to drive business value and innovation

Nice-to-haves

Hands-on experience with modern data stacks and frameworks (e.g., dbt, Snowflake, SQL, Fivetran)
Familiarity with financial systems such as Netsuite, Kyriba, Hazeltree, MRI, or Aaro, and BI tools like PowerBI or Hex

What We Offer

A fast-paced and dynamic work environment at a leading global investment firm
The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and develop the future of EQT’s financial tools
A collaborative and inclusive company culture where innovation is encouraged
Regular hackathons, workshops, and learning opportunities to develop new skills
Competitive compensation and benefits package
A vibrant office environment in central Stockholm

Inclusion at
EQT

Our vision for EQT employees is to build high performing & engaged teams. Our competitive edge comes from fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, empowered, and motivated to drive business impact. Our commitment to inclusion is not just about fairness; We understand and believe that being a great place to work drives the best performance.At EQT, inclusion is a business imperative and it's embedded into our talent strategy, decision-making, and culture to ensure that every individual and team operates at their full potential. By doing so, we unlock better collaboration, stronger innovation, and superior investment outcomes.

About EQT

EQT is a purpose-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of over three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start-up to maturity. EQT has EUR ‌ 270 billion in total assets under management (EUR ‌ ‌141 billion in fee-generating assets under management), within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.

With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does. EQT has offices in more than 25 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas and has more than 1,900 employees.

Vi letar efter dig som drivs av att förenkla, standardisera och ta bort manuella moment – och som vill se resultatet av ditt arbete varje dag i den operativa leveransen. Som cloud automation engineer hos oss kommer du att:

Utveckla och förvalta automation för uppsättning av nya kundsystem – från infrastruktur och konfiguration till installation av våra medicinska IT-produkter.

Utveckling av automation och scripting för installation, konfiguration och uppgradering av våra system.

Felsökning och grundorsaksanalys – och att bygga bort problemet så att det inte återkommer.

,
