jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Own the backend services and APIs that turn a customer’s code into a threat model and carry it through to a fix.

Oplane is an always-on security expert for AI-first engineering teams. Our biggest focus today is PR Analysis: every pull request reviewed against the customer’s architectural threat model before it merges, with findings and code-level fixes attached rather than a report handed over. Scanners find patterns. Oplane understands the system. That is where we are now, not where we stop, and we ship new capabilities constantly.

You are a senior hire on that backend. There is a working system with paying enterprise customers on it, so you are not starting from a blank repo, but large parts of it are still the first version that got us here and need someone senior to make them hold at scale.

What you’ll own
The backend services and APIs that turn a customer’s code into a threat model and carry it through to a fix. Design, correctness, and the parts of reliability that live in the application layer.

What the job actually is
· Design and build the core backend. Python services, clean APIs, and the system design behind turning a customer’s code into a threat model and driving the fix. The analysis itself is AI-driven, so a lot of the interesting design is in orchestrating models reliably, not just moving data around. You own real system design here, not tickets handed to you fully specified.
· Build the APIs the product lives or dies by. Oplane only works when it is embedded in a customer’s repos, CI, pull request flow and coding agents. Part of that surface is how external coding agents talk to Oplane and run threat modeling directly. It has to be clean, stable, and hard to break, because other people’s pipelines and agents depend on it.
· Make it hold at enterprise scale. Companies with thousands of engineers, large codebases, concurrent analysis, and a lot of sensitive input passing through. You care about throughput, correct handling of customer code and secrets, and failure modes that do not silently drop a finding.
· Build the agentic way, because we mean it. This is the most agent-native codebase you are likely to have worked in. Our docs are written for coding agents to read, an agent reviews our pull requests, and we are building for a world where agents write most of the code. You will plan with an agent, build with one, and review with one, every day. We grow through agents rather than headcount, and if that reads as a threat to your craft rather than a multiplier of it, this is the wrong team.
· Work close to security. The whole product is about security architecture, and the team lives it, from prompt injection to secure-by-design, as a daily concern rather than an annual audit. You do not have to arrive as a security expert, but security experience is a real plus, and you should want to get good at it, because it is the domain the code is about.

Who this is for
· Around 10 years building backend systems in production. Depth in APIs, data, and system design matters more than any single language, and Python is a plus rather than a requirement.
· You think in architecture. You can hold a whole system in your head, see where it will break, own the design calls other people build on, and reason about a service end to end from data model to failure behavior.
· You can read what an AI agent produces and judge it. A lot of the code here is agent-written, and we need the architectural judgment to catch what it gets subtly wrong and steer it, rather than rubber-stamp it.
· You already use coding agents seriously in your own work and have opinions about where they help and where they do not. If you have not tried, this is the wrong team.
· Security experience is a strong plus. AppSec, secure design, working on a security product, or having been the person who reviewed everyone else’s threat model.
· Startup or scale-up background.
· Working language is English.

What you get
· A product with paying enterprise customers already running on the code you will own, so your work ships to real usage from week one. Teams like Miro, Tandem Health, Remotive Labs and Lightbringer already run Oplane, and we are SOC 2 certified.
· Real ownership of the backend, working directly with the founders.
· Backed by Seed Capital and Icebreaker.vc, with angel investors from Neo4j and Google, including Emil Eifrem. $5.2M seed.
· Based at our Malmö office, on-site five days a week. This is an in-person engineering team by design, not a distributed one.

How we work
Small team, ten of us today, real autonomy, and nothing between deciding something and doing it. We are honest about what is hard, including in this ad. We grow through agents rather than headcount, so the job is always to build the system that does the work rather than do the work by hand forever. Nobody here asks permission first. If you see it, do it, and tell us afterwards.

How to apply
Apply through the form on our site: https://www.oplane.com/careers/senior-backend-engineer
Use the Apply button on this post, which takes you there. We do not take applications through LinkedIn messages.

Tell us about a system you designed and one decision in it you would make differently now. Point us at code if you can.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Experienced Backend System Developer, Lund

Job Description

Do you want to build backend services that make a real difference for users around the world? We are looking for an Experienced Backend System Developer to join our User Services team in Lund, Sweden — a role where you will develop, maintain and evolve the services our users rely on every day.

Who is your future team?

You will join our User Services team
in Lund. We are a team where architectural decisions are made together with our most senior developers — but where everyone is part of the conversation, and everyone's voice is heard. We work closely together, we are humble towards each other, and there is no blame game here. We are looking for someone who brings that extra drive and who dares to challenge the rest of us.

What You'll Do Here As Experienced Backend System Developer

As a Backend System Developer with us, you are not just writing code — you are building the services that make a smarter, safer world work in practice. A key part of the role is learning the domain in depth, so you understand how what you build today affects everything around it tomorrow.

Develop new functionality in our backend services
Maintain and further develop existing software code
Configure and adapt existing systems
Build and continuously deepen your understanding of the domain
Contribute actively to the team's technical discussions and decisions
Take long-term responsibility for the quality and sustainability of the solutions you build

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who translates knowledge and experience into action. You have a strong willingness and ability to keep developing and improving — both yourself and the things you build. You are driven, you respect deadlines, and you are humble towards your colleagues. You see the long-term perspective in your work and understand how your part fits into the bigger picture. And you bring the kind of energy that lifts a whole team.

We'd love to hear that you have:

Solid experience working with Java and Spring
Experience developing and working with REST APIs
Experience working with some form of authentication
Fluency in English, both spoken and written
A relevant education in software development — or equivalent professional experience

Bonus points for:

Working knowledge of OAuth2 and OIDC — this can be a deciding factor, but it is also something you can learn with us
Working knowledge of Swedish — it makes everyday life easier, but it is not a requirement
Working knowledge of AWS.
Working knowledge of Git, Github Actions.
Knowledge of working in Linux.
Knowledge of another programming language such as Python.

What Axis Has To Offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide.

In this role you will grow with us. You will take on greater responsibility over time and build a broad internal network — a natural path towards a more senior role such as Tech Lead or Product Owner.

Curious to discover more?

We have a host of places where you can learn more about Axis, our products, solutions, company culture, and what working at Axis is really like.

Check out:

Life at Axis blog 

Engineering at Axis blog 

Innovation at Axis 

Ready to Act?

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

We go through applications continuously so don't wait – send in your application today!

In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Stefan Liljestrand at stefan.liljestrand@axis.com.

Type of Employment

Permanent Employment

Posting End Date

2026-09-22

Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments. Notice will be provided before we take any action.

About Axis Communications

We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.

With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working.

jobs.title: Cloud Network Architect till VING
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens nätverksarkitektur i ett av Nordens mest välkända reseföretag? Trivs du i en roll där du får kombinera strategiskt inflytande med tekniskt hands-on arbete och samtidigt driva utvecklingen av moderna cloudlösningar? Då kan det här vara möjligheten du har väntat på.

OM ROLLEN

Som Cloud Network Architect hos Ving får du en central roll i företagets fortsatta transformation mot en molnbaserad och framtidssäkrad infrastruktur. Du ansvarar för att utveckla och forma nätverksarkitekturen med fokus på Azure, Cloud Networking och säker, skalbar kommunikation mellan verksamhetens plattformar och tjänster.

Rollen kombinerar arkitekturansvar med operativt arbete. Du driver tekniska initiativ, tar fram målarkitekturer och roadmaps samt omsätter idéer till lösningar i produktion. Samtidigt fungerar du som teknisk rådgivare och samarbetar nära utvecklingsteam, cloudspecialister, arkitekter och externa partners för att säkerställa att vår nätverksmiljö utvecklas i linje med bolagets cloudstrategi.

Här erbjuds du stort mandat, hög teknisk mognad och möjligheten att påverka framtida teknikval i en internationell verksamhet där innovation och utveckling står högt på agendan.

DIN PROFIL

Vi Tror Att Du Har

Djup kompetens inom Microsoft Azure och Azure Networking (VNET, Hub & Spoke-arkitektur, VWAN, NSG, Private Link & Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall)
Djup kompetens inom WAN och Hybrid Connectivity (WAN-design, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, BGP, Private Link, Private Endpoint)
Erfarenhet av Cloud Architecture & Governance
Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Bicep eller Terraform
Erfarenhet av Cloud Security och moderna säkerhetsprinciper (Zero Trust)
Vana av att samarbeta med utvecklingsteam och DevOps-miljöer
Har erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt
Relevant högskoleutbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kompetens

Meriterande Om Du Även Har

Erfarenhet av Datacenter & Enterprise Networking
Är certifierad inom IT arkitektur (ex. TOGAF, COBIT)
Azure-certifieringar (t.ex. AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-700)

Som person är du engagerad, nyfiken och ansvarstagande. Du motiveras av att driva teknisk utveckling framåt och tycker om att omsätta strategier till konkreta resultat. Du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att skapa förtroende hos både tekniska och affärsnära intressenter. Dessutom är du prestigelös i ditt samarbete och trivs i en kultur där kunskapsdelning, initiativförmåga och laganda värdesätts högt.

OM ORGANISATIONEN

Ving är en del av Nordic Leisure Travel Group (NLTG) som säljer resor från Sverige, Danmark, Norge och Finland. I gruppen ingår researrangörerna Ving Sverige, Ving Norge, Globetrotter, Spies i Danmark, Tjäreborg i Finland, flygbolaget Sunclass Airlines samt våra egna hotellkoncept Sunwing Family Resorts, Ocean Beach Club och Sunprime Hotels. Gruppen säljer ett normalt år runt 1 250 000 resor i de nordiska länderna.

Vi erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande miljö där du får möjlighet till en intern karriär. Du får en omväxlande vardag tillsammans med härliga kollegor - vi arbetar i nära samarbete mellan de nordiska länderna för att ge våra gäster de bästa veckorna på året. Vi har dessutom ett högt medarbetarengagemang som år efter år visar sig i vår interna medarbetarundersökning. Vi älskar vårt jobb och välkomnar dig ombord på vår resa i Nordic Leisure Travel Group!

DIN ANSÖKAN

I denna rekrytering samarbetar NLTG
med Wise.

Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail, utan du söker enkelt med ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil på wise.se
. Vi använder kompetensbaserad rekrytering som metod. Det gör vi i vår strävan efter en mer potentialbaserad matchning. Vi ser därför gärna sökanden med olika bakgrunder, åldrar och erfarenheter, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och gör oss bättre och smartare som organisation.

Har du frågor om processen eller rollen? Kontakta då ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Anja Widell,
anja.widell@wise.se
.
Vi intervjuar löpande så rollen kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. Innan ett beslut om anställning fattas kommer en bakgrundskontroll att genomföras.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.description:
About the company
A specialist in identity, secure transactions, and digital services, IN Groupe is the global leader in secure identity and trust services. Every day, our 4,000 employees across 40 countries work to ensure that everyone has access to a reliable and secure identity, both in the physical and digital worlds. With our solutions and our international network of 10 R&D centers, we support governments and businesses in more than 130 countries.
Joining IN Groupe means helping to shape the future of the identity and secure transaction market. Become part of our international teams — driven by innovation and proud to design solutions that make life easier and protect personal data for millions of people around the world.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior backend engineer
to join our Stockholm office with strong, hands‑on expertise in modern Java, experienced in building and maintaining distributed systems and microservices. Brings solid proficiency in CI/CD and Azure DevOps (or comparable platforms), along with practical knowledge of cloud environments, containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, automated testing practices, and operating services reliably in production.

Main responsibilities

•Focus on backend development
, with responsibility for services, databases, and system integrations.
• Develop, improve, and maintain services with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
• Select and use technologies based on problem-solving value, not trendiness.
• Ensure that deliveries are on time and secure, always balancing speed with quality.
• Collaborate closely with teammates and stakeholders, enabling fast and sustainable delivery.
• Over time, take a leading role in driving improvements in both technology and ways of working.
Our Tech Stack (key areas for this role)
• Java (primary language: deep expertise required)

• Spring Boot

• REST, Microservices, Databases

• Azure (cloud environment), Docker, Kubernetes

About you

• Highly experienced in backend Java development and proficient with Azure.
• Results-oriented: you deliver what is needed, when it is needed.
• Pragmatic: you enjoy new technology but choose what best solves the current problem while limiting technical debt.
• Humble and grounded: you listen, collaborate, and keep the team's health in mind.
• Independent yet collaborative: you take initiative but thrive in teamwork.
• User-focused: the end user's experience is always your guiding star.
Qualifications
• Extensive experience in Java backend development (main requirement).
• Experience with Spring Boot and modern development practices.
• Solid understanding of Microservices and integrations.
• Professional proficiency in English.

What we offer

• Impactful work: Your code directly powers secure identity services used by real customers worldwide.
• A pragmatic environment: We value smart choices over shiny tools. You'll use the most adapted technologies to solve problems, reduce complexity, and limit future technical debt.
• A healthy team culture: We believe in humility, collaboration, and keeping team well-being in balance with delivery goals.
• End-to-end responsibility: You'll see the whole lifecycle, from development through deployment to customer use.
• Growth into leadership: Over time, you'll have the opportunity to take on a bigger role in driving initiatives and supporting others in the team.

jobs.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
jobs.description:
SMBC Group is a top-tier global financial group. Headquartered in Tokyo and with a 400-year history, SMBC Group offers a diverse range of financial services, including banking, leasing, securities, credit cards, and consumer finance. The Group has more than 130 offices and 80,000 employees worldwide in nearly 40 countries. Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. (SMFG) is the holding company of SMBC Group, which is one of the three largest banking groups in Japan. SMFG’s shares trade on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and New York (NYSE: SMFG) stock exchanges.

In the Americas, SMBC Group has a presence in the US, Canada, Ireland, Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, and Peru. Backed by the capital strength of SMBC Group and the value of its relationships in Asia, the Group offers a range of commercial and investment banking services to its corporate, institutional, and municipal clients. It connects a diverse client base to local markets and the organization’s extensive global network. The Group’s operating companies in the Americas include Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp. (SMBC), SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc., SMBC Capital Markets, Inc., SMBC MANUBANK, JRI America, Inc., SMBC Leasing and Finance, Inc., Banco Sumitomo Mitsui Brasileiro S.A., and Sumitomo Mitsui Finance and Leasing Co., Ltd.

This is a hybrid role, requiring the successful candidate to attend our Tralee office.

Role Description

SMBC is seeking a Full Stack .NET Developer to join its Development team in Tralee. The team develops and supports strategic and tactical applications that enable critical business processes across the organisation.

The successful candidate will have hands-on experience across the full technology stack, including web applications, user interfaces, backend services, REST APIs, databases and enterprise application support. Strong experience with C#/.NET, object-oriented programming, Oracle and/or SQL Server databases and complex SQL development is required.

The role will design, develop, enhance and support business applications, workflow solutions and system integrations. Working closely with business users, analysts, architects and development teams, the successful candidate will deliver scalable and reliable solutions within a global financial services environment.

This role will report to the Senior Applications Developer - Business Process Management.

Role Objectives: Delivery

Design, develop, test and support full stack applications using C#/.NET technologies.
Develop web applications, user interfaces, RESTful APIs, backend services and workflow solutions.
Design and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views and database objects.
Gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Troubleshoot application, integration and database issues.
Provide production support, root cause analysis, system maintenance and performance tuning.
Collaborate with business users, analysts, architects and development teams to deliver scalable and reliable solutions.
Participate in application design, code reviews, testing, deployment and continuous improvement.
Produce and maintain technical documentation.

Qualifications And Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline.
5+ years of full stack software development experience.
Strong C#/.NET development and object-oriented programming experience.
Experience developing web applications, user interfaces, RESTful APIs and backend services.
Strong Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL Server database experience.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, stored procedures, query optimisation and performance tuning.
Strong knowledge of relational database concepts, data modelling and database design.
Experience with application integrations, enterprise systems and application architecture.
Experience supporting, debugging and troubleshooting production applications.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication and collaboration skills.
Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership, accountability and teamwork.
Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.
Experience within financial services or banking is preferred.

Additional Requirements

SMBC’s employees participate in a hybrid workforce model that provides employees with an opportunity to work from home, as well as, from an SMBC office. SMBC requires that employees live within a reasonable commuting distance of their office location. Prospective candidates will learn more about their specific hybrid work schedule during their interview process.

SMBC provides reasonable accommodations during candidacy for applicants with disabilities consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please let us know at accommodations@smbcgroup.com.

jobs.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic Patient Care Systems (PCS), we power the digital heartbeat behind life-saving cardiac therapies. We build the connected ecosystem that enables clinicians to monitor, manage, and protect millions of patients living with implantable cardiac devices around the world.

From secure device connectivity and real-time data platforms to intelligent clinical tools and patient-facing experiences, PCS transforms complex cardiac data into clarity — helping physicians make faster decisions, improving outcomes, and giving patients greater confidence in their care.

Every line of code we write supports someone’s parent, spouse, child, or friend. Our work ensures that life-saving therapies are not only delivered safely and reliably, but continuously improved through innovation, insight, and global scale.

If you want to build technology that truly matters — where uptime means peace of mind and innovation means more birthdays — join us. Together, we are shaping the future of connected cardiac care and changing lives every single day

Come for a job, stay for a career!

A Day in The Life Of:

In general, the following responsibilities apply for the Senior Software Engineer
role. This includes, but is not limited to the following:

Design, develop, and test innovative software solutions that power life-changing medical technologies, ensuring compliance with software development standards and best practices.
Collaborate with product engineers, technology architects, software developers, and test engineers to define technical solutions, plan project deliverables, and drive successful execution from concept to release.
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to software engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.
Participate in technical reviews of requirements, architecture, designs, code, and other engineering artifacts, ensuring high-quality outcomes and timely delivery of project commitments.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance development processes, quality practices, and team effectiveness.
Design and implement reusable frameworks, components, and engineering patterns that accelerate development, improve maintainability, and increase team productivity.
Drive innovation by exploring new technologies, tools, and approaches that enhance software quality, performance, and user experience.
Partner closely with cross-functional teams and global stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions that make a meaningful impact on patients' lives.

Key Skills & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum of 4 years of relevant software engineering experience, or an advanced degree with 2 years of relevant technical experience.
Passion for building high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software solutions, supported by strong documentation practices.
Experience developing frameworks, reusable libraries, platforms, or shared software components that enable efficient product development.
Strong leadership, mentoring, and collaboration skills with a desire to help teams grow and succeed.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a passion for tackling complex technical challenges.
Proven ability to thrive in an Agile, fast-paced, and highly collaborative environment.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.
Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Company Awards:

Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025)
Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)

Discover our Benefits:

Remote First, Remote Always
PTO in accordance with local labor requirements
Monthly Wellness Fridays - enjoy an extra-long weekend every month
Fully Paid Parental Leave
Home office stipend based on country of residency
Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University
Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling and knowledge transfer

Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion

Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

Position Overview

As a Software Engineer intern you will be contributing and building Microsoft Azure NetApp Files (ANF) - an award winning first party cloud storage solutions that enables companies to deploy and run business critical workloads in the Microsoft Azure cloud. You will work as part of a team responsible for building software defined cloud storage solutions that run on Kubernetes; and work closely with the development team to understand the existing architecture and support the design and implementation of customer facing features.

This internship provides hands-on exposure to cloud environments, AI-enabled data management, documentation, testing, and collaboration within a global engineering environment.

This role is open to 3rd year students looking for a 6-month internship as part of their degree program. You should have the unrestricted right to work in Ireland for the entire duration of the internship. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide sponsorship. You are required to come into the Cork office a minimum of 4 times a week to ensure you make gain the most knowledge during this internship.

Key Responsibilities

Work on and develop features in close co-operation with our partner, Microsoft.
Build understanding of Unix systems and enterprise-scale functionality.
Explore and integrate AI-based techniques to enhance data management processes. Use AI to explore code functionality, improve existing tests, and develop new features. Document design, implementation, and testing processes clearly and consistently.
Collaborate with engineering teams and receive mentorship while gaining exposure to NetApp and Microsoft technologies.

Your Profile

You must be a current student pursuing a bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Working efficiency in C, C++,.net, and goLang programming languages. Python is a nice to have.
Basic knowledge of operating systems, architecture and debugging tools. Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and interest in their application in data management.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

Start Date: January or March 2027

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

jobs.title: Business Application Architect
jobs.description:
Would you like to use your skills to accelerate the global transition to a low-carbon circular economy?

About Cambi

Cambi is a world-leading provider of sustainable technology solutions that enable cities to turn wastewater sludge into valuable resources. We are a medium-size, Norway-based multinational company listed in Oslo on Euronext Growth, with offices in several countries. We have diligent employees from different backgrounds and more than 25 nationalities, and a growing sales network covering all continents.

Our core expertise lies in designing, testing, manufacturing, installing, and operating industrial process installations, used mainly for treating sewage sludge before or after anaerobic digestion in wastewater treatment plants. The technology, known as thermal hydrolysis, reduces greenhouse gas emissions and produces renewable energy, organic fertilizers, and various soil products while destroying pathogens and other harmful substances. Our systems have the capacity to cater to over 120 million individuals across more than 28 countries. We are proud of having cities like Oslo, London, Washington, Singapore, and Sydney among our clients.

About The Role

As a Business Applications Architect, you will be the technical owner of Cambi's Microsoft 365 landscape, ERP, CRM, and the integrations connecting them. You will translate business needs into platform functionality, aligned with the strategic direction for each system, and own the overall technical architecture across the full life-cycle of the platforms and their integrations – from design and implementation to ongoing evolution. This includes safeguarding the integrity, quality, and availability of the company's data as it flows across these platforms. The responsibility spans from high-level architectural direction to hands-on technical implementation, ensuring that strategic intent and operational detail remain consistently connected.

Key Responsibilities

Technically own the core business platforms and execute life-cycle enhancements to create business value.
Define and maintain architectural principles, standards, and documentation for Cambi’s core business applications and integrations.
Understand and translate business needs and foster cross-functional collaboration.
Ensure key processes have optimal system support.
Ensure technical changes are assessed and implemented with appropriate consideration for scalability, maintainability, security, data integrity, and life-cycle impact.
Embed data-driven thinking into architecture and technical decisions.
Operate within Cambi’s IT strategy, portfolio, priorities, and budget.

We are looking for

A data-first and data-driven mindset with a holistic way of thinking.
A consistent focus on ensuring that technology investments translate into tangible and measurable business value.
A genuine interest in platform solutions and the broader ecosystem they are part of.
A real appreciation for collaboration and cross-functional teams.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
A curious, technology-enthusiast approach to the work, with the drive and energy to help shape the role going forward.
Confident leading and participating in well-defined processes and appropriately scoped projects.
Willing to challenge the status quo, yet grounded and humble in how you do it.
Not afraid to get your hands dirty with day-to-day operational work, coding, and configuration.

Key qualifications and requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Relevant certifications and/or operational expertise within platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, ERP (platform-agnostic), CRM (Salesforce), integration development, and master data.
Significant, demonstrable experience in a comparable role is equally valid and will be given weight against formal education requirements.
Experience owning technical architecture and systems within a business context.
Experience in integration development, ideally with a background in software development (full-stack or backend).
Experience with system configuration and customization.
Experience with data platform architecture and the data engineering layer.
Hands-on skills in programming, scripting (PowerShell), and low-code (Power Automate, Power Apps) development within the ecosystem.
Experience with development methodology, including backlog and priority management.
Methodical project management experience, ideally from platform implementations or major upgrades.

At Cambi, we value people who share our commitment to the environment and the positive impact of the circular economy. Your personality should align with Cambi’s core philosophy, which centers around strong customer focus, delivering a high standard of quality in our solutions, products, and services, and always acting with integrity.

Why Join Cambi

Work globally: Encounter different cultures and work practices when working with the global organization.
Make an impact: Contribute to projects transforming organic waste streams into bioresources, boosting the circular economy, and leading to net-zero emissions in cities worldwide.
Immerse in diversity: Join a multicultural team with a mix of young and experienced colleagues from more than 25 countries and 18 different disciplinary backgrounds.
Grow personally: Embrace our values: quality, curious, reliable and teamwork, in a dynamic work environment grounded in a modern Code of Conduct applying to all employees and business partners.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career with us, we’d love to hear from you. We kindly ask you to upload your CV and answer three questions regarding your motivation for the role.

Delivering on our mission to enable a swift global transition to sustainable communities is contingent on attracting and retaining talented employees from diverse backgrounds.

Deadline for applying is the 18th of October 2026.
Please be informed that we will only accept and assess applications through our career site.

Kim Garberg, mob. 908 70 136, kim.garberg@cambi.com

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Architect who designs comprehensive technical solutions to bridge business problems with technology, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, security, and scalability. In your work you create architecture blueprints, select technology stacks, and lead implementation teams, acting as a crucial link between stakeholders and developers.

The role is based in our Espoo or Tampere office, and the work will be done in a hybrid model according to our needs.

Your Main Responsibilities

Sales and presales: Identifying customer needs and proposing bold solutions.
Architecture Design: Creating detailed architecture specifications, diagrams, and documentation for software and infrastructure.
Strategic Alignment: Mapping business requirements to technical solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.
Technology Selection: Evaluating and recommending tools, platforms, and frameworks that align with technical strategies.
Implementation Oversight: Guiding development teams during implementation to ensure adherence to the designed architecture.
Stakeholder Management: Communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and acting as a bridge between teams.

Your Required Skills And Experience

Technical Expertise: Strong background in software engineering (minimum 10 years), system integration, infrastructure, and cloud technologies (e.g., Azure, AWS).
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to diagnose complex problems and design effective, creative solutions.
Leadership: Ability and proven track-record in leading teams and guiding technical decision-making.
Project Management: Experience with SDLC, Agile methodologies, and managing project risks.
A Master’s degree in computer science or related field.
Extensive experience in software design, development, and IT infrastructure.
Experience in a technical leadership role.
Language skills: fluent English and Finnish

We also value

Entrepreneurial mindset
Deeper domain knowledge of industrial manufacturing

At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions, in line with our way of working. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 6000-7000€/month, depending on your background.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Solution Architect - Azure & AI
jobs.description:
Overview

Join our Cloud & AI team and help enterprise customers turn cloud and AI investments into measurable business value. As a Cloud Solution Architect, you’ll advise customers across AI and agents, applications, data, and infrastructure, shaping secure, resilient, and scalable solutions on Microsoft Azure. You’ll connect strategy to execution, remove complex technical blockers, and accelerate transformation from architecture through production and adoption.

Microsoft Customer & Partner Solutions accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.

We’re seeking a Cloud Solution Architect with broad expertise across AI and agents, applications, data, and infrastructure, and a passion for helping enterprise customers address complex technical and business challenges. In this customer-facing role, you’ll lead strategic technical engagements, advise C-level executives, and partner with Customer Success Leaders to shape and execute cloud strategies that advance transformation, modernization, sovereignty, resiliency, and security. You’ll guide customers through architecture, deployment, and operational excellence, helping them scale AI solutions, modernize applications and data platforms, and realize measurable value from Microsoft Azure. This role offers flexibility to work from home up to 30% of the time.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end technical delivery for a portfolio of strategic accounts, aligning engagements with customer success plans and ensuring customers realize measurable value from their Microsoft investments.
Serve as a technical advisor across the customer’s enterprise by helping technology and business leaders define Cloud and AI strategies, translate priorities into technical direction, and make informed architecture decisions that support long-term transformation outcomes.
Lead customers from strategy to production-ready solutions by guiding architecture design across AI, applications, data, infrastructure, security, resiliency, and agent-based scenarios; applying proven cloud architecture practices; and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, and ready for adoption.
Accelerate customer value from Microsoft Azure and AI investments by identifying modernization, data, AI, and platform opportunities across the enterprise; resolving technical blockers; guiding high-impact engagements from concept through implementation; and helping customers realize measurable business outcomes faster.
Orchestrate Microsoft and partner capabilities around customer priorities by coordinating with customer success, sales, engineering, specialist, partner, and delivery teams; aligning roles and responsibilities; and bringing the right expertise together to deliver a connected customer experience.
Drive technical quality and customer trust across complex engagements by anticipating risks, validating architecture quality, reinforcing secure and resilient design patterns, and ensuring mission-critical workloads are optimized for performance, governance, reliability, and operational excellence.
Scale successful outcomes through repeatable delivery practices by using proven frameworks, reusable assets, automation, and delivery guidance; capturing lessons learned; and contributing practices that improve consistency, quality, and speed across customer engagements.
Represent customer needs and strengthen technical community impact by sharing adoption blockers, product feedback, and field insights with internal teams; maintaining deep expertise across priority Cloud and AI workloads; mentoring others; and contributing to technical communities and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications (RQs)   

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND solid experience in Cloud & AI platform technologies, including Azure architecture, AI and agents, GitHub, Agentic DevOps, AI Agent development, data platforms, application modernization, resiliency, security, and production-scale cloud delivery, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
OR equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications (PQs)

Proficiency in Finnish language, with the ability to advise customers and conduct business discussions in Finnish.
Several years of experience in a customer-facing technology consulting role, advising enterprise customers, shaping cloud and AI strategies, translating business priorities into technical solutions, and guiding senior stakeholders through complex decisions from discovery through adoption.
Several years of experience leading complex technical consulting engagements from architecture and roadmap development through implementation, coordinating customer, partner, and delivery teams, resolving technical risks, and communicating decisions and outcomes to executive stakeholders.
Relevant technical certification in one or more priority areas, such as Microsoft Azure architecture, Azure AI Foundry, AI agents, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Fabric, security, resiliency, data platforms, or application modernization. Equivalent certifications from Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud are also valued.

Cloud Solution Architecture IC5 - The typical base pay range for this role across Finland is € 79,200.00 - € 143,200.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

Find Additional Benefits And Pay Information Here

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/finland-corporate-pay.html

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

jobs.title: Software developer
jobs.description:
Etsimme Sovelluskehittäjää
vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiämme, joka toteuttaa merkittäviä digitalisaatiohankkeita. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

Sijainti:
Tampere, Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Turku, Oulu tai Lappeenranta. Voit myös halutessasi työskennellä etänä kotoa, mutta asiakkaan turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi osa työtehtävistä on suoritettava toimistolla tai asiakkaan tiloissa Helsingissä.

Vastuualueet

Sovelluskehittäjänä:

Työskentelet monipuolisesti suomalaisen julkishallinnon ja yksityisen elinkeinoelämän asiakasprojekteissa kehittäen moderneja, skaalautuvia sovelluksia.
Osallistut mikropalveluarkkitehtuurien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
Toimit osana asiantuntijatiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kehittäjät, arkkitehdit, analyytikot ja UX/UI-suunnittelijat.
Ohjaat asiakasta parhaisiin ratkaisuihin ja osallistut aktiivisesti tekniseen suunnitteluun.
Toimit tiimissä osana suurempaa monen tiimin hanketta.

Kenen kanssa työskentelet?

Työskentelet osana T woday Digital Engineering asiantuntevaa noin 350 hengen praktiikkaa. Meillä on Suomen kärkitason osaajia ja rooleja devaajista arkkitehteihin sekä konsultteihin.

Tarjoamme sinulle osaavan, rennon ja innokkaan työympäristön, jossa sinun on mahdollista kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi. Työkulttuuriamme kuvaa avoin ja välittävä asenne työntekijöitämme kohtaan.

Odotamme Sinulta

Vähintään 3 vuoden kokemus.
Osaamista seuraavista teknologioista: C#, .NET, Vue, React, TypeScript.
Tuntemusta relaatiotietokannoista kuten PostgreSQL, MariaDB tai Oracle.
Pilviosaamista: Azure tai AWS.
Kokemusta mikropalveluarkkitehtuureista ja kontitetuista ratkaisuista.
Kokemusta ketterästä sovelluskehityksestä.
Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vakituinen asuinpaikka Suomessa.
Englannin kielen osaaminen.
Olet oma-aloitteinen ja sinulla on kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin.
Olet sopivasti ulospäin suuntautunut persoona ja osaat toimia osana tiimiä.
Kykenet organisoimaan sekä priorisoimaan omaa työtäsi.
Uskallat esittää asiat kuten ne ovat.
Osaat antaa rakentavaa palautetta ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti.
Sinulla on vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto suoritettuna.
Olet taustaltasi nuhteeton, koska tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä asiakkaamme vaativat perusmuotoisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen, jotta asiakasprojektiin osallistuminen olisi mahdollista. Lisätietoa turvallisuusselvityksestä ja sen vaatimuksista.

jobs.title: Erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Bygma tilbyder vi faglig dybde og geografisk bredde. Derfor har du store muligheder, når du vil lægge næste lag på din karriere. I salg eller i stab. På lager eller i ledelse. Sådan hjælper vi med at bygge Danmark.

Fastansat/tidsbegrænset: Fastansat

Timer: 37.0

Erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma Gruppen

Vil du udvikle digitale løsninger og samtidig tage ansvar for at drive udviklingsopgaver fremad sammen med teamet?

Vi søger en erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma IT & Digitalisering. Du bliver en del af vores interne udviklingsteam, hvor vi arbejder med alt fra websites, CMS og e-commerce til webapplikationer, API'er og integrationer.

Vi udvikler selv en stor del af vores løsninger og følger dem fra udvikling til drift og videreudvikling. Derfor søger vi dig, der både er en stærk fullstack-udvikler og kan tage teknisk ansvar for en løsning - fra afklaring og løsningsbeskrivelse til udvikling og implementering.

Jobbet

Du bliver en del af Bygma IT & Digitalisering med ca. 35 kolleger og får en central rolle i udviklingsteamet med reference til Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov. Stillingen er med base på vores hovedkontor i Søborg.

Du arbejder selv hands-on med udviklingen og tager samtidig en drivende teknisk rolle i større opgaver. Sammen med interessenter og resten af teamet omsætter du behov fra forretningen til gode tekniske løsninger, får opgaverne brudt ned og bidrager til at skabe fremdrift hele vejen til implementering.

Vi arbejder tæt på forretningen og de løsninger, der er i brug hver dag. Derfor består jobbet både af nye udviklingsopgaver og den løbende videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger. Det betyder også, at du sammen med teamet tager fat på bugs, mindre forbedringer og konkrete forespørgsler fra forretningen, når de opstår.

Dine Opgaver Bliver Bl.a. At

udvikle og videreudvikle fullstack webapplikationer og digitale løsninger
tage ansvar for løsningsbeskrivelse og teknisk afklaring
nedbryde større udviklingsopgaver og drive dem fremad sammen med teamet
videreudvikle vores CMS- og e-commerce-platforme
udvikle både frontend og backend samt API'er og integrationer
håndtere bugs, forbedringer og løbende behov fra forretningen
sikre stabile, vedligeholdelsesvenlige løsninger, der er effektive at drifte
sparre om arkitektur, teknologi og best practices

Din profil

Du har flere års erfaring med fullstack webudvikling og gerne solid erfaring med CMS og e-commerce.

Vi leder efter en reel fullstack-profil, som er stærk i .NET/C#, men som også har solid erfaring med frontend-udvikling og selv arbejder med Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript og moderne webteknologier. Du trives med at arbejde på tværs af hele løsningen - fra brugerfladen i frontend til API'er, integrationer og data bagved.

Du trives med hele spændet i udviklingsarbejdet. Den ene opgave kan være en større ny funktion, den næste en fejl i en eksisterende løsning eller en konkret forespørgsel fra en kollega i forretningen. For dig er det naturligt at tage ansvar for begge dele.

Du har også blik for løsningen, når den er sat i produktion. Drift er en naturlig del af vores udviklingsansvar, og du tænker derfor stabilitet, performance, vedligeholdelse og effektiv drift ind i de løsninger, du er med til at bygge.

Vi Arbejder Bl.a. Med

.NET / C#
CMS og e-commerce – vi anvender pt. Optimizely / Episerver
Angular
JavaScript / TypeScript
SQL og databaser
Web API'er og integrationer

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af Bygmas digitale platforme og mulighed for at præge både løsninger og tekniske valg.

Hos os er IT tæt på forretningen. Vejen fra idé til implementering er kort, og det, du udvikler, bliver hurtigt brugt i praksis. Vi følger vores løsninger efter implementering og arbejder løbende med både drift, forbedringer og videreudvikling.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for at få tingene i mål.

Kan du se dig selv hos os?

Så søg jobbet via linket på denne side. Fristen er 8. oktober 2026. Vi holder løbende samtaler og kan derfor vælge den rette kandidat inden ansøgningsfristens udløb. Så skynd dig at sende os din ansøgning – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Bemærk, at vi kun modtager ansøgninger via vores rekrutteringssystem.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov på jefe@bygma.dk.

Om Bygma Gruppen

Bygma Gruppen A/S er den største danskejede leverandør af byggematerialer til det professionelle byggeri, og vi giver vores kunder rådgivning, service og kvalitet på branchens højeste niveau.

I Bygma Gruppen er vi fagfolk, som handler med fagfolk. Vi ved, at godt grej er afgørende for håndværkeren. At entreprenøren har brug for et samarbejde uden knaster. At en byggeplads kræver stram styring og varer til tiden.

Bygma Gruppen beskæftiger ca. 3.000 medarbejdere fordelt på flere end 125 forretningsenheder i både Danmark, Sverige, Island, Færøerne, Polen og Grønland og omsætter årligt for over 10 milliarder kroner.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Backend-udviklere til Mjølner i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Hos Mjølner får du som senior .Net-udvikler mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt i et stærkt fællesskab af dygtige kollegaer, hvor vidensdeling, sparring og arbejdsglæde er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du får spændende opgaver, frihed til at tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag og et solidt bagland, der støtter dig i din udvikling. Vi oplever i øjeblikket en sund og bæredygtig vækst, og vores kunder efterspørger flere af vores dygtige backend-konsulenter. Derfor udvider vi nu teamet i Aarhus.

Din rolle og hverdag hos Mjølner

Som backend-udvikler bliver du en del af vores største faglighed, hvor vi primært arbejder med .NET og Java, sikkerhed, arkitektur og DevOps.

Hos os får du det bedste fra to verdener: meningsfulde konsulentopgaver og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab at læne dig op ad. Typisk vil du være tilknyttet en konkret opgave hos én af vores kunder 2–3 dage om ugen, mens resten af tiden kan bruges hjemmefra eller fra vores kontor i Aarhus.

"For mig er Mjølner det modsatte af et ekkokammer. Der er altid nogen, der har et andet perspektiv, og som kan hjælpe og udfordre dig. Vi fylder ikke ugen op med møder, men om fredagen har vi til gengæld nogle fantastiske rammer for at sætte os sammen og vidensdele over morgenmad og spændende nyheder. Mjølner passer godt på sine konsulenter – og vi passer godt på hinand en,” fortæller vores Lead Software Developer Lea.

Du får mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for et bredt spektrum af teknologier og blive koblet på opgaver i forskellige brancher. Vores projekter har det tilfælles, at de skaber reel værdi for nogle af Danmarks mest interessante virksomheder, der virkelig sætter pris på vores kompetencer.

Konsulentopgaverne varer typisk 6–12 måneder, men ofte forlænges samarbejdet, og nogle opgaver strækker sig over flere år. Det giver dig mulighed for både faglig fordybelse og for at opbygge stærke relationer hos kunden. Uanset hvor du har din daglige gang, har du altid en stærk tilknytning til Mjølner og et bagland, der står klar til at hjælpe.

Det forventer vi af dig

• En relevant videregående uddannelse – fx som datalog eller softwareingeniør.
• Minimum 5 års erfaring med backend-udvikling og de nyeste .NET-teknologier (Java-erfaring kan også være relevant).
• At du kan tage ansvar for egne udviklingsopgaver og levere løsninger af høj kvalitet.
• Flair og interesse for konsulentrollen og en nysgerrig tilgang, hvor du trives med at sparre med både kunder og kollegaer om tekniske og forretningsmæssigeproblemstillinger.
• Lyst til at dele din viden og hjælpe kollegaer videre – både internt og ude hos kunden.

Det er en bonus, hvis du og
s å har:

• Erfaring fra konsulent branchen.
• Kendskab til Microservices, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, Azure/AWS eller CI/CD og lyst til at blive endnu skarpere fagligt .

Her udvikler du ikke kun løsninger for andre – du udvikler også dig selv

Du kan helt sikkert gøre os klogere, ligesom vi kan lære dig noget. Hos Mjølner bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor videndeling er centralt for vores måde at tænke, arbejde og agere på. Vi mødes i faglige guilds, hvor vi sammen dykker ned i tekniske emner. Om fredagen samles vi til fælles morgenmad – en fast tradition, hvor vi dyrker fællesskabet og holder hinanden opdateret.

Vores afdeling består af både erfarne og yngre kollegaer, og vi vægter diversitet højt. Vi kan lide at grine sammen og bruge tid sammen, men helst ikke mere end 37 timer om ugen. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes af mennesker, der har overskud – derfor prioriterer vi balancen mellem arbejde og fritid. Når vi mødes socialt, kan det fx være over et brætspil, til faglige talks, i løbeklubben eller til ølsmagning.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så skynd dig at ansøge via Apply-knappen.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores Manager, Dennis Kristensen på mail: dkr@mjolner.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Join Energy Asset Integration & Operations and work hands-on with backend development, data pipelines and automation that support trading, forecasting and operations. You will contribute to real software from day one while learning from experienced developers around you.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
We are growing fast and looking for someone to be the technical authority behind it. Someone who designs the AI architectures that large organisations build on, and who can hold the deep technical picture and the business outcome at the same time.

About KPMG NewTech

KPMG NewTech works with some of Denmark's largest organisations to put AI to work. Our team sits at the centre of this, operating across two areas that go hand in hand: we design and implement AI solutions and transformations, and we help organisations change how they work through AI adoption.

A big part of what makes us different is our NewPractice methodology, our approach to redefining how organisations build AI-native processes from the ground up. It is not about putting AI onto existing ways of working. It is about rethinking work itself.

We are a team that is motivated by learning, works well in changing environments and is accountable. We are growing quickly, and the people joining will have meaningful influence on where we go.

What You Will Be Doing

You will own the technical architecture of our most complex AI engagements. That means designing the platforms, reference architectures, and agent foundations that large organisations build on, and making the architectural calls that decide whether an AI solution scales or stalls.

Microsoft is at the core of what we do, so deep knowledge across the Microsoft AI and data platform is essential. Many of our clients run more than one cloud, so a working view of AWS or Google helps you design for the reality clients actually operate in.

You will sit at the executive table as the person clients trust on AI architecture, and you will set the technical standard for the team. As a Director or Senior Manager you also carry commercial weight: spotting opportunities, shaping proposals, and helping define where we take our AI services next.

A central part of the role is working with AI yourself. We use AI across everything we do, and you will set the standard for the team in how that is done.

In practice, that means:

Owning the technical architecture of complex AI and agentic solutions, from platform foundations through to production.
Designing enterprise AI reference architectures on Microsoft Azure (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric) and, where it fits, across AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker).
Making the architectural calls that matter: platform selection, security, scalability, cost, and integration.
Being the technical authority that clients trust on AI strategy, platform, and delivery.
Advising the C-suite and technical leadership on how to build AI capability that lasts.
Setting the technical standards and patterns for the team and raising the bar on how we build.
Managing and mentoring architects, engineers, and developers.
Spotting opportunities, shaping proposals, and helping define where we take our AI services next.

What We Are Looking For

You have 8 or more years of experience, likely from consulting, a senior architecture role, or a similar technical leadership position. You have designed and delivered enterprise AI or data architectures that made it all the way to production, and you are as comfortable in an executive meeting as in a design session.

More specifically, we look for:

Deep, practical experience with the Microsoft AI and data platform: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, and the surrounding services.
Working knowledge of AWS AI services such as Bedrock and SageMaker, ideally with a view that spans both clouds.
Experience of designing and delivering AI or data architectures at enterprise scale that reached production.
A solid grasp of AI security, governance, scalability, and the realities of running AI in regulated environments.
Comfortable at the executive level, translating deep technical decisions into clear business language.
Experience leading technical teams and setting architectural direction.
A commercial instinct: you spot opportunities and help shape the work, not just deliver it.
Genuinely curious about where AI architecture is heading, agentic systems, and how to build for what is coming.
Relevant Microsoft and AWS architecture certifications are a plus.
Fluency in English and Danish.
A relevant master's degree or above, or equivalent depth of experience.

Interested?

Upload your CV, and a short cover letter via the Apply button. Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We review applications and interview on a rolling basis.

Feel free to contact Mårten Waldmann ( mwaldmann@kpmg.com ) for any questions. We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Du får

En central rolle med ansvar for Azure-arkitektur, teknisk presales og rådgivning i komplekse og forretningskritiske kundemiljøer.
Mulighed for at sætte den faglige retning, udvikle referencearkitekturer og løfte kvaliteten på tværs af vores Azure-leverancer.
Et stærkt fagligt miljø med tæt samarbejde mellem Solution Architects, konsulenter, Operations, Sales og Alliances.

Dine opgaver

Du leder den tekniske kundedialog fra discovery og assessment til løsningsdesign, estimering og et beslutningsklart oplæg.
Du identificerer og former nye Azure-projekter og sikrer, at løsningerne kan implementeres og efterfølgende driftes effektivt i Sentias managed services-model.

Du er

En erfaren og selvstændig Azure Solution Architect, der kan tage teknisk ejerskab, skabe fremdrift og træffe velbegrundede arkitekturbeslutninger.
Kundeorienteret, kommercielt bevidst og dygtig til at samle specialister og interessenter om en pragmatisk og holdbar løsning.

Vil du stå i spidsen for Azure-arkitektur og omsætte komplekse behov til løsninger, der skaber reel forretningsværdi? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Som Senior Azure Solution Architect får du ansvar for at omsætte kundernes behov og tekniske udfordringer til gennemtænkte Azure-arkitekturer. Du følger løsningen fra den indledende dialog og analyse gennem design og planlægning til implementering og en struktureret overdragelse til Operations.
Du bliver den tekniske ekspert i projekterne og sikrer, at løsningerne bygger på Microsofts anbefalinger og Sentias principper for sikkerhed, governance, standardisering og managed services. Du arbejder tæt sammen med vores Solution Architects, konsulenter og Operations og bidrager løbende med sparring, design reviews og kvalitetssikring. Når projektet kræver det, deltager du også i tekniske afklaringer og udvalgte dele af implementeringen.
Du kan arbejde hybridt fra vores kontor i Ballerup, Odense eller Aarhus, hjemmefra og efter behov hos kunder. Rejseaktiviteten er begrænset og vil primært være knyttet til relevante kundemøder og workshops.

Dine ansvarsområder

Designe sikre, skalerbare og driftsegnede Azure-arkitekturer, der understøtter kundens tekniske behov og strategiske mål.
Omsætte forretningsmæssige og tekniske krav til robuste, fremtidssikrede og implementerbare løsninger.
Drive tekniske assessments, workshops, design reviews og centrale arkitekturbeslutninger gennem hele projektets livscyklus.
Planlægge og guide migrationen af applikationer og workloads fra on-premises, private cloud eller hybride miljøer til Azure.
Udarbejde og vedligeholde arkitekturdiagrammer, løsningsbeskrivelser, tekniske standarder, beslutningsgrundlag og implementeringsplaner.
Arbejde tæt sammen med konsulenter og øvrige tekniske specialister og understøtte implementeringen med rådgivning, afklaringer og kvalitetssikring.
Deltage praktisk i udvalgte dele af implementeringen, når der er behov for at afprøve eller etablere centrale komponenter.
Sikre, at løsningerne følger Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Well-Architected Framework og relevante principper for sikkerhed, governance, compliance og FinOps.
Kommunikere komplekse tekniske koncepter og arkitekturbeslutninger klart til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.

Din profil

Har solid erfaring som Azure Solution Architect, Cloud Architect eller i en tilsvarende rolle.
Har praktisk erfaring med design og implementering af Azure IaaS- og PaaS-løsninger.
Har stærke kompetencer inden for Azure Landing Zones, Cloud Adoption Framework, governance og design af enterprise Azure-miljøer.
Har erfaring med Azure-netværk, identitet og hybride løsninger, herunder eksempelvis Microsoft Entra ID, PIM, VPN, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall og private endpoints.
Har erfaring med at planlægge og gennemføre migrering af applikationer og workloads fra on-premises, private cloud eller andre cloudplatforme til Azure.
Har arbejdet med Infrastructure as Code og automatisering, eksempelvis Bicep, Terraform, PowerShell eller tilsvarende teknologier.
Har forståelse for Azure DevOps, CI/CD-pipelines og kontrolleret deployment af cloudplatforme og workloads.
Kan anvende principper for sikkerhed, governance, compliance, monitorering og FinOps i dine løsningsdesigns.
Kan udarbejde og kvalitetssikre arkitekturdiagrammer, løsningsbeskrivelser, tekniske standarder og implementeringsplaner.
Kan drive tekniske workshops og kommunikere komplekse løsninger tydeligt til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.
Taler og skriver engelsk på et professionelt niveau. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

En ny måde at arbejde med IT på

I Sentia trives vi ved at være vores kunders fortrukne og langsigtede samarbejdspartner. Derfor er det vigtigt for os at vi skræddersyer markedets bedste løsninger, som passer til kundens forretning, om det er pure Public Cloud, hybrid, Sentia Cloud eller andre managed services. Det vigtigste er, at vi skaber langsigtede løsninger sammen med vores kunder og derved sikrer et stærkt fundament for fremtidigt samarbejde.

Vi løser forretningsudfordringer med IT-løsninger

Vi mener, at den digitale verden er kernen i enhver virksomhed, og vi drives af at finde den bedste IT-løsning sammen med vores kunder. Vi er i øjeblikket på en spændende transformationsrejse, hvor vi optimerer vores interne struktur, fra vores systemlandskab til at udfordre traditionelle arbejdsmetoder. Vi inviterer dig på denne spændende rejse, hvor vi konstant er i udvikling og derfor kan du ikke lade være med at vokse sammen med os.

Vil du med på rejsen?

Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet det rette match. Vi vil derfor gerne invitere dig til at sende os dit CV og nogle passionerede linjer hvor du fremhæver hvorfor DU netop er det rette match for Sentia. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! Hvis du har specifikke spørgsmål vedr. Sentia eller positionen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Team Lead public Cloud Operations, Daniel Svagin Luplau på e-mail: daniel.svagin.luplau@sentia.dk
