jobs.title: Director, AI Solutions & Engineering
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Director, AI Solutions and Engineering

At Lundbeck, we are building a bionic company. We believe competitive advantage will not come from AI models alone, but from how we combine them with Lundbeck’s unique neuroscience expertise, data and enterprise knowledge to transform how we work, discover, develop and deliver treatments. In a global, regulated pharmaceutical environment, this means moving with both ambition and responsibility; rapidly exploring what AI makes possible while ensuring what we scale is secure, trusted and sustainable.

As Director, AI Solutions & Engineering, you will lead Lundbeck’s enterprise capability for AI solution architecture, engineering and industrialization. Working closely with the Chief AI Office, business leaders and technology teams, you will turn strategic AI opportunities into scalable solutions that create measurable value across Lundbeck.

AI Solutions & Engineering enables and scales AI solutions across Lundbeck while exploring and advancing high-value applications of frontier AI. Your team will rapidly explore and de-risk emerging capabilities, build advanced and differentiated solutions where dedicated engineering creates value, and establish the reusable architecture, engineering patterns and paved pathways that enable teams across Lundbeck to build safely and move fast. A key part of your mandate will be creating a clear path from experimentation and citizen-built solutions to secure, scalable and professionally engineered enterprise solutions.

This role is based at Lundbeck’s headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark, and requires regular on-site presence.

Your Responsibilities

Lead a high-performing team spanning AI and software engineering, solution architecture and applied AI specialists.
Partner with the Chief AI Office and senior business leaders to translate strategic AI opportunities into well-defined use cases, experiments and scalable solutions, owning the technical pathway from opportunity to enterprise production.
Lead the architecture, engineering and deployment of advanced AI solutions, including assistants, agents and AI-enabled workflows, building on enterprise platforms where possible and developing differentiated solutions where dedicated engineering creates greater value.
Shape Lundbeck’s federated AI engineering model by establishing reusable components, architectural guardrails and paved engineering pathways across areas such as agents, integrations, evaluation, observability, identity and deployment.
Partner with data, digital and business teams to connect AI with Lundbeck’s data, enterprise knowledge, applications and processes through modern data, semantic, retrieval and integration patterns.
Explore emerging frontier-model capabilities and rapidly test their application to Lundbeck’s business and scientific challenges, scaling what demonstrates meaningful value.
Set technical direction and continuously evolve Lundbeck’s AI engineering practices in close collaboration with the Digital & AI Foundation team and other enterprise technology capabilities.

What You Bring To The Team

You combine deep technical credibility with strategic leadership and strong business judgment. You can translate emerging technology into practical business opportunities, guide senior technical teams and act as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders. You are collaborative and pragmatic, but also able to form and defend a clear technical point of view in a complex environment. Most importantly, you start with the business problem and value to be created, not the technology itself.

Moreover, you possess most of the following qualifications:

Experience designing, building and scaling AI solutions in large, complex or regulated organizations.
Strong expertise across Generative AI, large language models, intelligent agents, evaluation and AI operations, supported by strong software engineering and cloud fundamentals.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture and the ability to set AI solution architecture and engineering direction within broader enterprise principles and governance.
Experience connecting AI with enterprise data, knowledge and business systems through APIs, semantic and retrieval architectures and modern integration patterns.
Experience across leading AI ecosystems and model providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft, with the ability to evaluate emerging capabilities and determine where they can create value at enterprise scale.
A proven track record of building and leading multidisciplinary technical teams and establishing trusted partnerships with senior business leaders, technology teams and external partners.

Our promise to you

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further in addressing the significant unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with exciting challenges and development opportunities, balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve.

Annual base salary range: 1 005 000 - 1 381 600 DKK gross

At Lundbeck, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. Please note that the final base salary within the stated range will be based on relevant qualifications, skills, competencies, and level of proficiency as well as internal pay equity.

Apply now

Can you see yourself in this role? We want to hear from you. Does this sound like your dream job, but you’re not sure if you meet all the requirements? We still want to hear from you!

Upload your CV and include a few lines about your motivation for applying. We ask you not to include a photo or personal information that does not relate to your professional experience. If you have questions, please contact TA Partner, Mette Kvist at mekv@lundbeck.com

Applications must be received by October 1st 2026.

Learn more about us at www.lundbeck.com, LinkedIn or Instagram (@h_lundbeck).

#EveryBrainInTheGame

This job ad is intended for individuals seeking a career opportunity with Lundbeck.
We engage with recruitment and search firms where needed on the basis of a written agreement, and we do not accept unsolicited requests of any kind. If you work as a recruitment consultant, you are kindly instructed to refrain from contacting Lundbeck or the hiring manager directly with suggested candidates. If you violate this policy, you do so at your own risk and for your own account, and Lundbeck will not assume any liability nor pay any associated fees resulting from such violation.

Build the future of software delivery at GN.

GN is making AI-augmented delivery an integral part of how our software organisation works, and the shift is already underway. We are looking for an engineer to own and evolve the platform behind it, helping shape where it goes next.

In the role of Senior AI Agent Engineer
in the Engineering Excellence team within Software Solutions
, you will contribute to our purpose of Bringing People Closer. You will build and operate the production platform that enables AI agents to support engineering teams in delivering reliable software.

The Team you will be part of:

Engineering Excellence is a small, experienced team within Software Solutions, based in Ballerup near Copenhagen. We have a clear mandate to evolve how GN builds and delivers software.

We explore how work happens across the software organisation, identify where automation adds value and where human judgement remains essential, and build practical solutions ourselves. As the team grows, you will play a central role in developing the AI agent delivery platform and creating trusted ways of working with engineering teams.

Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:

Own and evolve the platform that enables AI agents to perform engineering work end to end, with human approval and clear visibility.
Set the technical direction and architecture, making informed decisions and communicating the rationale behind them.
Build, deploy and operate production-grade systems, with accountability for reliability, cost, latency and traceability.
Develop tooling that helps agents work effectively across a large codebase, including context retrieval and measurement of solution performance.
Design resilient workflows with guardrails, deterministic fallbacks and approval gates that people can understand and trust.
Expand automation into relevant parts of the software delivery lifecycle, while evaluating and retiring approaches that do not deliver value.
Partner closely with engineering teams whose code and pipelines the platform supports, building trust through collaboration and practical outcomes.

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

Bring solid engineering judgement and experience designing, building and operating reliable software systems.
May have experience taking solutions from an early prototype to a production system that people rely on.
Have experience deploying and operating an LLM-powered system in production, including learning from incidents and improving its reliability.
Think in interfaces, schemas, state management and asynchronous workflows, and apply a structured approach to observability, retry logic and cost control.
Work well with people across teams and disciplines, are comfortable navigating evolving practices, and bring a thoughtful approach to AI agent security, including prompt injection.

You will work with Python in an environment that is largely based on C#, .NET and Azure. Experience with the Microsoft stack is an add-on, as this is where much of our software is developed; experience with Python is also beneficial but not required from day one.

At GN we pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

We encourage you to apply

GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

What impact can you make in this role?

You will be empowered to be at the top of your game by providing strategic partnership, and innovative technology solutions that supports GIC’s vision of being a tech-driven, global, long-term investment firm.

As a Software Engineer at GIC, you will be at the forefront of financial technology innovation, driving the development of cutting-edge solutions that empower our investment strategies and operations. You will:

What makes you a successful candidate?

At least 5 years of relevant experience in software development, and hands-on experience in solution designing, software testing, and production support
Proficiency in Agile software development methodologies and practices such as Scrum, Kanban, or Test-Driven Development
Hands-on technical skills and good competency in C# (.Net Core) and related frameworks such as ASP.NET Core

Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure and containerisation technologies like Docker and Kubernetes
Strong team player who is keen to learn, independent, and possesses strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills
Passionate about understanding business requirements and using technology to transform or improve current state
Familiar with and interested in learning about current and emerging technology landscapes

Experience leading engineering teams and/or mentoring junior software engineers is advantageous, especially for VP candidates

As a Cloud Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the Out of the Box experience of all Dyson Connected products, this includes pairing the Dyson Link app with connected products and building API and microservices for Connected products.

jobs.title: Mid-level Full-Stack Developer C#/.NET & Angular
jobs.description:
About Ragnar Solutions

Ragnar Solutions Romania is the Romanian branch of Ragnar Solutions BV, a growing software company based in the Netherlands.
We build and maintain Deimos
, an e-invoicing integration platform used for compliance accross PEPPOL (multi-country), France, Poland, Spain and more.
E-invoicing is becoming mandatory in more and more countries, but every country has different rules, formats, and government systems. Deimos handles that complexity for our clients, helping make sure
their invoices are processed correctly and delivered to the right systems on time.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-level Full-Stack Developer
to join the team building Deimos.
You will own features end to end: from the CSV/SFTP intake and the background jobs that talk to national e-invoicing systems (Poland's KSeF, Spain's VeriFactu, the Peppol network) through to the Angular portals where clients see the result.

Our Stack

How it's built

A multi-tenant platform: two Angular portals (client and admin), an API gateway in front of two ASP.NET Core APIs, and multiple .NET background services
Services talk over RabbitMQ; calls to external systems go through an outbox with idempotent retries
Integrations over REST, SOAP and SFTP, with XML built and validated against official schemas (Peppol BIS / UBL, Poland's FA(3))

Backend

C# 14 on .NET 10, ASP.NET Core
Entity Framework Core with PostgreSQL
RabbitMQ, Serilog
xUnit and Moq

Front-end

Angular 20, standalone components and signals
TypeScript, RxJS, Tailwind CSS
Nx monorepo with libraries shared by both portals
Playwright for end-to-end tests

Tooling and Infrastructure

Docker and Docker Compose
GitLab CI for builds, tests and deployments
HashiCorp Vault for configuration and secrets

What you will do

Own features across backend, frontend, tests and docs
Build and maintain integrations with national e-invoicing authorities
Work with XML schemas: build documents, validate them, debug rejections from the authority
Design background jobs: import pipelines, outbox-based sync workers, retries, idempotency
Investigate production issues independently across services (logs, queues, database)
Keep tenant isolation and authorization intact in everything you touch
Review code and mentor junior developers

What we are looking for

3+ years professional C#/.NET, including ASP.NET Core APIs
Solid EF Core and relational DB skills (PostgreSQL preferred): migrations, indexing, query performance
Angular + TypeScript + RxJS, comfortable with forms, tables, reusable components; signals a plus
Message-based / asynchronous processing (RabbitMQ or similar): at-least-once delivery, idempotency, retries
Unit and integration tests as part of "done" (xUnit, Moq)
Comfortable integrating third-party APIs (REST, SOAP) and reading XML/XSD
Can debug a distributed issue on your own
Git/PR workflow, gives useful code review

Nice to have

E-invoicing, Peppol, UBL or any tax-authority integration
Multi-tenant SaaS
Docker Compose, GitLab CI, Vault
File-based integrations (SFTP, CSV)
Auth: JWT, FIDO2/passkeys, RBAC
Nx monorepos, Playwright

What we offer

Salary range between 7000 and 11000 RON (net), depending on experience
Hybrid working environment
Meal tickets
Medlife Gold private medical insurance
End of year bonus
Performance bonus
Access to courses for continued professional development

Our hiring process

We keep it short and transparent:

Intro call to talk about your background, the role, and what you are looking for.
Take-home assignment, described below.
Technical discussion (around an hour) where we go through your assignment together.
Final conversation with the team, and an offer.

About the take-home assignment

The assignment is a small full-stack task scoped to around 4 hours: a .NET API that accepts invoice-like records, a background worker that processes them from a queue (idempotent, with retries), and a small Angular page that shows the outcome. We care about how you structure and test it, not about polish. You have one week to hand it in.

KIPCO Grubu'nun (Kuwait Projects Company) bir iştiraki olarak 1977 yılında kurulan Burgan Bank Grubu, MENAT (Orta Doğu&Kuzey Afrika, Türkiye) bölgesinin en büyük şube ağına sahip bankalarından biridir. Özellikle kurumsal müşterilere, finansal kurumlara ve özel bankacılığa odaklanmış olup bireysel ve özel bankacılık alanlarında büyüyen bir markadır.

2013 yılından bu yana Burgan Bank Türkiye olarak sürekli değişen ve gelişen dünyanın dinamik yapısına hızla ayak uyduruyor, yenilikleri fırsata dönüştürüyoruz. Her zaman güvene dayalı, samimi ve sürdürülebilir ilişkiler kurarak tecrübeleri ve uzmanlıklarıyla birbirini besleyen ‘biz olmak, dinamizm ve kazanmak’ değerleri doğrultusunda uyum içinde çalışan bir kurumuz.

Hedefe ulaşırken tüm ekip arkadaşlarımızın çabasını ve performansını güçlendirmek için çalışan mutluluğunu benimsiyoruz. Ailemizin her üyesine daha ilk günden itibaren “Burgan seninle” mesajını veriyor; kariyer, gelişim, gelecek ve yaşam yolculuğunda her türlü eğitim, seminer ve uygulamalarla Burganlılara destek oluyoruz.

Bilgi Teknolojileri Grubu, Ödeme Sistemleri Geliştirme Bölümü, Kart ,Kampanya ve Ödemeler ekiplerimizde bankacılıkta fark yaratarak, müşterilerimize en iyi bankacılık deneyimini sunmak için çalışıyoruz.

Agile ve çevik yaklaşımlarla, sadece kod yazmıyor, aynı zamanda geleceği şekillendiriyoruz.
Eğer sen de bu heyecan verici yolculuğa katılmak istiyorsan başvurularınızı bekliyoruz !

Nasıl Yapıyoruz?

SOLID Prensipleri:
Temiz kod ve sürdürülebilir projeler için SOLID prensiplerini benimsiyoruz.
.Net Core:
Backend geliştirmelerimizde en güncel .Net Core versiyonlarını dapr destekli kullanıyoruz, N8N & Zeebe gibi araçlarla entegrasyon sağlıyoruz
Veritabanı Teknolojileri:
MSSQL, Qlik, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL kullanıyor ve Entity Framework ile ORM geliştirmeleri yapıyoruz.Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ: Veri erişimi için Redis, event streaming için Kafka ve RabbitMQ kullanıyoruz.
Openshift:
Üretim ortamında container teknolojisi ile Openshift altyapısını kullanıyoruz.
Azure DevOps:
CI/CD süreçlerimizi Azure DevOps ile yönetiyor, zero downtime deployment ile süreçleri hızlandırıyoruz.
Elastic Stack: Loglama ve performans yönetiminde Elastic Stack ile hayatımızı kolaylaştırıyoruz.

Kimi Arıyoruz?

5 yıl veya üzeri yazılım geliştirme deneyimi
Tercihen Kredi Kartı, Ödeme Sistemleri (Para Transferleri), Kampanya Yönetimi vb. alanların bir veya bir kaçında.Net Core ve Micro Service konularında yetkin
DDD, Clean Architecture ve Yazılım Mimarileri konusunda karar alabilecek
Agile ve Scrum metodolojilerine aşina
Takım çalışmasına yatkın ve iletişim becerileri kuvvetli

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. More Than a Job: A Mission

We're looking for a Full Stack Software Designer in Istanbul to shape cutting-edge digital solutions for modern mobility systems. You'll work alongside people who show up with ownership, passion, and dedication.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in Turkey.

This is a strategic and advisory architecture role focused on shaping complex, multi-domain platforms for scalability, security, reliability, and long-term sustainability.

You will define architecture strategy, technical roadmaps, and reference patterns while guiding engineering teams through complex technical decisions.

The role combines deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.

You will bridge pre-sales and delivery, ensuring client solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with long-term platform realities.

While the position is primarily architecture-focused, you will remain hands-on when greenfield initiatives, prototypes, or critical architectural decisions require deeper technical involvement.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, Leadership, and clients while influencing senior technical teams through expertise rather than formal authority.

This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced architect who can raise technical maturity while remaining closely connected to delivery.

Accountabilities

Define detailed architecture blueprints, system designs, technical standards, reference patterns, and long-term technology roadmaps for complex platforms.
Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable distributed systems and integrations while balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational complexity.
Act as the primary architectural authority, guiding technical direction and modernization strategies across mature and evolving systems.
Architect and optimize cloud or hybrid infrastructures, including networking, IAM/RBAC, compute, storage, monitoring, security, governance, resilience, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and automation strategies using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or native cloud tooling.
Guide DevOps adoption, CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, release workflows, environment management, observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Support engineering teams with complex debugging, incident resolution, performance improvements, and architectural refactoring from a systems-level perspective.
Contribute selectively to architecture-critical code, prototypes, proofs of concept, code reviews, design reviews, and technical troubleshooting when hands-on involvement is required.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success during pre-sales to assess technical feasibility, shape solution approaches, participate in discovery and proposals, and validate delivery commitments.
Ensure architectural context and decisions transition effectively from pre-sales into delivery and early project planning.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and modern automation approaches.
Mentor engineers and technical leads, identify capability gaps, promote engineering best practices, and strengthen overall architectural and technical maturity.
Influence senior technical stakeholders through strong communication, credibility, and sound judgment without relying on formal authority.

Requirements

Bring 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in architecture-focused roles.
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
Have proven experience designing, delivering, and evolving distributed systems in production, including large-scale or mission-critical environments.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of REST APIs, service-oriented architectures, event-driven design, messaging, queues, buses, event-management systems, SQL, data models, and databases.
Have solid understanding of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, TDD, EDD, Infrastructure as Code, Platform as a Service, security, governance, observability, and resilience.
Be capable of reading, understanding, and reasoning about complex codebases across multiple technologies, with sufficient code literacy to guide architectural decisions.
Have strong familiarity with modern cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure, including experience with Azure or comparable platforms.
Demonstrate experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automation, infrastructure architecture, and production operations.
Possess strong architectural judgment and a systems-thinking mindset, combined with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and demonstrate strong ownership in evolving and ambiguous environments.
Be comfortable influencing and guiding senior engineers without direct authority while respecting their expertise and autonomy.
Demonstrate curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies and new architectural approaches.
Experience modernizing legacy systems, evolving mature platforms, working with cloud-native or containerized architectures, microservices, workflow orchestration, event-driven platforms, or AI/ML integration is a plus.
Cloud or architecture-related certifications are considered an additional advantage.

Benefits

Long-term, full-time employment.
Fully remote work.
Competitive salary in USD, based on the role and experience.
20+ paid time-off days.
Opportunity to work on complex, multi-domain technology platforms and influence long-term architectural strategy.
Exposure to cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.
Opportunities to mentor technical teams and contribute to broader engineering maturity and leadership development.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Ebenso entwickelst du gewachsene Systeme weiter – durch Migrationen, Refactorings und Performance-Optimierungen – und achtest dabei auf Testbarkeit und Wartbarkeit über mehrjährige Produktlebenszyklen.
Zentrale Anwendungsbausteine, wiederverwendbare Komponenten und Schnittstellen, die wir projektübergreifend einsetzen, entstehen unter deiner Verantwortung
Du gestaltest Build-, Deployment- und Infrastrukturprozesse mit – von Containern über CI/CD bis zum Cloud-Hosting – und bringst AI-gestützte Entwicklung in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Expert:innen voran
Gemeinsam mit dem Chapter Lead und den anderen Staff Engineers definierst du das technische Zielbild des Chapters, legst Standards fest und setzt Technologie-Prioritäten. Bei kritischen Projekten bist du zudem fachliche Eskalationsinstanz für Team Leads und Entwickler:innen
Du gibst dein Wissen weiter – durch Schulungen, Reviews und technische Austauschformate für die Teams

Dein Profil

Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung als Senior oder Lead Engineer in der Entwicklung komplexer Webanwendungen mit
Fundierte Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony gehören ebenso zu deinem Profil wie die Erfahrung, Anwendungen über mehrere Jahre hinweg weiterzuentwickeln und zu verantworten. Dabei denkst du full-stack, vom Datenmodell über die Schnittstelle bis ins Frontend (z. B. Node.js, TypeScript, React)
Du hast bereits projektübergreifend wiederverwendbare Bausteine entwickelt – Basis-Setups, Bundles, geteilte Bibliotheken und wiederkehrende Module
Mit CI/CD, Container-Umgebungen und dem Betrieb in der Cloud (z. B. AWS, GCP oder Azure) kennst du dich aus und triffst hier Architekturentscheidungen mit, ohne den operativen Betrieb zu übernehmen
AI-gestützte Entwicklung und agentische Workflows sind fester Bestandteil deines Arbeitsalltags
Du überzeugst durch Argumente statt durch Hierarchie: Du bindest Team Leads und Entwickler:innen frühzeitig ein, begründest deine Vorschläge nachvollziehbar und passt sie an, wenn gute Gegenargumente vorliegen. Technische Zusammenhänge erklärst du sowohl Kund:innen als auch der Geschäftsführung verständlich, und es liegt dir daran, andere fachlich weiterzubringen
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und gute Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab und ermöglichen dir die sichere Kommunikation mit deutschsprachigen Kund:innen
Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Erfahrung mit Pimcore oder in einer Digitalagentur mit

Warum wir?

Ein dynamisches und anspruchsvolles Agentur-Umfeld mit vielfältigen Herausforderungen und einem interessanten Kundenmix
Mitarbeit in einem agilen und fokussierten Team
Eine abwechslungsreiche und selbstständige Tätigkeit mit flachen Hierarchien und gegenseitigem Vertrauen
Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit der Wahl zwischen hybrid oder full remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Spaniens oder Österreichs
Standorte in München, Traunstein, Barcelona und Wien
Flexible Arbeitszeiten (kinderfreundlich und garantiert ohne Wochenenddienst)
Legendäre Teamevents

Über uns

Wir sind die Digitalagentur mit Full-Service-Charakter mit Standorten in München, Traunstein, Barcelona und Wien. Bereits seit 2007 konzipieren, designen und programmieren wir individuelle Websiteprojekte, entwerfen anspruchsvolle Designs, entwickeln erfolgreiche Werbekampagnen und vieles mehr für unsere Kunden. Dabei bieten wir nicht nur für unsere Kunden individuelle Lösungen - auch unser Team profitiert davon. Bei uns arbeiten Profis in den Bereichen Webentwicklung, Design, Marketing und Beratung und Projektmanagement.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

About the Role
:

We are looking for an enthusiastic Full Stack .NET Engineer to join our team. You will work in the Researcher Profiles Service
team, where we build and manage a global-scale academic data platform.
Through powerful APIs and intuitive UIs, we make critical research information accessible to the rest of the company and to end-users worldwide.

We have fully embraced AI-based spec-driven design
, integrating AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle. From specification to implementation, AI tooling shapes how we architect, build, and iterate — making us faster, more deliberate, and focused on what matters most. This isn't an experiment. It's how we work.

You will take ownership of high-impact projects and drive them to success in a team that's redefining how modern software is built.

Key Responsibilities
:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications using .NET and Vue.js
Enhance and support existing solutions built with older versions of .NET and Vue.js
Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other cross-functional teams to gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and determine optimal implementation strategies
Collaborate within a multinational, cross-functional team to deliver software solutions aligned with business needs
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to best practices
Ensure the quality of the delivered solutions
Optimise applications for performance, scalability, and responsiveness
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges
Conduct code reviews and mentor junior engineers
Willingness to learn, flexible approach, and staying current with emerging trends in IT to maintain an up-to-date technology stack
Business-oriented attitude with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes for end-users. Demonstrable experience in owning and driving full-stack projects end-to-end, from the specification refinement phase to the production monitoring

Requirements

5+ years of experience in software engineering, specializing in .NET Core/Framework
3+ years of hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks (Vue 3 is a plus)
Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies
Deep expertise in Vue.js, including Vue 2 and Vue 3, with a strong understanding of state management, component-based architecture, and best practices for building scalable front-end applications
Strong expertise in SQL Server, including performance tuning, indexing strategies, query optimization, and troubleshooting production issues.
Heavy experience in implementing APIs with REST and GraphQL
Experience integrating AI solutions into customer-facing applications
Proficient in leveraging AI to enhance daily engineering work
Expexienced in owning complex, distributed system architectures
Solid understanding of microservices and micro-frontend concepts
Collaborative and thriving in a hybrid environment

Nice-to-Have Skills
:

Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB)
Experience with containerization platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

As a Medior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/Modern Frontend), you will join a friendly, agile, and fully remote DevOps team. We have a clear mission: We want to focus our efforts on evolving and enhancing our core Digital Signing application. To achieve this, your role will be a balance between building these new capabilities and helping us maintain and stabilize our existing ecosystem (Digital Signing, Document Creation, and File Transfer).

Your duties will revolve around designing and delivering resilient software solutions, ensuring high code quality through strong review practices and automated testing (we own our code from design to deployment!). We embrace modern tooling, so you will leverage AI-assisted tools to drive productivity and optimize our processes. As part of the team, you will participate in all agile ceremonies and actively contribute with your ideas and expertise. 

Skill set

Team spirit.
Autonomous and self-organized.
Be a persistent, creative problem-solver.
Flexible and willing to accept a change in priorities as necessary.
Strong attention to detail.
Outstanding collaboration.
Fluent English: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. English is our daily working language (meetings, documentation, and code). Our team is distributed in the Netherlands and in Spain. 
A positive, resilient attitude. We are looking for someone who brings good energy to the team, enjoys helping others, and navigates maintenance or legacy challenges with a constructive mindset.

Technical skill set

At least 5+ years' experience in web and software development (Medior level).
Strong backend experience: Solid knowledge of .NET / .NET Core architecture and API programming experience (REST).
Modern frontend knowledge: Experience with a modern frontend framework like React, Vue, or Angular using TypeScript. (Note: Our stack is Angular, but if you come from React/Vue and are willing to learn, we want you!)
Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude) to accelerate workflows while ensuring code quality.
Hands-on experience or strong interest in integrating LLMs and generative-AI services into applications (e.g., Azure OpenAI Service).
Familiarity with concepts like prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or vector search.
Microsoft Azure experience.
Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions experience (CI/CD pipelines).
SQL experience.
Experience handling integration challenges (authentication, rate limiting, error handling, resiliency, and messaging like Service Bus/Event Grid).
Awareness of data-privacy principles (GDPR/AVG), including the safe handling of personal and payroll data (encryption in transit and at rest).
Strong code review practices and critical thinking to evaluate technical trade-offs.
Experience working in an agile environment.
Experience with professional software engineering best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, source control management, build processes, automated testing, and operations.

Nice to have:

Direct hands-on experience specifically with Angular (TypeScript).
Experience with Document Generation libraries (e.g., TextControl).
Specific domain knowledge in Digital Signing or File Transfer applications.

Responsibilities

Drive our core product: Design, build, and maintain full-stack features fully hosted in Microsoft Azure, focusing on the evolution and enhancement of our core Digital Signing application for Youforce.
Support the ecosystem: Maintain, stabilize, and troubleshoot our existing ecosystem (Digital Signing, Document Creation, and File Transfer), which includes navigating legacy technologies and keeping our support baseline under control.
Own the quality: Take full ownership of software testing (Unit, Integration, E2E) and performance. We don't have a dedicated QA team, so our engineers own the code from design to deployment.
Smart AI Integration: Responsibly integrate AI APIs (like LLMs) into our products when needed, ensuring they handle personal and payroll data in strict compliance with GDPR/AVG and least-privilege principles.
AI Monitoring & Guardrails: Build guardrails, evaluation, and monitoring for any AI features you integrate, keeping a close eye on quality, cost, latency, safety, and bias. 
Architecture & Problem Solving: Architect and implement software solutions by analyzing business context, technical feasibility, and system scalability.
Code Excellence: Evaluate, refactor, and review code actively. Ensure high security standards, architectural integrity, and efficiency.
Take Ownership: Make informed decisions quickly and take ownership of services and applications at scale.
Team Collaboration: Actively participate in agile team meetings, propose creative solutions to daily challenges, share knowledge, and work collaboratively to achieve our goals.

What we offer

Our local staff is part of a dynamic and multicultural environment (average age of 41, 9 nationalities)
Challenging, exciting, and varied tasks.
An inclusive and inspiring work environment with skilled colleagues.
Exciting professional environment based on a high level of expertise.
Facilitation for professional and personal development.
Competitive pay.
Social benefits (ticket restaurants, teleworking expenses and health insurance).
Team building activities and social business life.
Autonomy day (take a day off from your daily duties to research, experiment with new technologies/AI tools, or self-learning).
Flexible working hours, 7-10h / 16-19h (Friday from 8-15h).
During July and August, 8-15h every day.
Salary 44.000-55.000 annual gross

Position with full flexibility: full remote*, partial or in office.
Remote working across different areas of Spain is not a problem but please note that you'd have to be already located and eligible to work in the country to apply. Please ensure when applying for this role that you are legally eligible to work/live in your preferred location. Visa sponsorship or relocation costs will not be provided.
If you are interested in this role, please submit your CV in English.
Youforce Spain is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. Define how MES, historians, SCADA/PLC, and enterprise systems (ERP, LIMS, QMS) communicate.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical guidance to project teams (MES consultants, automation engineers, data engineers, developers).
Review and validate functional & technical designs, ensuring alignment with the architectural vision.
Support implementation by offering hands-on expertise when needed (prototyping, integration, troubleshooting).

Collaboration & Strategy

Facilitate workshops with stakeholders to explore requirements and align on architectural decisions.
Support clients in building digital transformation roadmaps — focusing on value, resilience, maintainability, and long-term scalability.
Contribute to AG SOLUTION’s internal knowledge base, best practices, and reference architectures.

Quality, Security & Governance

Ensure architectures comply with cybersecurity, data governance, and reliability standards.
Promote modern practices: event-driven architectures, decoupled integration, domain-based modelling, and clean data flows.

What we’re looking for

Essential Experience

Strong expertise in MES platforms (e.g., Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FTPC, Werum, Aveva, Ignition, etc.).
Deep understanding of manufacturing processes and OT/IT ecosystem integration.
Solid experience with Unified Namespace concepts and enabling technologies:
MQTT, Sparkplug B, broker design, payload conventions
Event-driven architecture & pub/sub models
Data modelling for industrial environments

Strong knowledge of industrial integration patterns (OPC UA, REST APIs, SQL databases, historians, etc.).
Ability to design reference architectures and explain trade-offs clearly.
Experience collaborating with automation teams (PLC/SCADA) and IT/data teams.
A structured, analytical mindset with strong communication skills — able to make complex topics accessible.

Experience with modern IIoT platforms or data platforms (Kafka, Azure/AWS IoT, Influx, etc.).
Knowledge of ISA-95, ISA-88, and general manufacturing standards.
Experience in cybersecurity frameworks for industrial systems.
Ability to mentor junior engineers or lead small technical teams.
Hands-on experience with scripting or coding (Python, Node-RED, .NET, etc.) is a plus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: dComm Solutions Design Architect
jobs.description:
Overview

At PepsiCo International dCommerce team, we are building the next generation of innovative products and capabilities using emerging technologies to accelerate our business and gain back share. While tied closely to broader PepsiCo, the dCommerce group has a unique start-up feel and defined values that embrace a more entrepreneurial mindset.

We are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to guide the technical direction of our engineering organization as we scale. From evolving our data platform to transitioning to software, from BI tooling into a full application and AI for BI, you'll lead architecture and design reviews, define integration approaches with wider PepsiCo capabilities, and ensure we build coherently across Data Engineering, BI Engineering, and Product Engineering.

This is a role for someone who wants to build the blueprint, not just inherit one. You'll partner with Engineering Managers to make technology choices that balance innovation with pragmatism, navigate platform governance to unblock delivery, and ensure what we build today supports where we're heading. If you want to shape the technical future of a scaling digital commerce capability not just review other people's designs - this is that opportunity.

Responsibilities

Architecture and Design Oversight

Lead software architecture and design reviews across the International Digital cCmmerce engineering organization, ensuring alignment with organizational standards and long-term goals
Define and maintain reference architectures for dComm capabilities from data platform through to user-facing applications
Ensure architectural coherence across Data Engineering, BI Engineering, and Product Engineering
Participate in creating the the architectural runway in collaboration with Platform team by identifying foundational investments needed to support future capabilities

Platform and Integration Strategy

Lead evaluation and design of integration approaches with wider PepsiCo capabilities and platforms relevant for International
Partner with DTX Core Platform Team to ensure dComm needs are represented in platform decisions
Navigate platform governance, submit requests, advocate for international requirements, ensure dComm isn't blocked by platform constraints
Advise on AI for BI evolution

Technical Leadership

Partner with Product Engineering Manager on application architecture decisions: technology selection, system design, scalability approach
Provide architectural guidance on complex cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams
Review and challenge technical designs to ensure they meet non-functional requirements (performance, security, maintainability)

Standards and Governance

Define and maintain software architecture standards for dComm: API design, service boundaries, security patterns, deployment approaches
Ensure alignment with wider PepsiCo technology standards while advocating for dComm-specific needs
Create and maintain architecture documentation, decision records, and design artefacts
Guide Engineering Managers on architectural trade-offs and help them make informed decisions

Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary architectural interface between dComm and DTX Core Platform Team
Collaborate with Data Architect to ensure end-to-end coherence across data and application layers
Represent dComm engineering in enterprise architecture forums and technology governance processes
Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risks, and architectural implications of strategic initiatives

Qualifications

6+ years of experience as a solutions architect spanning data platforms and applications
Experience navigating enterprise platform teams and governance processes
Background in integration architecture connecting capabilities across organizational boundaries
Strong software architecture foundation system design, API design, service-oriented and event-driven architectures
Experience with modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow) and how applications integrate with data platforms
Strong expertise in containerization technologies and container orchestration solutions
Ability to create and maintain architecture diagramas to effectively communicate system design/technical decisions
Understanding of cloud cost optimization, with the ability to balance cost, performance and business value in architectural decisions.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and infrastructure considerations
Understanding of BI tools (Power BI) and their architectural limitations
Experience with or strong interest in Elixir (or comparable functional languages for scalable applications)
Knowledge of security, performance, and scalability patterns for enterprise applications
Ability to guide and influence Engineering Managers without direct authority
Strong communication skills and can articulate architectural rationale to technical and business audiences
Comfortable operating in a matrix environment across dComm, DTX Platform, and enterprise functions

What makes us different?

Hybrid work model: combination of remote and collaborative office experience to enable innovation
Entrepreneurial environment in leading international company
Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities
Variety of benefits to support your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing
Volunteering opportunities to help external communities

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We're Capital on Tap 👋

💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We've done a pretty good job so far, but we're just getting started!

We opened our first Portuguese office in Porto in autumn 2025, and in less than a year it has grown to a team of 50. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one.

🏡🏢 The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €55,000-70,000

This is a multiple-headcount role, so please don't be put off if you've seen it advertised for a while.

What You'll Be Doing

We're looking for Senior Full stack Engineers to help us build the best credit card and payment products for small businesses. If you're looking for an environment where you're given the freedom to make empowered decisions, research new technologies, and learn/share knowledge with your peers. Then keep on reading!

You'll build robust and scalable solutions using .Net technology
From the first line of code to production, monitoring, and continuous improvement - you'll own the SDLC
You'll craft slick, responsive user interfaces with modern JavaScript frameworks (React), making sure our products don't just work, they feel great to use
Teamwork makes the dream work - you'll partner with Product Managers, QA's, and fellow Software Engineers
You'll build bulletproof unit and integration tests to keep our software sharp and our users happy
Bugs happen. When they do, you'll be ready to troubleshoot and tweak as needed
You'll bridge the gap between tech speak and business goals, ensuring everyone's on the same page and moving forward together

We're Looking For 🔎

Required skills:

A minimum of 5+ years hands-on experience in C#, .Net Core, SQL Server, ideally JavaScript and React also!
Good testing practices, in both Unit and Integration testing
Good understanding of database technologies
Experience in using Agile development practices
A passion for learning new skills and technologies
A proactive, supportive, and collaborative team player

Our Tech Stack

Backend: C#, .Net, .Net Core
Frontend: React, JavaScript
Mobile: Flutter, Dart
Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
Cloud: Azure & GCP

Interview Process 🤝

First stage: 30-minute intro, CV review, and values with a Talent Partner
Second stage: 45-minute "Tech Chat" with a Team Manager
Final stage: 90-minute Code Pairing + 30-minute Values Interview

Diversity & Inclusion
🌈

We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks

Check out our benefits:

🏥 Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare

🎁 Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)

🏖️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)

📖 Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget

💬 6 free therapy sessions per year

🍫 Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Other Info

👍Check out our 'Top Tips' for interviewing.

✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin.

📧Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions.

Excited to work here? Apply!

If you'd like to progress your career within our fast growing, profitable fintech then click apply and we will aim to get back to you within 3 working days (during busy periods this could take up to 5 working days.)

We believe in the positive power of energy – and in people who are ready to shape the future with their ideas and dedication. That’s why we established the EnBW Tech Hub in Portugal to drive innovation and develop digital solutions that support the energy transition and improve the way we work.

As a key pillar of EnBW’s technological transformation, the Tech Hub plays a vital role in our journey. EnBW is one of the largest energy companies, headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, employing approximately 30,000 people. ENBW IT SOLUTIONS, UNIPESSOAL LDA, a wholly owned subsidiary of EnBW, operates as an integral part of EnBW's IT division. In Lisbon, we bring together experts in IT, administration, project management and HR to collaborate in an agile, international environment and create smart, scalable solutions.

Our Benefits

Private supplementary health insurance including coverage for your immediate family, offering peace of mind beyond the public system.
Meal allowance to support your daily work routines.
Additional paid days off (24 December & Carnival Day) on top of statutory annual leave - giving you more time for what matters.
Hybrid working model with a mix of remote and office days to support flexibility and modern ways of working.
Intercultural collaboration & cross border projects - grow your international experience by working with colleagues in Germany.
Modern technology and continuous development opportunities to support your growth and keep you up to date in your field.
Bright, appealing offices in a trendy Lisbon area, designed for productive and enjoyable workdays.

Your tasks

You are part of a software engineering team that builds and operates BAPC, our internal business platform for monetization, including services for billing, accounting, payment, and collection.
You design, build, and operate cloud-native services on Azure Kubernetes Service, MongoDB Atlas, and other Azure services, increasingly supported by AI-coding agents. We use Go/Golang (preferred in this team), C#/.NET, Kotlin, and additional technologies in a complex, grown system landscape.
You contribute to a high-quality engineering culture by creating clean, well-tested code (unit and integration tests), applying Domain-Driven Design and resilience patterns, and maintaining production workloads responsibly.
You shape and maintain our infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines with a DevOps mindset, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes containerization to keep delivery and operations efficient and reliable.
You work closely with architects, business analysts, and process experts to clarify architecture and business requirements and support the customer journey.

Your profile

Education: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a comparable qualification
Experience: 3+ years of professional software development experience using Go/Golang, C#/.NET, Kotlin, Java, or similar languages in a cloud environment (Azure preferred)
Agile practices: Comfortable working in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), with a continuous-improvement mindset, shared ownership, and pragmatic problem-solving
Collaboration & communication: able to articulate and document technical decisions clearly, and collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders
Maintenance & operations: Willingness to share on-call responsibility and actively contribute to stable, observable, and secure production systems

Nice To Have

Experience with AI-based tools for agentic coding
Experience with processes around B2C CRM and billing or payment
Experience in a regulated environment or in the energy sector
Kubernetes know-how: K8s concepts, Helm charts, operators
Proficiency in gRPC, Protobuf, REST

Language Skills

Proficiency in English (C1 level or higher)
Portuguese (B1 level or higher)
German language skills are a plus

About The Department

Our Sales IT department is the Software Engineering powerhouse behind EnBW’s Sales, Marketing and Operations organization. We design, build and run scalable digital platforms and customer‑facing services for B2C businesses such as energy, utility services and e‑mobility. Working in cross‑functional, agile teams, we apply strong engineering principles such as Domain-Driven Design and Event-Driven Architecture, along with modern software engineering practices, cloud technologies and product‑oriented thinking to deliver high‑quality solutions and accelerate time‑to‑market for a digital energy future.

Our teams build and operate a broad portfolio of digital products almost entirely on the Azure cloud. This includes high‑traffic customer websites such as yello.de and enbw.com, mobile applications like the Zuhause+ App and the Yello App, as well as Mobility+, EnBW’s app for fast and convenient EV charging on the go. Behind these customer touchpoints, we develop and run a wide range of backend systems from energy core systems and EMP/CPO backends, to an Event-Driven integration platform and numerous APIs, including services for intelligent offer and pricing orchestration across sales channels.

If you are passionate about cloud-native backend development, thrive in a team that takes shared ownership of what it ships, and want to work on software that directly drives EnBW’s sales business we’d love to hear from you.

Contact

Are you interested? Apply online now! A cover letter is not required; we may ask a few job-specific questions in our application form.

In addition to EnBW, our recruiting team also recruits for other Group companies. If you have any questions, please contact Boulay, Andrea | a.boulay@enbw.com.

Intapp is looking for a Client Support Engineer to join our Client Success & Support team. This is a technical, client-facing role focused on the investigation and resolution of issues across Intapp Time — our time capture and management platform — in both cloud and on-premise environments.

What you'll do

Own investigation, triage, and resolution of client-reported issues across Intapp Profitability, with a primary focus on Intapp Time in cloud and on-premise environments.

Diagnose issues across the Intapp Time ecosystem, including the web application, Admin, Desktop, Desktop Extension, Mobile, Capture, tenant configuration, and identity and access management.

Investigate common support scenarios such as time-entry and submission failures, missing client or matter data, validation and synchronisation issues, performance problems, login failures, and integration errors.

Use logs, error messages, configuration, browser diagnostics, API responses, and client-provided evidence to isolate root cause and distinguish product defects from configuration, data, network, or environmental issues.

Prepare complete escalation packages for product defects, including business impact, diagnostic evidence, steps to reproduce, and relevant logs.

What you'll need

2+ years' experience supporting enterprise SaaS and/or on-premise software in a client-facing technical support or application support role.

Experience creating knowledge-base content or support procedures that reduce recurring issues and improve resolution quality.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in Portugal.

This is a strategic and advisory architecture role focused on shaping complex, multi-domain platforms for scalability, security, reliability, and long-term sustainability.

You will define architecture strategy, technical roadmaps, and reference patterns while guiding engineering teams through complex technical decisions.

The role combines deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.

You will bridge pre-sales and delivery, ensuring client solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with long-term platform realities.

While the position is primarily architecture-focused, you will remain hands-on when greenfield initiatives, prototypes, or critical architectural decisions require deeper technical involvement.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, Leadership, and clients while influencing senior technical teams through expertise rather than formal authority.

This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced architect who can raise technical maturity while remaining closely connected to delivery.

Accountabilities

Define detailed architecture blueprints, system designs, technical standards, reference patterns, and long-term technology roadmaps for complex platforms.
Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable distributed systems and integrations while balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational complexity.
Act as the primary architectural authority, guiding technical direction and modernization strategies across mature and evolving systems.
Architect and optimize cloud or hybrid infrastructures, including networking, IAM/RBAC, compute, storage, monitoring, security, governance, resilience, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and automation strategies using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or native cloud tooling.
Guide DevOps adoption, CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, release workflows, environment management, observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Support engineering teams with complex debugging, incident resolution, performance improvements, and architectural refactoring from a systems-level perspective.
Contribute selectively to architecture-critical code, prototypes, proofs of concept, code reviews, design reviews, and technical troubleshooting when hands-on involvement is required.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success during pre-sales to assess technical feasibility, shape solution approaches, participate in discovery and proposals, and validate delivery commitments.
Ensure architectural context and decisions transition effectively from pre-sales into delivery and early project planning.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and modern automation approaches.
Mentor engineers and technical leads, identify capability gaps, promote engineering best practices, and strengthen overall architectural and technical maturity.
Influence senior technical stakeholders through strong communication, credibility, and sound judgment without relying on formal authority.

Requirements

Bring 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in architecture-focused roles.
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
Have proven experience designing, delivering, and evolving distributed systems in production, including large-scale or mission-critical environments.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of REST APIs, service-oriented architectures, event-driven design, messaging, queues, buses, event-management systems, SQL, data models, and databases.
Have solid understanding of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, TDD, EDD, Infrastructure as Code, Platform as a Service, security, governance, observability, and resilience.
Be capable of reading, understanding, and reasoning about complex codebases across multiple technologies, with sufficient code literacy to guide architectural decisions.
Have strong familiarity with modern cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure, including experience with Azure or comparable platforms.
Demonstrate experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automation, infrastructure architecture, and production operations.
Possess strong architectural judgment and a systems-thinking mindset, combined with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and demonstrate strong ownership in evolving and ambiguous environments.
Be comfortable influencing and guiding senior engineers without direct authority while respecting their expertise and autonomy.
Demonstrate curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies and new architectural approaches.
Experience modernizing legacy systems, evolving mature platforms, working with cloud-native or containerized architectures, microservices, workflow orchestration, event-driven platforms, or AI/ML integration is a plus.
Cloud or architecture-related certifications are considered an additional advantage.

Benefits

Long-term, full-time employment.
Fully remote work.
Competitive salary in USD, based on the role and experience.
20+ paid time-off days.
Opportunity to work on complex, multi-domain technology platforms and influence long-term architectural strategy.
Exposure to cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.
Opportunities to mentor technical teams and contribute to broader engineering maturity and leadership development.

Als Fullstack Engineer
bist du Teil eines Teams, das für die Prozessautomatisierung von Festnetzzugangsprojekten innerhalb der Telekom Deutschland verantwortlich ist. Du arbeitest in einem innovativen und agilen Umfeld und implementierst zukunftsorientierte Softwarelösungen zur Verwaltung und Planung des Hardware-Rollouts für das Festnetzzugangsnetz. Das Fixed Access Rollout Orchestration (FARO) System ist eine Cloud-native Softwareplattform, deren Hauptaufgabe die Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen ist, basierend auf einer Microservice-Architektur, die in C# .NET geschrieben ist. Implementierung und Verbesserung der Nachverfolgbarkeit, Beobachtbarkeit und Stabilität der wachsenden Microservice-Architektur durch Monitoring-Tools wie Grafana, Prometheus und Dapr

Vertraut mit testgetriebener Entwicklung (TDD)
Vertraut mit Versionskontrollsystemen (Git)
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microservice-Architekturen, vorzugsweise mit .NET und Kubernetes
Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von RESTful APIs
Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von Integration Connectors
Analytische und lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise an Problemstellungen
Angetrieben von der Bereitschaft zu wachsen und dich und dein Team kontinuierlich dazu zu bringen, innovative Ideen zu erkunden
Fähigkeit, in einem agilen Arbeitsumfeld erfolgreich zu sein

jobs.description:
Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

Project Description:

The Fixed Access Rollout Orchestration (FARO) system is a cloud native software platform whose main task is the automation of business processes. FARO is based on a microservice architecture written in C# .NET. It provides process control (so called MissionScheduler) and connects to 3rd party systems in the environment of the processes (so called connectors). In the future FARO will enable our new process platform Camunda with connectors. The team in addition to developing connectors for FARO will also be responsible to develop templates and APIs for Camunda.

Activity Description:

As a Fullstack engineer you are part of a team which is responsible for process automation for fixed access network projects within Telekom Deutschland. You will be part of an innovative and agile work environment where you will be implementing future-oriented software solutions to manage and plan the hardware rollout for the fixed access network.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend microservices using C# .NET within a Kubernetes-orchestrated environment
Implement and improve traceability, observability, and stability of the growing microservice architecture through monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Dapr
Develop and enhance frontend components using Angular to deliver responsive user interfaces and support rapid feature deployment
Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration connectors for FARO and Camunda process automation platform
Model, configure, and optimise business processes using BPMN standards within the Camunda ecosystem
Containerise applications using Docker and manage deployment pipelines within Kubernetes clusters
Conduct code reviews, share technical expertise, and provide constructive feedback throughout the development lifecycle to maintain code quality and team growth
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve performance bottlenecks and system issues across the microservice architecture
Contribute to the continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation processes
Drive innovation by evaluating and implementing emerging technologies and best practices in software development, including design patterns, clean code principles, and test-driven development

Qualifications

Must-Have Skills:

You hold a degree in informatics, computer science, or a related field
You have multiple years of professional experience as either a Fullstack or Backend Developer
You are proficient in at least one object-oriented programming language, preferably C#
You have hands-on experience with containerisation using Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes
You have practical experience with Camunda and are proficient in BPMN process modelling
You have experience in configuring and developing monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Dapr
You are well-versed in common software development best practices including design patterns, clean code principles, test-driven development (TDD), and version control systems (Git)
You possess proficient knowledge of microservice architectures, preferably with .NET and Kubernetes
You have experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and integration connectors
You are analytical and solution-oriented in your approach to problem-solving
You are driven by a willingness to grow and continuously push yourself and your team to explore innovative ideas
You thrive in an agile work environment and embrace collaborative development practices
You are interested in telecommunication technologies and their applications
You are proficient in English; German language skills are a significant advantage

Nice-to-Have Skills:

You have experience with Angular and can make quick, effective fixes to the front end
You have hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation processes
You have demonstrated experience in performance optimisation and troubleshooting complex system issues
You are familiar with emerging technologies and best practices in software development and are keen to evaluate and implement them

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

About the Company

Phi Partners is a global capital markets technology consultancy, offering a range of services, technology solutions, and advisory support to investment banks, hedge funds, and asset managers. Since its founding in 2004, Phi has expanded its presence worldwide, with headquarters in London and offices across North America, EMEA, and APAC. Our expertise in high-impact areas such as Quantitative, Front Office, and Risk Technology sets us apart, enabling us to collaborate with some of the world's most prominent financial institutions. We specialize in delivering robust, scalable, and cloud-based solutions, supporting clients across their digital transformation journeys.

About the Role

Phi Partners is supporting one of the world’s largest, most influential sovereign wealth funds that has a diverse portfolio covering every asset class across every major geographical region globally. Our client is building a low-latency, event-driven trading platform on Azure. The programme focuses on delivering a high-performance, regulated architecture using Solace messaging, AKS and cloud-native services. This role will perform the end-to-end quality & automation testing and compliance assurance for the data platforms and ETL pipelines linked to the trading platform, ensuring the platform meets performance, resiliency and audit requirements for regulated markets.

Responsibilities

This role is ideal for a highly skilled Software Engineer in Test.
Key responsibilities include:
Define and execute test strategy across unit, integration, contract, E2E, and performance for the data platforms (databricks, snowflake) and ETL pipelines.
Support incident response, root cause analysis and production verification activities.
Automate data quality checks for market/reference data, order/trade states, and downstream stores (SQL Server/Azure SQL).
Implement reconciliation across OMS/EMS, risk, and settlement; verify lineage and PII/PCI masking where relevant.
Use SQL and profiling to validate accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and SCD/versioned data behaviors.
Manage golden datasets and synthetic market data at scale for repeatable regression.

Required Skills

Key Skills The ideal candidate will have:
Experience with implementing and defining test automation strategies for data platforms.
Hands-on experience building automation frameworks using C# and/or Python with xUnit, NUnit, MSTest or PyTest, integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
Strong experience with SQL Server or Azure SQL.
Experience with Databricks or Snowflake.
Experience testing APIs (REST/GraphQL/SOAP) and implementing contract testing.
Experience performing performance testing using JMeter or LoadRunner for latency, throughput, spike and failover scenarios.
Experience supporting financial/trading systems, including order lifecycle, market data and risk controls is highly preferred.

Nice to have:
QuickFIX/N (FIX testing), schema registry tools, ISTQB Advanced/CSTE, Azure certifications, Agile/Scrum.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a talented individual to join a leading capital markets technology consultancy and work on a strategic trading platform programme, offering strong technical ownership within a cloud-native, regulated environment.

bist du Teil eines Teams, das für die Prozessautomatisierung von Festnetzzugangsprojekten innerhalb der Telekom Deutschland verantwortlich ist.
