jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in Saudi Arabia.

This is a strategic and advisory architecture role focused on shaping complex, multi-domain platforms for scalability, security, reliability, and long-term sustainability.

You will define architecture strategy, technical roadmaps, and reference patterns while guiding engineering teams through complex technical decisions.

The role combines deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.

You will bridge pre-sales and delivery, ensuring client solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with long-term platform realities.

While the position is primarily architecture-focused, you will remain hands-on when greenfield initiatives, prototypes, or critical architectural decisions require deeper technical involvement.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, Leadership, and clients while influencing senior technical teams through expertise rather than formal authority.

This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced architect who can raise technical maturity while remaining closely connected to delivery.

Accountabilities

Define detailed architecture blueprints, system designs, technical standards, reference patterns, and long-term technology roadmaps for complex platforms.
Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable distributed systems and integrations while balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational complexity.
Act as the primary architectural authority, guiding technical direction and modernization strategies across mature and evolving systems.
Architect and optimize cloud or hybrid infrastructures, including networking, IAM/RBAC, compute, storage, monitoring, security, governance, resilience, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and automation strategies using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or native cloud tooling.
Guide DevOps adoption, CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, release workflows, environment management, observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Support engineering teams with complex debugging, incident resolution, performance improvements, and architectural refactoring from a systems-level perspective.
Contribute selectively to architecture-critical code, prototypes, proofs of concept, code reviews, design reviews, and technical troubleshooting when hands-on involvement is required.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success during pre-sales to assess technical feasibility, shape solution approaches, participate in discovery and proposals, and validate delivery commitments.
Ensure architectural context and decisions transition effectively from pre-sales into delivery and early project planning.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and modern automation approaches.
Mentor engineers and technical leads, identify capability gaps, promote engineering best practices, and strengthen overall architectural and technical maturity.
Influence senior technical stakeholders through strong communication, credibility, and sound judgment without relying on formal authority.

Requirements

Bring 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in architecture-focused roles.
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
Have proven experience designing, delivering, and evolving distributed systems in production, including large-scale or mission-critical environments.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of REST APIs, service-oriented architectures, event-driven design, messaging, queues, buses, event-management systems, SQL, data models, and databases.
Have solid understanding of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, TDD, EDD, Infrastructure as Code, Platform as a Service, security, governance, observability, and resilience.
Be capable of reading, understanding, and reasoning about complex codebases across multiple technologies, with sufficient code literacy to guide architectural decisions.
Have strong familiarity with modern cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure, including experience with Azure or comparable platforms.
Demonstrate experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automation, infrastructure architecture, and production operations.
Possess strong architectural judgment and a systems-thinking mindset, combined with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and demonstrate strong ownership in evolving and ambiguous environments.
Be comfortable influencing and guiding senior engineers without direct authority while respecting their expertise and autonomy.
Demonstrate curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies and new architectural approaches.
Experience modernizing legacy systems, evolving mature platforms, working with cloud-native or containerized architectures, microservices, workflow orchestration, event-driven platforms, or AI/ML integration is a plus.
Cloud or architecture-related certifications are considered an additional advantage.

Benefits

Long-term, full-time employment.
Fully remote work.
Competitive salary in USD, based on the role and experience.
20+ paid time-off days.
Opportunity to work on complex, multi-domain technology platforms and influence long-term architectural strategy.
Exposure to cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.
Opportunities to mentor technical teams and contribute to broader engineering maturity and leadership development.

jobs.title: MS Dynamics 365 Solution Architect
jobs.description:
The MS Dynamics 365 Solution Architect is responsible for defining, designing, and guiding the technical and
functional architecture for enterprise-wide Dynamics 365 solutions. This role requires a "hands-on" architectural
experince who translates complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and practical D365 designs. The
architect will actively lead real-world implementation cases, resolve complex technical blockers, and ensure the
ongoing performance, optimization, and maintenance of large-scale, high-volume D365 deployments across the
enterprise.
Key Focus Areas:
 Dynamics 365 Architecture & Solution Design
 Hands-on Implementation & Delivery
 Large-Scale System Maintenance & Optimization
 Integration & Power Platform Enablement
 Application Modernization & Upgrades
 Cross Domain Application Alignment
 Infrastructure, Security & Environment Strategy
 Drive Innovation
Job Description
Dynamics 365 Architecture & Solution Design
 Design end-to-end application architectures across the MS Dynamics 365 ecosystem (F&O, Commerce,
SCM, CE) and related enterprise platforms.
 Define application architecture standards, customization patterns (extension over over-layering), and best
practices for modular design, maintainability, scalability, and performance.
 Evaluate out-of-the-box (OOTB) capabilities versus custom development, identifying technical risks,
assessing cost versus benefit, and recommending fit-for-purpose architecture decisions.
 Create comprehensive Solution Blueprints that consider applications, data flows, integrations, infrastructure,
security, operations, and delivery constraints.

Hands-on Implementation & Delivery

 Actively participate in real-world implementation cases, rolling up sleeves to guide complex configurations,
custom extension designs (X++, C#), and advanced data migration strategies.
 Provide deep technical troubleshooting and hands-on guidance during delivery to resolve critical blockers
and ensure the implemented solution remains aligned with the approved design.
 Lead the technical design of complex customizations, ensuring engineering teams follow Microsoft best
practices for code quality and performance.
 Oversee and validate data migration strategies (DMF/DIXF) from legacy ERP/CRM systems into Dynamics
365.
Large-Scale System Maintenance & Optimization
 Architect and oversee the post-go-live maintenance of large-scale Dynamics 365 environments supporting
thousands of users and high-volume retail transactions.
 Proactively monitor system performance, identifying bottlenecks in database sizing, batch job scheduling,
API limits, and complex query execution.
 Guide the optimization of large-scale data sets, archiving strategies, and high-availability setups to ensure
continuous business operations across global outlets.
 Partner with Microsoft Support (FastTrack) and internal teams to resolve critical infrastructure, platform, or
product-level issues.
Integration & Power Platform Enablement
 Design robust integration architectures connecting D365 to enterprise systems, SaaS platforms, and legacy
applications using Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management) and Dataverse.
 Guide the practical adoption of the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) to extend
D365 capabilities without heavy custom code.
 Ensure integration choices (OData, Custom Services, Dual-Write, Virtual Entities, Business Events) are
secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
Application Modernization & Upgrades
 Manage the architecture strategy for continuous updates (Microsoft One Version), ensuring the enterprise is
prepared for platform updates with minimal business disruption.
 Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt by deprecating legacy customizations and replacing them with
newly released OOTB features or Power Platform solutions.
 Support legacy application assessment, rationalization, and modernization initiatives transitioning to the
Dynamics 365 cloud ecosystem.
Cross Domain Application Alignment & Security
 Work closely with enterprise, data, infrastructure, and security architects to ensure D365 solutions are aligned
across the broader technology landscape.
 Incorporate security by design principles, architecting robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Extensible
Data Security (XDS), and aligning with Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) for identity management.
 Ensure application designs properly address master data management (MDM) needs, reporting dependencies,
and operational dependencies.

Architecture Governance & Compliance Alignment
 Work with the Architecture Review Board and domain architects to ensure D365 solution designs follow
approved architecture standards and governance processes.
 Review application and technical designs for alignment with enterprise standards across integration, data,
infrastructure, security, and operational readiness.
 Track architecture decisions, exceptions, risks, and follow-up actions through appropriate governance
forums.
Leadership & Collaboration
 Serve as the ultimate Subject Matter Expert (SME) and technical advisor for MS Dynamics 365 initiatives.
 Mentor D365 developers, functional consultants, and engineering teams on architecture principles, security
best practices, and technology adoption.
 Lead architectural reviews, provide technical guidance, and resolve design conflicts between functional
requirements and technical constraints.
Documentation & Knowledge Management
 Create and maintain Solution Architecture Documents (SAD), Functional/Technical Design Documents
(FDD/TDD), system context diagrams, data flow diagrams, and architecture decision records.
 Document application design standards, technical patterns, operational guidelines, and support considerations
for the Dynamics 365 ecosystem.
 Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and capability building programs for engineering, product, delivery,
and technical teams.

Senior .NET & Azure Developer | DevOps Engineering

Do you want to improve how engineers develop and deploy software through Azure DevOps, .NET and Microsoft Azure?

Summary

As a Senior .NET & Azure Developer at Rabobank, you will work within Tech4Dev on technology that enables efficient DevOps and work-item management. You will use C#, .NET Core, Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps to automate and standardise services for Rabobank engineers.

Tech4Dev supports more than 400 squads that build Rabobank’s modern digital experience. Your work helps engineers onboard, design solutions, manage tasks, develop software and deploy changes efficiently, while meeting high standards for quality, performance and security.

At a glance:

Develop reliable and scalable backend services with C#, .NET Core and Microsoft Azure.
Customise and extend Azure DevOps services using APIs, pipelines and automation.
Improve the development experience for engineers across more than 400 squads.

What will you do as a Senior .NET & Azure Developer?

Develop and maintain backend solutions in C# and .NET Core that support DevOps and work-item management for Rabobank engineers.
Customise and extend Azure DevOps services through platform administration, Azure DevOps Pipelines, APIs and the Microsoft Graph REST API.
Automate development and deployment processes to help engineers onboard, build features and release software efficiently.
Build reliable and scalable services with Microsoft Azure components such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, Azure Storage Accounts and Azure SQL.
Collaborate with squad members, the product owner, scrum master and solution architect to balance technical quality, security and business priorities.

Skills, Tools And Areas Of Expertise

In this role, you will work with or develop knowledge of:

C#, .NET and .NET Core.
Microsoft Azure, including Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, Azure Storage Accounts and Azure SQL.
Azure DevOps, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Azure DevOps administration and Azure DevOps APIs.
API design, API development and the Microsoft Graph REST API.
Continuous integration and continuous delivery, DevOps methods and the software development lifecycle.
Git, source control and branching strategies.
Infrastructure as Code with Bicep and Terraform.
MSSQL and Azure SQL.
Bash, PowerShell or Python scripting.
AI-enabled development tools.
Process automation, reporting and analytics integrations.

Together we achieve more than alone

We believe in the power of differences. By combining people's differences, we become an even better bank. We are curious about what you will bring to our team Tech4Dev.

Within Tribe Tech4Engineering, the Tech4Dev squads develop tools and supporting processes for more than 400 squads. You will work with your squad members, the product owner, scrum master and solution architect to provide reliable and easy-to-use services for Rabobank engineers.

Work on yourself & the world around you

For us, your development and that of society go hand in hand. That is why we want to invest in you and work together to create a better world. We summarise this in one sentence: at Rabobank, you work on yourself and the world around you at the same time.

Why everyone is welcome at Rabobank

At Rabobank, we are working towards a culture where everyone feels welcome. We value our differences and use them to collaborate more effectively and make better decisions. By being open to different perspectives, we create an environment where colleagues feel heard.

What do you bring?

Must-haves:

Senior-level experience in .NET development, including backend programming with C# and .NET Core.
Strong knowledge and practical experience of Microsoft Azure cloud services, including Azure Storage Accounts, Azure Container Apps, Azure Functions, Azure App Service and Azure SQL.
Experience in API design and development.
Experience with Azure DevOps setup and administration, Azure DevOps Pipelines and the Microsoft Graph REST API.
Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery, DevOps methods and the software development lifecycle.
Experience using AI-enabled development tools to improve productivity, code quality and solution outcomes.
Knowledge of Git, source control and branching strategies.
Experience with MSSQL.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, particularly Bicep, and familiarity with Terraform.
Scripting skills in Bash, PowerShell or Python.
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field.
A critical and analytical approach to identifying the root cause of problems.
The ability to communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A proactive and practical approach, with ownership of problems and outcomes.
The legal right to work in the Netherlands.

Nice-to-haves:

Deep knowledge of Azure DevOps APIs and services.
Experience developing Azure DevOps extensions.
Experience building APIs and data services for reporting, analytics and integration platforms such as Backstage and Kong.
Experience developing Power BI semantic models.
Experience developing Power BI reports.
AZ-400: DevOps Engineer Expert certification.
AZ-204: Azure Developer Associate certification.
DP-900: Azure Data Fundamentals certification.
Experience supporting teams with onboarding or migration to new technologies.
Experience with large-scale rollouts in complex enterprise environments.
Leadership skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.

Frequently asked questions

Is this role suitable for my experience level?

This is a senior-level .NET and Microsoft Azure development role. You need senior-level .NET experience and practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, APIs and DevOps engineering.

What will I do each day as a Senior .NET & Azure Developer?

You will develop backend services, customise Azure DevOps, automate development processes and improve tools used by Rabobank engineers. You will work with your squad, product owner, scrum master and solution architect.

Which skills, tools or technologies will I use?

You will use C#, .NET Core, Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure DevOps Pipelines, APIs, Git, Bicep and scripting languages such as Bash, PowerShell or Python.

Which team will I join and who will I work with?

You will join Tech4Dev within Tribe Tech4Engineering. You will work with squad members, the product owner, scrum master and solution architect to improve services for Rabobank engineers.

What does the application process look like?

Your CV and answers to 3 application questions will be used in the first assessment round. Interviews will take place by video call, and a screening and an assignment are part of the process.

Apply

To ensure that we assess all candidates equally for suitability for this position, we do not require a cover letter. Instead, we ask all candidates the same three questions to see how your profile matches the position. Pay sufficient attention to answering these questions and explaining your answers; this, together with your CV, is the only information we will use to evaluate you in this round. If this is missing from your application, your application will not be considered. You can draw on your work, volunteer work, education, private life, and so on. Use a maximum of 200 words per question and provide no more than two examples. Below are the questions:

How should an enterprise-wide DevOps platform be set up to make sure the process is secure and developers can work efficiently?
What do you think about having standard rules versus being flexible when setting up DevOps processes in an enterprise?
If you use Azure DevOps, what automation opportunities do you see?

You and the application process

Apply for the Senior .NET & Azure Developer vacancy at Rabobank.

Questions about working at Rabobank or the process? Contact Niels Diks IT Recruiter, via Niels.Diks@rabobank.nl.
Interviews will take place via video call.
If you are invited for an interview, Bo, our virtual assistant, will contact you by SMS and email to schedule the interview.
A reliability assessment is part of the procedure.
An assessment can be part of the application process.
You can find answers to frequently asked questions here: Rabobank application FAQs.
We respect your privacy: Rabobank privacy information.

You must be based in the Netherlands or elsewhere in the European Union and have the legal right to work in the Netherlands. Rabobank cannot consider applicants who require relocation from another country.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
The job

As a Cloud Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, deploying and operating the cloud infrastructure that supports Milence's digital products, charging operations and customer-facing services. You will ensure that our cloud platforms are secure, reliable and scalable while enabling engineering teams to deliver solutions efficiently across development, acceptance and production environments.

Reporting to the Head of Software Engineering, you will work closely with Software Engineering, Data, IoT and Product teams to build and maintain the cloud foundations that power Milence's technology landscape. In addition, you will drive automation, improve operational excellence and contribute to the continuous evolution of our cloud and platform engineering practices.

What you will do

You will design, deploy and maintain Azure-based cloud infrastructure, ensuring cloud environments are scalable, secure, cost-aware and aligned with business and engineering requirements.
You will establish and manage development, acceptance and production environments in collaboration with engineering teams, promoting DevOps practices that improve deployment reliability, performance and operational efficiency.
You will implement and maintain monitoring, logging and alerting capabilities across hybrid software and hardware environments, proactively identifying and resolving performance, availability and reliability issues.
You will automate repeatable infrastructure and operational processes, contributing to Infrastructure as Code practices and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, consistency and reliability.
You will troubleshoot and resolve cloud, network and infrastructure issues, working independently on complex challenges and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams when broader technical input is required.
You will support secure cloud operations through identity and access management, network configuration, VPNs, firewalls and other infrastructure controls, enabling reliable integration between cloud platforms, corporate networks and hybrid or IoT environments.

Who are we looking for

You have 5+ years of relevant experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, systems engineering or DevOps-related roles.
You hold a bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent working and thinking level, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Cloud Engineering or a related discipline.
You have proven experience designing, deploying and managing Azure cloud infrastructure, including landing zones, cloud resource provisioning, identity and access management and scalability considerations.
You have experience operating cloud platforms in business-critical or distributed environments.
You have experience with containerised applications, service orchestration technologies and modern cloud operations practices.
You possess strong knowledge of monitoring, logging, observability and platform reliability tooling.
You have experience implementing automation solutions and Infrastructure as Code practices.
You have knowledge of networking concepts, cloud connectivity, VPNs, firewalls and infrastructure security controls.
You are familiar with hybrid technology environments and understand how cloud services integrate with enterprise networks, operational technology and IoT platforms.
You bring strong troubleshooting and analytical skills and can effectively identify root causes and develop practical solutions to complex infrastructure challenges.
You actively seek opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency, consistency and reliability.
You collaborate effectively with software, data, infrastructure and IoT teams and can translate technical requirements into practical cloud and platform solutions.
You take ownership of assigned environments and operational responsibilities and consistently deliver high-quality, reliable outcomes.
You learn new technologies quickly and adapt comfortably in a fast-paced scale-up environment.
You have strong communication and stakeholder management skills and can work effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
You are quality- and security-minded while remaining pragmatic and focused on continuous improvement and delivery.
You are comfortable working independently, managing complexity and contributing visibly to the evolution of Milence's digital infrastructure and engineering practices.

What we offer

You'll be joining us at an exciting stage of growth where you can make a visible impact, work alongside passionate experts, and help solve some of the most complex challenges in the energy transition.
In return, we offer:
The opportunity to work on technology that contributes directly to a more sustainable future.
A high-impact role with significant ownership, autonomy and visibility across the business.
A collaborative, international and purpose-driven culture where innovation and continuous learning are encouraged.
The chance to work with leading industry partners, manufacturers and technology providers shaping the future of transport e-mobility.
Company annual incentive bonus plan.
Unlimited holiday policy.
Company pension plan.
A one-time home office allowance to create a comfortable and productive workspace.
Monthly phone allowance.
A 12-month fixed-term employment contract.

Ready to Charge the Future?

Met Power Apps, Power Automate en Dataverse zet je slimme low-code applicaties en workflows neer. Tegelijkertijd ga je de diepte in als software engineer: je ontwikkelt API’s en integraties met bijvoorbeeld Python, FastAPI of C#, zodat het Power Platform naadloos aansluit op andere systemen en data­bronnen. In een team van bevlogen professionals ontwerp, implementeer en optimaliseer je Power Platform-oplossingen. Samen met collega-consultants werk je aan innovatieve projecten bij toonaangevende klanten.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan o.a. uit:

Vertalen van klant­uitdagingen naar maatwerk Power Platform-oplossingen (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)
Bouwen van APIs en integraties om het Power Platform te koppelen aan interne en externe systemen.
Maken van herbruikbare apps en workflows om bedrijfsprocessen te optimaliseren
Advies leveren en bestaande oplossingen optimaliseren om maximale waarde voor de klant te leveren.

Dit is wat we je bieden

Daar hoort natuurlijk ook een aantrekkelijk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket bij. Naast een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring, achtergrond en potentie, kun je rekenen op:

Een Leaseauto met tankpas of een mobiliteitsvergoeding met kilometervergoeding;

50% bijdrage aan je ziektekostenverzekering van jou én die van je partner;

Hybride werken;
Gebruik van gym op kantoor.

Dit ben jij

Je bent iemand met passie voor digitale transformatie en automatisering, en voelt je thuis in het Power Platform-ecosysteem. Je vindt het leuk om low-code te combineren met high-code programmeren . Daarnaast beschik je over:

HBO- of WO-diploma, bij voorkeur in Informatica, Informatiekunde, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde of gerelateerd
Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), bij voorkeur in een consultancy- of enterprise-omgeving

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer (Nederlands sprekend)
jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Netcompany dient een breed scala aan klanten in hun digitale transformatietrajecten in de publieke en private sector in heel Europa. Opgericht in 2000 en met haar hoofdkantoor in Kopenhagen, Denemarken, zijn we vandaag de dag een internationaal bedrijf met meer dan 9000 medewerkers. In Nederland werken we met ruim 200 collega’s aan innovatieve projecten, met name voor de centrale overheid. Denk hierbij aan organisaties zoals CBG, Studielink, IND en 3RO. Lees hier meer over onze internationale projecten.

Ons Nederlandse kantoor is gevestigd in Haagse Poort in Den Haag.

Ontwikkelen doen we samen

Bij Netcompany staat jouw persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling centraal. Vanaf de start word je gekoppeld aan een mentor
die je begeleidt bij het stellen van doelen, het volgen van je voortgang en het verkennen van je loopbaanmogelijkheden binnen Netcompany.

Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot de Netcompany Academy, waar je kunt deelnemen aan trainingen en seminars op het gebied van technologie, consultancyvaardigheden en communicatie. Alle sessies worden verzorgd door ervaren collega’s en zijn afgestemd op jouw kennisniveau en ontwikkelbehoeften.

Vacatureomschrijving

Als Cloud Operations Engineer bij Netcompany werk je samen met getalenteerde collega's aan impactvolle projecten welke de Maatschappij dienen, terwijl je je carrière in cloud operations en infrastructuurbeheer verder ontwikkelt. Voorbeelden van deze interessante en complexe projecten zijn bij Studielink, Rijkswaterstaat, IND, Douane en VWS Datalab.

Met nieuwe projecten op de horizon, zoeken we ambitieuze collega's om zich bij ons aan te sluiten in onze missie om Europa op een verantwoorde manier te digitaliseren. Als Cloud Operations Engineer speel je een vitale rol bij het opzetten en optimaliseren van bestaande en toekomstige maatschappijkritieke oplossingen. Bij Netcompany geven we betekenis aan je werk.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Cloud Operations Engineer Ben Je Verantwoordelijk Voor

Het beheren van een of meerdere bedrijfskritieke systemen, waarbij je zorgt voor continue en correcte monitoring en prestaties van de platformen. Dit omvat ook scripting en het tunen van het platform.
Samenwerken met andere teamleden op het gebied van beveiliging, probleemoplossing, tooling en procesoptimalisatie en deelnemen aan het ondersteunen van audits, pentests en incidenten, probleem- en change management.
Het gebruik van een breed scala aan cloud tooling om infrastructuur te beheren en monitoren.
Het onderhouden van cloud-gebaseerde omgevingen voor verschillende projecten gebaseerd op Microsoft Azure en Oracle Cloud.
Werken met Kubernetes platformen, managed containers en andere nieuwe technologieën.
Statusrapportage over activiteiten en SLA-definities.
Het bouwen van nieuwe omgevingen in een DevOps team.
Reageren op klantverzoeken, change management, incidenten etc. gebaseerd op ITIL-principes.
Infrastructure as Code met Terraform en Azure DevOps pipelines.

Functie-eisen

Wat breng je mee?

We Zoeken Collega's Met De Volgende Vaardigheden En Competenties

Een bachelor- of masterdiploma in IT-studies of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels, zowel schriftelijk als mondeling.
Begrip van fundamentele concepten en voordelen van de Cloud.
Interesse in het werken met container technologieën.
Passie voor innovatieve technologieën en continu leren.
Bereidheid om regelmatige taken te automatiseren en workflows te verbeteren.
Bekend met het OSI-model.

Bereid om de onderstaande technologieën te leren en gebruiken:

Azure DevOps
Kubernetes AKS
IaC Terraform, Bicep
Cloudflare of een vergelijkbare WAF/CDN service
Cryptografie en TLS/SSL certificaatbeheer
Scripttalen (Bash, PowerShell)
Cloud security principes
Docker, Ansible, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Argo CD en meer
Qualys vulnerability management tooling
Certificeringen zijn een pré maar niet vereist. We streven ernaar je te helpen je AZ-900 en AZ-104 te behalen in je eerste jaar van werken in ons Operations team.

Word onderdeel van onze inclusieve gemeenschap

Bij Netcompany stimuleren we een open en inclusieve werkomgeving, gebaseerd op samenwerking, vertrouwen en respect. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt — ongeacht achtergrond, identiteit of ervaring.

Je werkt samen met collega’s uit verschillende landen en disciplines en kunt deelnemen aan diverse sociale en professionele activiteiten om je netwerk uit te breiden.

Wat wij bieden ?

Afhankelijk van je werkervaring een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.300,- en € 4.400,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.
26 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld.
Een pensioenregeling waarbij Netcompany twee derde van de premie voor haar rekening neemt.
Volledige vergoeding van reiskosten met het openbaar vervoer of €0,25 per kilometer bij reizen met de auto.
Een thuiswerkvergoeding van €2,45 (netto) per dag.
De mogelijkheid om tot vijf vakantiedagen te kopen of te verkopen.
Een flexibele feestdagenregeling die culturele en religieuze diversiteit ondersteunt.
Uitgebreide ontwikkelmogelijkheden via de Netcompany Academy , waaronder een vijfdaags Client Engagement Seminar in Kopenhagen.
Mogelijkheden om maatschappelijke impact te maken via JINC-projecten.
Een laptop en mobiele telefoon van de zaak.
Een fietsregeling en korting op sportschoolabonnementen.
Dagelijks premium snacks op kantoor, met altijd koffie, thee en vers fruit beschikbaar.
Diverse sociale activiteiten, waaronder evenementen georganiseerd door AfterDark en jaarlijkse zomer- en winterfeesten.

Solliciteer bij ons

Geïnteresseerd? Upload je CV en (optioneel) motivatiebrief hier! Heb je vragen of wil je de functie eerst bespreken? Neem gerust contact op met Ankita Chadha via +31 611 431 235 of stuur je CV naar recruitment.nl@netcompany.com.

Wij zijn een werkgever die zich inzet voor mensen met een beperking en we creëren een inclusieve en diverse omgeving waarin elk individu welkom is. Onze sollicitatieprocessen zijn gebaseerd op individuele behoeftes. Als je tijdens het sollicitatiegesprek behoefte hebt aan extra ondersteuning, stuur dan een e-mail naar recruitment.nl@netcompany.com. We helpen je met plezier.

Alle gekwalificeerde kandidaten worden aangemoedigd om te solliciteren, ongeacht geslacht, genderexpressie, seksuele geaardheid, beperkingen, leeftijd, religieuze overtuigingen, politieke opvattingen, nationaliteit, etnische achtergrond of sociale afkomst.  

Onderzoek laat zien dat veel talentvolle mensen pas solliciteren als zij aan alle functie-eisen voldoen.

Spreekt deze rol je aan, maar voldoe je niet aan alles?

Neem gerust contact op met een van onze recruiters.

jobs.description:
Applied AI Engineer – C#/.NET & Generative AI
Central Nottingham | Hybrid – 3 days onsite per week | Up to £70,000 DOE

Important – please read before applying

To be considered for this role, you must have hands-on commercial experience implementing LLM / Generative AI functionality into a live software product
.

This means more than using Copilot, ChatGPT or AI tooling to support software development.
We are specifically looking for engineers who have personally designed, built and shipped AI-enabled product functionality using technologies such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search/databases, agents or orchestration frameworks
.

If your AI experience is limited to personal projects, proof-of-concepts or developer productivity tools, this role is unlikely to be suitable.

The opportunity
Our client is an established software business investing heavily in the next generation of its product suite. As part of that investment, they are building out an Applied AI engineering capability focused on introducing meaningful Generative AI functionality into real commercial software used by customers.

This is not an AI research role and it is not simply about connecting an application to an LLM API.
They need a strong software engineer who understands how to take AI functionality from an idea through to production-quality product engineering
.
You will work on genuine customer problems, combining traditional software engineering with modern AI techniques to build functionality that is useful, reliable, secure and commercially viable.
What you'll be doing
You will design, build and deliver AI-enabled functionality within established software products, working closely with Product, Engineering and other technical stakeholders.

Your work could include:
Building Generative AI and LLM-powered product features
Developing RAG and retrieval-based solutions
Working with embeddings, vector search and knowledge retrieval
Designing agentic or orchestrated AI workflows
Integrating commercial LLM APIs into .NET applications
Building APIs and backend services using C#/.NET

Evaluating model behaviour, accuracy and reliability
Reducing hallucination and improving grounding
Designing appropriate guardrails and validation
Considering security, observability, scalability and cost
Taking AI functionality from prototype through to production
Contributing to architecture and engineering standards
Working alongside Product to determine where AI genuinely adds value

What we're looking for
Essential:

Strong commercial C#/.NET
software engineering experience
Demonstrable experience building and deploying LLM / Generative AI functionality into a commercial product

Clear understanding of how LLM-powered systems behave in production
Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications or backend services
Strong API and software design experience
Ability to explain what you personally designed and coded within an AI solution

We would particularly like to speak with engineers who have worked with some combination of:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation ( RAG
)
Embeddings
Vector databases or vector search
LLM orchestration
AI agents
Prompt engineering
Model evaluation
Structured outputs
Grounding and citation
Hallucination mitigation
AI security / guardrails

Experience across modern frontend technologies such as React, Angular, Next.js or TypeScript
would also be useful, although the strongest requirement is the combination of .NET engineering + genuine production AI experience
.
What good looks like
The ideal person will be able to clearly explain:

What AI functionality they built, why it was needed, how the architecture worked, which models/tools were used, what they personally coded and how the solution behaved once it reached production.

You should be equally comfortable discussing traditional software engineering principles as you are discussing LLMs.
We are not looking for somebody whose AI experience begins and ends with:
“I use Copilot every day.”
We want someone who can say:
“I built this AI capability, integrated it into the product, deployed it to customers and can explain exactly how it works.”
Location & package

Central Nottingham

Hybrid – 3 days per week onsite

Salary up to £70,000 depending on experience

This is an excellent opportunity for a strong .NET engineer who has already moved beyond experimenting with Generative AI and wants to build serious AI functionality inside established commercial software products
.

jobs.description:
👋 A bit of background on Rotageek

Rotageek helps businesses optimise staff scheduling through data-driven technology. By combining machine learning and advanced algorithms, we help organisations forecast demand, improve workforce management and give employees greater control over their schedules.

Our solutions drive operational efficiency, improve customer experiences and help reduce staff turnover across the retail and healthcare sectors. Rotageek is now part of the ELMO Software group, strengthening our ability to deliver industry-leading workforce management solutions as part of a broader HR technology ecosystem.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we’ll let you in on a secret: there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate.

Rotageek is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

💛 Our values: what we live by

🫶 Start With People
: You champion the customer experience, create psychological safety and help the whole team deliver with confidence.

🤝 Own It, Together
: You take responsibility for quality outcomes, collaborate across disciplines and help turn incidents into learning.

🙌 Clear Is Kind
: You make defects, risks, coverage and quality decisions clear, actionable and respectful.

💡 Why this role is so important

Our customers rely on Rotageek to support important workforce decisions. As a Software Engineer, you’ll help build the services, APIs and integrations that make those experiences reliable, secure and easy to extend.

You’ll take ownership of well-scoped features and components, turning clear requirements into simple, robust and maintainable C# and .NET solutions. You’ll work closely with Engineering, QA, Product and Data colleagues from design through to production.

This is a role for an engineer who cares about the whole journey, not just the code. You’ll think about testability, security, performance, observability and the way application data moves into reliable customer-facing experiences.

You’ll also use AI-assisted engineering tools as part of your delivery workflow. You’ll use them to accelerate implementation, testing and refactoring, while applying your judgement to validate the output for correctness, security and architectural fit.

🛠️ What You’ll Be Doing

Break down well-scoped features into deliverable tasks, identifying dependencies and communicating progress, risks and decisions.
Design medium-complexity components with clear responsibilities, well-defined interfaces and sensible separation of concerns.
Write automated tests covering core behaviour and common edge cases, working with QA to ensure the right coverage at the right level.
Apply established security practices, including OWASP principles, secure handling of data and appropriate escalation of risks.
Use logs, metrics and traces to monitor, troubleshoot and improve production behaviour.
Participate in constructive code reviews that improve logic, style, performance and security while helping colleagues grow.
Work with Data Engineering colleagues on interfaces, data contracts, data quality and operational failure modes.
Contribute to incident response, post-incident learning and continuous improvement of the services you support.
Document technical decisions and operational knowledge so the team can understand, support and extend what you build.

✅ What You’ll Bring

Professional experience building software with C# and .NET.
Strong fundamentals in object-oriented design, APIs, SQL, automated testing and debugging.
Experience delivering medium-complexity features within an established architecture.
A practical understanding of secure development, performance, reliability and observability.
Confidence participating in code reviews and explaining technical decisions clearly.
The ability to take ownership of work from a well-scoped ticket through to production, including testing, documentation, monitoring and follow-through.
A collaborative, customer-focused approach to agile delivery.
The judgement to use AI productively while validating and owning everything it produces.

🌱 Nice To Have, But Not Essential

Experience working closely with Data Engineering, Data Architecture or analytics teams.
Practical understanding of data modelling, data quality, lineage, data contracts or transformation pipelines.
Experience building reliable ingestion or integration workflows, event-driven services or messaging-based systems.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks, or with BI and semantic-layer concepts.
Experience working with multi-tenant systems, row-level access controls, PII or GDPR-sensitive data.
Experience supporting a migration from legacy reporting or BI technology to a governed, modern data platform.

You don’t need experience with every tool or concept listed above. We’re more interested in your engineering fundamentals, problem-solving approach, curiosity and ability to learn.

🤝 How You’ll Work

You use AI-assisted delivery thoughtfully, validating generated code and tests before they become part of the product.
You favour simple solutions, evaluate existing libraries and services before building new ones, and avoid unnecessary complexity.
You take ownership from ticket to production, including documentation, testing, monitoring and follow-through.
You are comfortable explaining technical choices, listening to alternatives and collaborating across Engineering, QA, Product and Data.
You connect implementation decisions to customer value, reliability, cost and the wider product experience.
You share knowledge through pairing, reviews and clear documentation, while asking for help early when a problem needs wider input.

📈 The impact you’ll make

Customers receive reliable features that are easy for the team to understand and extend.
Components have clear boundaries, sensible abstractions and automated coverage.
Production issues are diagnosed quickly because the right signals and documentation are in place.
The team can trust your delivery, your reviews and your communication.
Application and data integrations have clear ownership, interfaces and failure behaviour.
Data-dependent features work coherently from source system through to analytics and customer experience.

🔧 The tools and ways of working

C# and .NET for services, APIs and application development.
Strong SQL and relational data stores, with an interest in how application data becomes reliable analytics data.
Automated unit and integration testing, Git, CI/CD and environment-aware delivery.
Observability through logging, metrics, tracing and production diagnostics.
Cloud-hosted services, with AWS experience useful in our wider platform environment.
AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code or Codex, used with disciplined review and validation.
Agile planning, code review, incident response and collaborative technical documentation.

🎁 Why you’ll love it here

Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
Flexible, hybrid working, with collaboration across the team and time to focus when you need it.
25 days’ holiday, plus one extra day after three years, and your birthday off.
UK bank holidays, plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve afternoons off.
Private medical insurance with enhanced mental health, dental and optical coverage via AXA.
Employee Assistance Programme, support when you need it.
Life insurance at 2x salary and matched pension contributions of 5%.
Two volunteer days per year, give back to causes that matter to you.
Access to Mintago for financial wellbeing, discounts and expert advice.
Retail discount scheme, perks and savings just for being part of our team.

🚀 The hiring process: let’s make it personal!

Screening call:
A virtual chat with one of our team to learn more about your experience, what excites you about the role and how you align with our people-first culture.

Competency interview:
You’ll meet the hiring manager and talk through your approach to software design, development, testing, debugging, security and collaborating across Engineering, QA, Product and Data.

Final stage interview:
You’ll meet members of the wider team and explore how you would build reliable services, make sound technical decisions and contribute to a strong engineering culture.

Title:

Optio Systems (Valstone Portfolio)

About Optio Systems:

Optio Systems — formed through the merger of DSL and Datastor — is a leading provider of process control software, trusted by nearly 200 manufacturing sites worldwide. Around 70% of our customers are in the UK & Ireland, with the remainder spread across North America and beyond. While we are a long-established partner to the animal feed industry, our software is increasingly powering other sectors including paints and specialist chemicals.

About the Role:

We are looking for a hands-on, web-focused .NET Developer to help us build, support and test the web applications that manage our industrial control platform.

Initially, this role is focused on full-stack web development — building and maintaining the .NET web applications at the heart of our industrial control platform. As you build familiarity with our codebase, products, and customers, you'll progressively take on responsibility for building our test automation capability, using tools such as Selenium and Azure DevOps to improve test performance, coverage and release confidence across the team. This is a genuine growth path rather than a dual role from day one: you'll spend your first months primarily writing application code, with automation responsibilities increasing as your product knowledge deepens.

You will own features from specification through to deployment and real-world usage, working across the stack in a Microsoft environment and turning complex plant data and workflows into clean, usable web interfaces for our customers. You should enjoy operating at the intersection of software and real-world engineering, be comfortable talking directly to customers when needed, and be motivated by seeing your work running in live manufacturing plants.

You will be based in our Nottingham office, collaborating closely with other developers and control engineers, with some time on customer sites to commission your work and understand how it's used on the ground. You'll be encouraged to take ownership early, with support from experienced colleagues to help you grow your skills and responsibilities over time.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain web applications using ASP.NET Core with C#, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS in Visual Studio.
Develop features end-to-end, from database schema and SQL queries through to UI and front-end behaviour.
Work closely with control and automation engineers to understand plant processes and translate them into intuitive web tools and dashboards.
Support deployments, troubleshooting, and diagnostics for web components in live environments.
Progressively take ownership of test automation processes, standards, technology and environment as your product knowledge grows.

Requirements

Hands-on experience building web applications with ASP.NET Core (or .NET Framework) and C#.
Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience writing SQL queries and working with relational database schemas.
Comfortable working across the full stack, from database through to UI.
Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative team and manage your own workload.
Proactive, comfortable taking the initiative, and keen to learn about our products and the industrial processes behind them.
Strong communication skills — clear and succinct, verbally and in writing, at all levels.

Desirable

Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium and Azure DevOps.
Experience working in a Microsoft development environment (Visual Studio, Azure DevOps).
Exposure to industrial control systems, plant data, or manufacturing environments.
Experience within the feed, grain, food, bulk materials handling, or wider process manufacturing industries.

Experience with our Imperium4 platform is not required — full training on our platform and internal engineering processes is provided.

How We Think About AI

We expect our engineers to use AI tools heavily to speed up the mechanics of writing code — so more of your time goes toward the things AI can't do for you:
Knowing what to build — understanding user needs, business context, and judgement that come from real development experience, not just an accurate description of the problem.
Evaluating quality beyond "tests passing" — judging whether a solution is maintainable, scalable, and understandable by the next person to touch it.
Navigating ambiguity — working out the right approach when requirements, priorities, and understanding are still evolving.
System-level thinking — understanding how a change in one part of the system affects everything else.

– Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. High quality output

We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first-order concerns in development.

jobs.title: Senior Identity and Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Aberdeen, our ambition is to be the UK’s leading Wealth & Investments group.

Strengthening talent and culture is one of our strategic priorities. We strive to make Aberdeen a great place to work so that we can attract and retain the industry’s best talent.

Our people put our stakeholders at the heart of everything they do by helping us to make a positive difference to the lives of our clients, customers, colleagues, shareholders, and society.

We are focused on growing our direct and advised wealth platforms and repositioning our specialist asset management business to meet client demand. We are committed to providing excellent client service, supported by leading technology and talent.

Aberdeen Comprises Three Businesses, Interactive Investor (ii), Investments, And Adviser, Each Of Which Focuses On Meeting And Adapting To Our Clients’ Evolving Needs

interactive investor, the UK’s second largest direct-to-consumer investment platform, enables individuals in the UK to plan, save, and invest in the way that works for them.
Our Adviser business provides financial planning solutions and technology for UK financial advisers, enabling them to create value for their customers.
Our Investments business is a specialist asset manager that focuses on areas where we have both strength and scale to capitalise on the key themes shaping the market, through either public markets or alternative asset classes.

About The Department

Digital Engineering delivers the platforms, applications and services that power customer and colleague experiences across Aberdeen. Working closely with product, security and business teams, the department modernises technology, strengthens resilience and supports innovation. The team promotes collaboration, continuous improvement and engineering excellence, helping enable our clients to be better investors.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Identity & Full-Stack Engineer to take technical ownership of our customer-facing identity platform while contributing to application, API and cloud engineering initiatives. Based in Edinburgh, this permanent opportunity combines identity platform leadership with hands-on software engineering across Microsoft Azure and modern digital technologies. You will play a key role in improving security, reliability, automation and user experience across our digital estate. This is an opportunity to shape critical services, influence engineering standards and continue developing your expertise in a collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

Own and evolve Aberdeen’s customer-facing Identity Provider (IDP) and IDaaS platform, ensuring reliability, security and continuous improvement.
Design and implement authentication, SSO, federation, user lifecycle and access governance solutions using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML and SCIM.
Build and support cloud-native applications, APIs and integrations on Microsoft Azure, taking solutions from design through to production support.
Drive automation and engineering excellence through Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines and scripting tools.
Troubleshoot complex incidents, perform root-cause analysis and strengthen operational resilience across digital services.
Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership, standards and best practices across Digital Engineering.

About The Candidate

Essential skills and experience:

Experience operating and supporting Identity Provider or Identity-as-a-Service platforms, ideally Okta but other Identity platforms will be considered.
Strong knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SSO, MFA and identity security controls.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, identity integration and cloud-native services.
Strong software engineering capability across C# .NET APIs, backend services and secure integrations.
Experience with Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD automation and scripting tools.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to collaborate, mentor and support colleagues.

Desirable:
Okta administration, SCIM provisioning, access governance, GraphQL, Playwright, TypeScript, Terraform-based infrastructure provisioning, AI-assisted engineering tools and regulated financial services experience.

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you have a disability and would like to apply to one of our UK roles under the Disability Confident Scheme, please notify us by completing the relevant section in our candidate questionnaire. One of our team will reach out to support you through your application process.

Our Benefits

There's more to working life than coming home with a good salary. We have an environment where you can learn, get involved and be supported.

When you join us, your reward will be one of the best around. This includes 40 days’ annual leave, a 16% employer pension contribution, a discretionary performance-based bonus (where applicable), private healthcare and a range of flexible benefits – including gym discounts, season ticket loans and access to an employee discount portal. You can read more about our benefits here.

Our business

Enabling our clients to be better investors drives everything we do. Our business is structured around three distinct areas – our vectors of growth – focused on our clients’ changing needs. You can find out more about what we do here.

An inclusive way of working

Whatever way you like to work, if you have the talent and commitment to join our team, we’d like to hear from you.

At Aberdeen we’ve adopted a ‘blended working’ approach. This approach combines the benefits of face-to-face collaboration, coaching and connecting in our offices with the flexibility of working from home. It enables colleagues to find a balance that works for their roles, their teams, our clients and our business.

An inclusive culture, where diverse perspectives drive our actions, is at the core of who we are and what we do. If you need assistance with your application, or a reasonable adjustment to your interview arrangements – for example, because you are neurodivergent, or have a physical, sensory, cognitive, mental, visible or invisible disability – please let us know and we’ll be happy to help.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive workplace where all forms of difference are valued and which is free from any form of unfair or unlawful treatment. We define diversity in its broadest sense – this includes but is not limited to our diversity of educational and professional backgrounds, experience, cognitive and neurodiversity, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or belief and ethnicity and geographical provenance. We support a culture that values meritocracy, fairness and transparency and welcomes enquiries from everyone.

If you need assistance or an adjustment due to a disability please let us know as part of your application and we will assist.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
jobs.location: City Of Bristol, England, United Kingdom
jobs.description:
About Heidi

Heidi was born to make it easy for more and more people to discover the power of the mountains. We burst onto the ski holiday market in 2018 (formally known as Ski Zoom) and have seen exponential growth.

The company came from a desire to fix the lack of flexibility in the winter ski market. We help skiers and mountain lovers discover resorts that are hidden gems alongside the classics, and our clever tech is helping them to do it in a way that suits them best. We’re a youthful, challenger brand, with an awesome culture, and we’re shaking up a very traditional ski/mountain holiday industry.

Looking to the future, we have huge ambitions for growth. We have grown year on year and expect 2026 to be our biggest yet. In that time we came 63rd in the Times top 100 fastest growing UK companies, securing £5.6 million investment and just had our most successful season ever in which we were able to hit profitability . Key to that is also growing the Heidi team with even more brilliant people than we have now. So we are looking for someone who will be fundamental to the success of our vision and is excited to help us drive that forward.

Our Supply
Team

You'll be joining a team of four, reporting to our Senior Developer and Team Lead. Our Head of Product leads product direction, and you'll work alongside another developer. It's a tight group where everyone has real influence on what gets built and how.

Why this role is interesting

You'll see the direct impact of your work. A supplier integration you build means new holidays appear on the site
The problem space is genuinely varied: one week you might be integrating a new accommodation API, the next you're solving a data mapping challenge for flight availability
You'll be part of a small, close team (4 people) where your contribution is visible and matters
Heidi is growing fast. We're a challenger brand shaking up a traditional industry, and supply breadth is one of our biggest competitive levers

What a week might look like

Monday you're debugging a data mapping issue where a supplier changed their availability format without telling anyone. Tuesday and Wednesday you're building out the API integration for a new transfer company. Thursday you're pairing with a teammate on the mix-and-match transfers project. Friday you're deploying your transfer integration to staging and writing up what you learned about the supplier's quirks for the team.

What you'll be responsible for

This isn't a task list. It's what you'll own and be accountable for:
Supplier integrations:
Building and maintaining the connections between Heidi and our suppliers. You'll work with third-party APIs, handle data mapping, error handling, and monitoring.
Data quality:
The data flowing through your integrations feeds our pricing engine and search platform. When it's wrong, customers see wrong prices or missing availability. You'll care about getting this right.
Supply breadth projects:
Contributing to the team's work on expanding what Heidi can offer: mix-and-match transfers, open jaw flights, and more flexible accommodation options.
Your own growth:
Whether you're stepping up from mid-level or bringing senior experience, we expect you to develop strong views on how the supply systems should evolve and to take on increasingly complex work over time.

What you bring

Here's what actually matters for this role:
You can build and maintain backend services in C# / .NET Core. Whether you're a few years in or deeply experienced, you need to be comfortable working in this stack day-to-day.
You understand relational databases (we use MySQL and SQL Server) and can write queries that perform well, not just queries that work.
You've worked with third-party APIs before. You know that documentation lies, error handling matters, and retry logic isn't optional.
You can work through ambiguity. Supply integrations rarely come with a clean spec. You'll need to read API docs, ask good questions, and figure things out.
You communicate clearly with non-technical people. The Supply team works closely with our Head of Product and the wider business.

Bonus if you have experience with Docker, cloud infrastructure (Azure), or frontend work with React/Next.js, but none of these are required.

How big is the team?

Engineering:

1x CTO
1x Lead engineer
2x Senior software engineers
4x Software engineers
1x Senior data engineer

Product:

1x Head of product
1x Senior product manager
1x Product manager
1x Design lead
1x Senior product designer

Who's going to be your manager?

You’ll be reporting to JP Our tech lead.

The interview process

Screening call (30 mins)
with our TA Lead
Competency interview (45 mins)
where you show us your experience through real examples
Technical interview (2 hrs) where we pair program and do a system design task

Values interview (45 mins)
with one of our co-founders

Our employee benefits

Salary of £75- £100K based on experience
25 days annual leave + bank holidays + 4 “me/wellbeing” days
We have a hybrid working policy and are happy for people to balance their working week between the office and home.
Vitality health insurance.
Enhanced parental leave for primary /secondary carers and adoptive parents.

Additional employee perks

£1,000 Heidi holiday credit + additional holiday discounts.
A fun packed company social calendar including our summer party, end of term conference and budget for team celebrations
£300 work from home budget

Our Commitment to inclusive hiring

We want to create an inclusive environment that celebrates the diversity of our people whilst enabling them to do the best work of their careers. We are committed to ensuring that all our people processes are equitable. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, sex, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status ,national origin, veteran, neurodiversity status or disability status

Job Description

Job Title:
Technical & Solution Architect (Distributed Ledger / Regulated Financial Services)

Location
: Hybrid - remote + regular on-site (London)

This is a hands-on technical leadership position in the making.

You will work across product management, engineering, and client-facing discussions to evolve the design of a distributed ledger-based post-trade platform operating within regulated financial services. You will initially contribute as a senior engineer while progressively taking ownership of system-level architecture, solution design, and technical direction.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to: Move from senior engineer to architect; Work on real financial market infrastructure problems; Combine deep technical thinking with business context; Shape a product at an early stage.

Why join us? You'll have real ownership and influence in a small, high-calibre team, with direct exposure to cutting-edge financial market infrastructure and a genuine say in product and architectural direction. The role offers a steep learning curve spanning technology, regulation, and market structure, along with a clear path to grow into a formal Technical & Solution Architect position.

Responsibilities

Job requirements

Architecture & System Design

Design scalable, secure distributed systems in regulated environments
Define and evolve system architecture, APIs, and integration patterns
Apply appropriate software design patterns and architectural principles
Contribute to smart contract and ledger design decisions
Ensure auditability, resilience, and operational robustness

Distributed Ledger & Digital Assets

Work with distributed ledger technologies and smart contracts. Design models for:

Tokenised assets
Natively digital assets
Atomic settlement
DvP and RvP mechanisms
Central bank digital currency (CBDC) integration concepts
Evaluate trade-offs between on-chain and off-chain components

Financial Services Context

Translate regulatory and market structure requirements into technical design
Understand settlement models and post-trade infrastructure
Work within business frameworks such as CSDR and GDPR.

Engineering & Implementation

Contribute production-quality code in Java, JavaScript, Solidity, SQL
Review code and guide best practices
Improve CI/CD, testing strategies, and observability

Communication & Influence

Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, product management, clients, and regulators (where applicable)
Tailor messaging to different audiences.
Use structured thinking and persuasive communication to amplify the impact of our technology.
Contribute to technical documentation and client materials.

Requirements

Technical:

Strong experience designing and building software products
Solid understanding of distributed systems principles
Experience with distributed ledgers and/or blockchain platforms
Familiarity with tokenisation and digital asset concepts
Strong API design experience (REST, event-driven architectures, etc.)
Working knowledge of: Java; JavaScript; Solidity; SQL

Financial Services Knowledge (or Strong Motivation To Learn)

Understanding of post-trade processes
Familiarity with: CSDR; Central securities depositories; DvP and RvP models; Atomic settlement
Appreciation of regulatory constraints in financial infrastructure

Communication & Leadership Potential

Excellent written and verbal communication
Ability to adjust technical depth depending on audience
Structured and persuasive thinking
Comfortable operating in ambiguity
Ambition to grow into a Technical & Solution Architect role
Ownership mindset and startup resilience

What Success Looks Like

Within 6–12 months, success in this role means owning key architectural decisions and leading solution design discussions both internally and with partners. You'll be the go-to person for system-level trade-offs, using your technical insight to influence product direction, and you'll act as the bridge between business requirements and engineering implementation.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are Printed.com, one of the largest and fastest growing on-line print shops in the UK. We are filled to the brim with a passionate team who are mad about printing, designing, building and growing the business. In the office you'll find that we are forward-thinking, with a mission to be creative, innovative and to help our customers.

We are constantly investing in new products and using technology to improve how we increase our market share and take advantage of new opportunities. Catch us in our production space and you will find a fast-paced, dedicated team who endeavour to reach perfection for our customers.

We're a growing company with offices in London and Newcastle, looking for employees that are equal parts dynamic and enthusiastic. People brimming over with new, original ideas that they just can't wait to share with their team and bring to life.

Printed.com is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering team as we scale our platform across UK and US markets, reporting directly to our Head of Engineering. You'll work across a mix of PHP (Symfony/Laravel) applications running on AWS (EC2 and EKS), contributing hands-on to multiple concurrent projects while helping raise the bar on engineering practices across the team. This role carries the scope and expectations of someone who takes the initiative on ambiguous or unowned problems with little to no guidance, is comfortable moving fluidly between workstreams, conversations, and challenges, and can dig past the symptom to find the actual root cause. You'll be trusted to own technical decisions and help set technical direction, not just execute against a spec, and to bring that same drive to mentoring others as the team continues to mature.

This is a hybrid role with minimum of 2 days required in our Cramlington office.

Requirements

Responsibilities

Ownership & Initiative

Take the initiative on problems with little to no guidance — spotting what needs doing, digging past the symptom to find the actual root cause, and driving the technical decisions needed to resolve it, working closely with the Engineering Leadership Team, Head of Engineering and Head of Programme to keep that aligned with the wider technical direction.

Multi-Project Delivery

Work across several concurrent workstreams — spanning feature development, platform improvements, and infrastructure initiatives — balancing competing priorities while maintaining code quality and delivery pace.

Engineering Best Practices

Champion and help embed engineering best practices (code review standards, testing, CI/CD, documentation) across the team, acting as a role model for the standard of work expected from senior engineers.

High quality output
Observability and monitoring
Automated testing in all environments, including production
Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices

We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first-order concerns in development.

Strong grasp of C# .NET development
Experience with event-driven systems – Service Bus or similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Microservices architecture experience
Experience with Azure, or other major cloud providers such as AWS or GCP

Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Testing and deployment expertise
DevOps culture mindset
Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar

Location & Benefits

Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones

Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Connected 📱: 6 million smartphone customers, 2.5 million first-time smartphone users
Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents
Green 🌱: 11,000+ e-motorbikes financed, growing 3x year-on-year, cutting air pollution by 90% and helping riders save more than $3 a day

Ready to build C# .NET solutions that put clean, affordable transport within reach of Every Day Earners, while advancing your career in modern backend engineering?

With the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways.
